implementation.sourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 来源版本当前不可选，请复制后重新选择有效来源。
implementation.sourceUnavailable.en-US: This source is unavailable. Copy the research and select a current source.

implementation.sameCandidate.zh-CN: 所有证据对应同一候选

implementation.sameCandidateHelp.zh-CN: 修改权重、费用或资金状态会生成新指纹；旧报告保留，但不能用于新方案定稿。
implementation.sameCandidateHelp.en-US: Changes to weights, fees or funding create a new fingerprint. Old reports remain readable but cannot approve the new proposal.

implementation.validationHelp.zh-CN: 本次操作会保存运行记录与报告；独立随机流验证不等于数据样本外或独立审批。
implementation.validationHelp.en-US: This saves the run and report. Independent random streams are not data out-of-sample evidence or independent approval.

implementation.reviewHelp.zh-CN: 具名保存研究结论。实施条件、历史可得性和机构独立审批资格分别保留。
implementation.reviewHelp.en-US: Record a named research conclusion. Implementation, historical availability and institutional approval remain separate.

implementation.acceptLimits.zh-CN: 我已核对报告并接受列明的研究限制；本次定稿不代表交易授权或机构独立审批。
implementation.acceptLimits.en-US: I reviewed the report and its research limits. Finalization does not authorize trading or certify independent institutional approval.

implementation.mustValidate.zh-CN: 请先完成当前候选的验证，并解决硬约束失败或完整性缺失。
implementation.mustValidate.en-US: Validate the current candidate and resolve hard failures or missing integrity evidence first.

implementation.finalizedHelp.zh-CN: 此版本已锁定。需要修改时，请复制重研。实施条件仍以报告和当前资格为准。
implementation.finalizedHelp.en-US: This version is locked. Copy it for changes. Implementation still depends on the report and current eligibility.

implementation.noPackagesHelp.zh-CN: 从产品实施开始，保存后即可在这里验证和定稿。
implementation.noPackagesHelp.en-US: Start with product implementation, then save the package for validation and finalization.

implementation.budgetHelp.zh-CN: 产品只能在各大类内分配；本次预算：
implementation.budgetHelp.en-US: Allocate products within their classes. Budgets:

implementation.mappingRequired.zh-CN: 此政策尚无产品映射，请先选择有效映射。
implementation.mappingRequired.en-US: This policy has no product mapping. Select a valid mapping first.

implementation.feeHelp.zh-CN: 按每边实际成交金额收费。基金请填写适用持有期和渠道的费率；未知值不要填零。
implementation.feeHelp.en-US: Rates apply to each side's traded amount. For funds, use the applicable holding period and channel. Do not enter zero for unknown fees.

implementation.basisConfirmation.zh-CN: 我已确认 CMA、代理和产品的币种与收益口径一致，并核对费用覆盖。
implementation.basisConfirmation.en-US: I confirmed consistent currency and return bases for CMA, proxies and products, and checked fee coverage.

implementation.balanceHelp.zh-CN: 填写已确认的当前可投资总价值。产品市值、可支付现金、受限现金及应收应付分别列示；已排除的组合外储备不再扣除。
implementation.balanceHelp.en-US: Enter confirmed investable value. Separate holdings, payable cash, restricted cash and unsettled balances. Do not deduct an already excluded external reserve again.

implementation.monthlyRule.zh-CN: 月度再平衡：逐产品路径

implementation.originalPlan.zh-CN: 原计划起点 {{origin}}，总计 {{months}} 个月

implementation.costAlreadyIncluded.zh-CN: 确认余额已包含本次过渡费用，续算不再重复扣除。
implementation.costAlreadyIncluded.en-US: The confirmed balance already includes this transition cost; do not deduct it again in continuation.

implementation.annualFeeSource.zh-CN: 额外年费来源（不得重复已含费用）
implementation.annualFeeSource.en-US: Additional fee evidence (exclude fees already charged)

implementation.stationarityConfirmation.zh-CN: 我接受将冻结 CMA 的年度矩用于剩余模型月的平稳近似；此假设不代表逐产品交易或结算已验证。
implementation.stationarityConfirmation.en-US: I accept a stationary annual-moment approximation for the remaining model months. This does not validate product trading or settlement.

implementation.reconciliationHelp.zh-CN: 逐笔确认已付、部分支付或未付。过去漏付会独立保留，不因未来余额恢复而消失。
implementation.reconciliationHelp.en-US: Confirm each paid, partial or unpaid occurrence. Past missed payments remain recorded even if future wealth recovers.

implementation.cashEventHelp.zh-CN: 登记余额日后的确定到账与支付。本次交易自动纳入，不要重复登记；未知到账日留空。
implementation.cashEventHelp.en-US: Record confirmed receipts and payments after the balance date. Proposed trades are added automatically; do not duplicate them. Leave unknown dates blank.

implementation.totalActiveRisk.zh-CN: 相对 SAA 总主动风险

implementation.historicalMissed.zh-CN: 原计划已有漏付；未来成功率不改变此事实。
implementation.historicalMissed.en-US: The original plan has missed payments. Future success does not change that fact.

implementation.fundingScope.zh-CN: 月度标量代理结果，未模拟未来逐产品交易与结算；逐模型区间不等于联合置信区间。
implementation.fundingScope.en-US: Monthly scalar proxy; future product trades and settlement are not simulated. Per-model intervals are not joint intervals.

ltcma.centerDefinition.zh-CN: LTCMA（Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions，长期资本市场假设）是面向长期投资的一组前瞻假设，描述各类资产的预期收益、波动率和相关性。符合条件的假设可供战略资产配置（SAA）使用，组合权重由 SAA 决定。
ltcma.centerDefinition.en-US: LTCMA (Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions) is a set of forward-looking assumptions about asset-class returns, volatility and correlations for long-term investing. Eligible assumptions serve as inputs to strategic asset allocation (SAA), where portfolio weights are determined.

ltcma.centerRationale.zh-CN: 为什么需要：配置决策面向未来，历史表现未必适用于未来环境；均值方差优化可能放大参数估计误差，使配置权重大幅变化。LTCMA 通常结合历史数据、当前估值和宏观判断形成假设，并关注估计的不确定性。它为配置提供研究依据，但不能消除预测误差。
ltcma.centerRationale.en-US: Why it matters: allocation decisions concern the future, and past performance may not represent future conditions. Mean-variance optimization can amplify input estimation errors, causing large changes in portfolio weights. LTCMA typically combines historical data, current valuations and macroeconomic judgment to form assumptions while considering estimation uncertainty. It informs allocation decisions but cannot eliminate forecast errors.

ltcma.viewReturnDifference.zh-CN: 观点{{index}}年化收益差（百分点）

ltcma.viewStdHint.zh-CN: 严格为正，表示观点不确定性，不是胜率。
ltcma.viewStdHint.en-US: Positive view uncertainty, not a win probability.

ltcma.viewEmpty.zh-CN: 尚无观点，可直接预览先验，或添加有依据的观点。
ltcma.viewEmpty.en-US: No views yet. Preview the prior or add a supported view.

ltcma.basketHint.zh-CN: 系数不是百分数：例如 1、-0.5、-0.5。绝对观点合计为1，相对观点为0；不能全零，绝对值合计不超过4。不会自动归一化。
ltcma.basketHint.en-US: Coefficients are not percentages: for example 1, -0.5, -0.5. Sum to 1 for absolute views or 0 for relative views; nonzero gross exposure must not exceed 4. No automatic normalization.

ltcma.uncertaintyPenalty.zh-CN: 均值不确定性惩罚倍数

ltcma.boxSetHint.zh-CN: 按各资产半宽求区间内最坏收益；人工半宽和边际区间都不代表组合联合置信保证。
ltcma.boxSetHint.en-US: Worst-case return within the declared box. Manual widths and marginal intervals do not provide joint portfolio confidence.

ltcma.ellipseSetHint.zh-CN: 只使用冻结的均值协方差，不修改资产风险；覆盖水平以模型前提为条件，并非收益保证。
ltcma.ellipseSetHint.en-US: Uses only frozen mean covariance, without changing return risk. Coverage is conditional on the model, not a return guarantee.

ltcma.ellipseMultiUnavailable.zh-CN: 多 CMA 尚未定义均值误差交叉协方差，当前只能使用区间方式。
ltcma.ellipseMultiUnavailable.en-US: Cross-model mean-error covariance is not defined; multi-CMA supports box uncertainty only.

ltcma.ellipseSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选版本没有可用的冻结均值协方差；请建立新统计／BL 版本或使用区间方式。
ltcma.ellipseSourceUnavailable.en-US: No frozen mean covariance is available. Create a new statistical/BL version or use box uncertainty.

ltcma.ellipseApproximation.zh-CN: 当历史均值协方差经过收缩或为奇异矩阵时，我接受高斯插件近似；不将名义覆盖水平视为精确覆盖率。
ltcma.ellipseApproximation.en-US: For shrunk or singular historical mean covariance, I accept a Gaussian plug-in approximation rather than exact coverage.

ltcma.frozenUncertainty.zh-CN: 已冻结的均值稳健口径

ltcma.ellipseSummary.zh-CN: 模型覆盖 {{confidence}}% · 椭球半径 {{radius}}

ltcma.conditional_gaussian_mean_ellipsoi.zh-CN: BL 条件高斯均值模型。

ltcma.conditional_niw_multivariate_t_cov.zh-CN: NIW 多元 t 均值后验；半径已区分协方差与尺度矩阵。
ltcma.conditional_niw_multivariate_t_cov.en-US: NIW multivariate-t posterior; covariance and scale matrices are distinguished.

ltcma.iid_normal_hotelling_sample_mean.zh-CN: 独立正态样本前提下的 Hotelling 联合均值区间。
ltcma.iid_normal_hotelling_sample_mean.en-US: Hotelling joint mean region under independent normal sampling.

ltcma.gaussian_plugin_not_exact_confiden.zh-CN: 高斯插件近似，不承诺精确的统计覆盖。
ltcma.gaussian_plugin_not_exact_confiden.en-US: Gaussian plug-in approximation, without exact statistical coverage.

ltcma.meanStandardErrorHint.zh-CN: 标准误来自模型均值协方差；不是资产波动，也不会自动覆盖人工半宽。历史／NIW 半宽是边际参考，BL 半宽仍由研究员声明。
ltcma.meanStandardErrorHint.en-US: Standard errors come from model mean covariance, not asset volatility. They do not overwrite manual half-widths. Historical/NIW intervals are marginal; BL box widths remain declared.

ltcma.sampleWindowSummary.zh-CN: 本次样本约 {{sample}} 个观察年

ltcma.incrementalEvidence.zh-CN: 这里仅显示 NIW 新增证据批次；累计先验信息量另见冻结后验，不把批次长度当作全部样本。
ltcma.incrementalEvidence.en-US: This is only the incremental NIW evidence batch. Cumulative prior information is retained in the frozen posterior.

ltcma.sampleWindowHint.zh-CN: 观察年按日频 252 期换算，不等于覆盖完整经济周期。
ltcma.sampleWindowHint.en-US: Observation-years use 252 daily periods; they do not establish full-cycle coverage.

ltcma.blDiagnosticsHint.zh-CN: 请结合 δ、τ、风险矩阵与观点标准差复核，不设通用 Sharpe 硬阈值。下表资产数值是各观点对年化均值的更新贡献，不是概率或组合权重。
ltcma.blDiagnosticsHint.en-US: Review delta, tau, covariance and view uncertainty jointly; no universal Sharpe threshold is imposed. Asset entries are contributions to the annual mean update, not probabilities or portfolio weights.

ltcma.viewInfluence.zh-CN: 观点影响与均值更新贡献

ltcma.transitionHint.zh-CN: 仅使用相邻已知状态；未知状态中断计数。持续期按一步 Markov 解释为观察期数，未用于多年风险或资金模拟。空白不补自循环。
ltcma.transitionHint.en-US: Only adjacent known states are counted. Durations use a one-step Markov interpretation in observation periods, not a multi-year forecast. Missing rows are not filled with self-loops.

ltcma.stationaryUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前样本无法确认唯一平稳分布；不以历史占用率冒充平稳概率。
ltcma.stationaryUnavailable.en-US: A unique stationary distribution is not certified. Historical occupancy is not substituted.

ltcma.fundingDistributionHint.zh-CN: 资金路径仍使用单一月度对数正态矩代理，未保留情景厚尾或状态转移；即使 CMA 来自情景研究，也不能据此声称使用了原生情景分布。
ltcma.fundingDistributionHint.en-US: Funding still uses a single monthly lognormal moment proxy without native scenario tails or regime transitions, even when the CMA was scenario-based.

ltcma.tableScrollHint.zh-CN: 左右滑动表格，可查看全部列。
ltcma.tableScrollHint.en-US: Scroll the table horizontally to see all columns.

ltcma.regimeEvidenceMissing.zh-CN: 缺少完整的冻结状态证据。

ltcma.stateProbabilityHint.zh-CN: 历史占用率来自共同有效样本；本次应用概率用于推导假设，不是状态转移概率。
ltcma.stateProbabilityHint.en-US: Historical occupancy uses the common valid sample. Applied probabilities produce these assumptions; they are not transition probabilities.

ltcma.excludedStateObservations.zh-CN: 未分类或缺失状态的收益观察：{{count}} 条。
ltcma.excludedStateObservations.en-US: Return observations with unclassified or missing states: {{count}}.

ltcma.description.zh-CN: 研究资产的收益与风险，符合条件的长期假设可供 SAA 使用。这里不决定组合权重。
ltcma.description.en-US: Research asset returns and risk. Eligible long-term assumptions can be used in SAA; portfolio weights are determined separately.

ltcma.scenarioConditionalDescription.zh-CN: 结合当前市场状态，研究指定区间的收益与风险。结果用于情景研究，暂不用于 SAA。
ltcma.scenarioConditionalDescription.en-US: Study returns and risk over a chosen period using the current market state. Results are for scenario research and are not yet eligible for SAA.

ltcma.editVersionHint.zh-CN: 保存后更新当前 LTCMA 方案，列表不会新增一份；已有研究引用保留其当时的结果。
ltcma.editVersionHint.en-US: Saving updates this LTCMA study without adding another list entry. Existing research references keep the results they used.

ltcma.deleteVersionImpact.zh-CN: 删除后，此版本将从默认列表移除，并停止新的研究引用。已有 SAA、TAA 等研究引用及历史记录会保留，不会物理删除；勾选“显示已停止引用的版本”仍可查看。
ltcma.deleteVersionImpact.en-US: This version will be removed from the default list and blocked from new research references. Existing SAA, TAA and other research references and history are retained, not permanently erased. Select “Include retired versions” to view it.

ltcma.deleteVersionReason.zh-CN: 用户从 LTCMA 中心列表删除此版本，停止新的研究引用并保留历史记录。
ltcma.deleteVersionReason.en-US: Deleted from the LTCMA center list by the user; new research references are blocked and history is retained.

ltcma.versionDeleted.zh-CN: 已删除“{{name}}”：停止新引用，历史记录已保留。
ltcma.versionDeleted.en-US: Deleted “{{name}}”: new references are blocked and history is retained.

ltcma.includeRetired.zh-CN: 显示已停止引用的版本

ltcma.chooseScope.zh-CN: 选择已保存的大类或战略范围
ltcma.chooseScope.en-US: Choose saved asset classes or a strategic universe

ltcma.scopeMissing.zh-CN: 没有可用资产范围。请先构建大类，或定义独立战略范围。
ltcma.scopeMissing.en-US: No asset scope is available. Build asset classes or define a strategic universe first.

ltcma.emptyHint.zh-CN: 新建一份长期假设，或调整筛选条件。已有版本不会自动重新计算。
ltcma.emptyHint.en-US: Create long-term assumptions or adjust the filters. Existing versions are never recomputed automatically.

ltcma.emptyDraftsHint.zh-CN: 新建研究后可随时保存未完成的输入。草稿不进入 SAA。
ltcma.emptyDraftsHint.en-US: Save incomplete inputs while creating research. Drafts cannot be used in SAA.

ltcma.deleteConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除草稿“{{name}}”？此操作不影响已确认版本。
ltcma.deleteConfirm.en-US: Delete draft “{{name}}”? Confirmed versions are unaffected.

ltcma.sourceHint.zh-CN: 选填研究来源或判断说明，不影响计算；具体观点的来源仍需在模型中填写。
ltcma.sourceHint.en-US: Optional research notes do not affect calculation. Specific view sources are entered in the model.

ltcma.basisConfirm.zh-CN: 我已核对资产范围、币种、收益、费用及汇率口径。
ltcma.basisConfirm.en-US: I have checked the scope, currency, returns, fees and FX conventions.

ltcma.publishConfirm.zh-CN: 我已阅读结果和限制，确认保存这份研究假设。它不是收益承诺或外部审批。
ltcma.publishConfirm.en-US: I have reviewed the results and limitations and confirm these research assumptions. This is not a return guarantee or external approval.

ltcma.draftSaved.zh-CN: 草稿已保存，可从列表继续编辑。
ltcma.draftSaved.en-US: Draft saved. Continue editing from the list.

ltcma.computing.zh-CN: 正在核验来源并计算，请勿重复提交。
ltcma.computing.en-US: Checking sources and calculating. Do not submit again.

ltcma.needInputs.zh-CN: 请检查收益、风险和资产分类的取值；缺失或超出范围时无法计算。
ltcma.needInputs.en-US: Check returns, risks and asset classification for missing or out-of-range values.

ltcma.needName.zh-CN: 先填写名称再保存草稿。
ltcma.needName.en-US: Enter a name before saving the draft.

ltcma.needPreview.zh-CN: 先完成输入并计算预览，再确认保存。
ltcma.needPreview.en-US: Complete the inputs and calculate a preview before confirming.

ltcma.inputChanged.zh-CN: 输入已变化，旧预览失效，请重新计算。

ltcma.clockUnknown.zh-CN: 平台知识截止日尚未读取，暂不能计算或发布。
ltcma.clockUnknown.en-US: The platform knowledge cutoff is unavailable. Calculation and publication are blocked.

ltcma.clockInvalid.zh-CN: 研究日不能晚于平台知识截止日或今天。
ltcma.clockInvalid.en-US: The research date cannot exceed the platform cutoff or today.

ltcma.clockChanged.zh-CN: 平台知识截止日已变化，请核对研究日并重新预览；没有自动改写输入。
ltcma.clockChanged.en-US: The platform cutoff changed. Check the research date and preview again; inputs were not overwritten.

ltcma.uncertainty.zh-CN: 均值不确定半宽（百分点）

ltcma.uncertaintyHint.zh-CN: 人工半宽不是资产波动或统计置信区间；填 0 仅表示本次不施加该惩罚。
ltcma.uncertaintyHint.en-US: A manual half-width is not asset volatility or a statistical interval. Zero means no penalty is applied.

ltcma.covariance.zh-CN: 协方差矩阵（小数收益平方）

ltcma.matrixHint.zh-CN: 编辑上三角，下三角同步。空值不按零处理；服务端核验矩阵合法性。
ltcma.matrixHint.en-US: Edit the upper triangle; symmetric cells update together. Missing values are not zero. The server validates the matrix.

ltcma.riskReferenceHint.zh-CN: 只回填波动和相关性，不替换你的预期收益。修改风险后会解除原参考认证。
ltcma.riskReferenceHint.en-US: Only volatility and correlation are filled. Expected returns are preserved. Editing risk removes the original certification.

ltcma.riskLoaded.zh-CN: 已读取 {{count}} 个共同收益观察期。

ltcma.riskCertified.zh-CN: 已绑定历史风险来源；修改风险数值后需重新确认。
ltcma.riskCertified.en-US: Historical risk source is bound. Risk edits require a new confirmation.

ltcma.sampleHint.zh-CN: 当前历史模型仅支持 CNY、SSE 连续日频、252 期年化；缺失或不足不会自动缩短窗口。
ltcma.sampleHint.en-US: Historical models support CNY, continuous SSE daily observations and 252 periods per year. Missing or short history is not silently shortened.

ltcma.proxyHint.zh-CN: 为每个战略大类指定研究代理，资产轴保持不变。这不是最终实施产品映射。
ltcma.proxyHint.en-US: Assign research proxies to each strategic asset without changing the asset axis. These are not final implementation mappings.

ltcma.scopeFactsMissing.zh-CN: 缺少完整的资产配置事实，暂时无法确认是否适用。
ltcma.scopeFactsMissing.en-US: Complete asset configuration is unavailable; compatibility cannot be confirmed.

ltcma.scopeAssets.en-US: The assets or their order differ.

ltcma.scopeRoles.en-US: The assets have different economic roles.

ltcma.scopeLiquidity.zh-CN: 资产的流动性定义不同。
ltcma.scopeLiquidity.en-US: The assets have different liquidity definitions.

ltcma.scopeProxyType.zh-CN: 研究代理配置缺失或资产类型不同。
ltcma.scopeProxyType.en-US: Research proxy configuration is missing or asset types differ.

ltcma.scopeRebalance.zh-CN: 研究代理的再平衡规则不同。

ltcma.scopeProxySource.zh-CN: 研究代理的来源或价格字段不同。
ltcma.scopeProxySource.en-US: Research proxy sources or price fields differ.

ltcma.scopeProxyWeights.zh-CN: 研究代理的成分权重不同。

ltcma.priorFuture.zh-CN: 先验研究日晚于当前研究日。
ltcma.priorFuture.en-US: The prior research date is later than the current research date.

ltcma.priorBasis.zh-CN: 收益、费用或汇率口径不同，不能直接作为先验。
ltcma.priorBasis.en-US: Return, fee or FX conventions differ; this study cannot be used directly as a prior.

ltcma.priorUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选先验已不可用，请重新选择。
ltcma.priorUnavailable.en-US: The selected prior is no longer available. Select another study.

ltcma.priorNotCurrent.zh-CN: 先验或其上游已有新版本，请更新后再作为先验。
ltcma.priorNotCurrent.en-US: The prior or its upstream research has a newer version. Update it before using it as a prior.

ltcma.noMatchingPrior.zh-CN: 已有 LTCMA，但均不适用于当前配置。请查看下方具体原因。
ltcma.noMatchingPrior.en-US: Existing LTCMA studies do not match this configuration. Review the reasons below.

ltcma.handoffGoalMismatch.zh-CN: 所选研究关联了不同的投资目标，请分别进入配置。
ltcma.handoffGoalMismatch.en-US: The selected studies link to different investment objectives. Continue with each separately.

ltcma.handoffGroupMismatch.zh-CN: 只能一起选择同一投资目标与约束、同一研究路径与范围下的 LTCMA。
ltcma.handoffGroupMismatch.en-US: Select LTCMAs together only when they share the same objectives, constraints, research path and scope.

ltcma.priorModeHint.zh-CN: 新建先验：借用所选版本的收益和风险，重新决定它们的分量。续更后验：接着上次 NIW 的结果计算，继承原有信息量，无需再填强度；只接受上次样本截止日之后的数据。
ltcma.priorModeHint.en-US: New prior: use the selected version’s return and risk estimates and set their weight again. Continuation: build on a previous NIW result, inheriting its information without re-entering strengths. It only accepts data after the previous sample cutoff.

ltcma.meanStrengthHint.zh-CN: 决定旧收益判断有多大分量。例如填 100，就让旧判断在均值更新中相当于 100 个日观察；相对本次样本越大，结果越靠近旧判断。
ltcma.meanStrengthHint.en-US: Controls the weight of the old return estimate. A value of 100 gives it the weight of 100 daily observations in the mean update. A larger value relative to the current sample keeps the result closer to the prior.

ltcma.riskStrengthHint.zh-CN: 决定旧波动与资产联动判断有多大分量。填得越大，越保留原风险结构，不代表风险越高；更新还会考虑新旧均值的差距，不能把波动率直接平均。
ltcma.riskStrengthHint.en-US: Controls the weight of prior volatility and co-movement estimates. A larger value preserves more of that risk structure; it does not mean higher risk. The update also accounts for differences between old and new means, so volatility is not simply averaged.

ltcma.niwSampleTitle.zh-CN: 先看本次样本，再填先验强度
ltcma.niwSampleTitle.en-US: Check the sample before setting prior strengths

ltcma.niwSampleHint.zh-CN: 按上方资产范围、研究日和历史窗口读取实际数据；无需先填这两个数。统计共同可用的日收益观察，不是自然日，也不是“年数 × 252”。
ltcma.niwSampleHint.en-US: Read actual data for the selected assets, research date and history window. Neither strength is required. Count common daily returns, not calendar days or years × 252.

ltcma.niwSampleCount.zh-CN: 本次样本：{{count}} 个日收益观察

ltcma.niwSampleDates.zh-CN: 数据区间：{{start}} 至 {{end}}，由 {{nav}} 个共同净值日得到。
ltcma.niwSampleDates.en-US: Data span: {{start}} to {{end}}, from {{nav}} common NAV dates.

ltcma.niwSampleExamples.zh-CN: 均值强度参考：填 {{quarter}} → 旧判断占 20%；填 {{equal}} → 占 50%；填 {{four}} → 占 80%。这是分量对照，不是推荐参数。
ltcma.niwSampleExamples.en-US: Mean strength examples: {{quarter}} → 20% prior weight; {{equal}} → 50%; {{four}} → 80%. These illustrate relative weight, not recommended settings.

ltcma.niwSampleLimits.zh-CN: 这里只核对样本数量，不代表先验适用或数据没有重复；计算预览会重新读取并检查。
ltcma.niwSampleLimits.en-US: This checks sample size only, not prior eligibility or evidence overlap. Calculation preview reads and validates the data again.

ltcma.niwStrengthRange.zh-CN: 两个数都须大于 0、且不超过 {{max}}，可填小数；上限只是输入限制，不是建议值。
ltcma.niwStrengthRange.en-US: Both values must be greater than 0 and at most {{max}}; decimals are allowed. The upper limit is an input constraint, not a recommendation.

ltcma.niwMeanShare.zh-CN: 相当于本次样本的 {{multiple}} 倍；更新均值时，旧判断约占 {{prior}}%，本次样本约占 {{evidence}}%。
ltcma.niwMeanShare.en-US: Equivalent to {{multiple}} times the sample size. In the mean update, the prior has about {{prior}}% weight and this sample {{evidence}}%.

ltcma.niwRiskRatio.zh-CN: 相当于本次样本的 {{multiple}} 倍。这不是波动率的混合权重；风险还会计入新旧均值的差距。
ltcma.niwRiskRatio.en-US: Equivalent to {{multiple}} times the sample size. This is not a volatility blending weight; risk also accounts for disagreement between old and new means.

ltcma.niwExampleTitle.zh-CN: 用 100 个日观察看懂均值更新
ltcma.niwExampleTitle.en-US: Understand the mean update with 100 daily observations

ltcma.niwExample.zh-CN: 假设旧判断的年化算术收益为 6%，本次 100 个日观察的样本均值按相同口径年化为 10%。均值强度填 100，更新后为（100 × 6% + 100 × 10%）÷ 200 = 8%；填 300 则为 7%。这只是算术示例，不是推荐收益或参数。
ltcma.niwExample.en-US: Suppose the prior annualized arithmetic return is 6%, and the mean of 100 daily observations annualizes to 10% on the same basis. With mean strength 100, the update is (100 × 6% + 100 × 10%) ÷ 200 = 8%. With strength 300, it is 7%. This is an arithmetic example, not a recommended return or setting.

ltcma.niwReuseHint.zh-CN: 同一段历史不能当成两份全新的证据。新建先验若复用数据，需核对并确认限制；续更不允许样本重叠，即使勾选也不能继续。
ltcma.niwReuseHint.en-US: The same history cannot count as two independent pieces of evidence. A new prior that reuses data requires review and acknowledgment. Continuation rejects overlapping samples even when the box is checked.

ltcma.recenter.zh-CN: 以冻结参数建立新先验
ltcma.recenter.en-US: Build a new prior from frozen moments

ltcma.continuePrior.zh-CN: 续更已有 NIW 后验

ltcma.meanStrength.zh-CN: 均值先验等效日观察数
ltcma.meanStrength.en-US: Equivalent daily observations for mean prior

ltcma.riskStrength.zh-CN: 风险先验等效日观察数
ltcma.riskStrength.en-US: Equivalent daily observations for covariance prior

ltcma.priorHint.zh-CN: 两个数是模型中的信息量，不是要读取的历史天数或正确率，也不必相同。历史窗口决定取哪些数据；它们决定旧判断占多大分量。没有通用最优值，应根据先验证据设定，并比较不同取值的结果。
ltcma.priorHint.en-US: These numbers express information weight, not the history window or the probability of being right. They need not match. The window selects the data; these settings weight the prior. There is no universally best value: justify the strengths from the prior evidence and compare results across settings.

ltcma.overlap.zh-CN: 已核对并明确接受先验与样本的数据复用限制。
ltcma.overlap.en-US: I have checked and acknowledge data reuse between the prior and sample.

ltcma.noPrior.zh-CN: 尚无已确认的 LTCMA。请先完成并确认一份研究。
ltcma.noPrior.en-US: No confirmed LTCMA is available. Complete and confirm a study first.

ltcma.regimeRun.zh-CN: 已保存的事后状态研究

ltcma.configureHistoricalScenario.zh-CN: 打开情景算法中心配置事后情景
ltcma.configureHistoricalScenario.en-US: Open scenario center to configure retrospective scenarios

ltcma.noRegime.zh-CN: 没有可用的事后状态结果。请先在情景算法中心保存适用研究。
ltcma.noRegime.en-US: No retrospective regime result is available. Save eligible research in the scenario center first.

ltcma.regimeHint.zh-CN: 按历史区间匹配日收益，不限识别频率；区间空缺保留未知。移到不可用项可查看原因。
ltcma.regimeHint.en-US: Matches daily returns to historical intervals, regardless of classification frequency. Gaps remain unknown. Hover or focus unavailable choices for reasons.

ltcma.resultHint.zh-CN: 收益为明确口径的模型输入，不是 CAGR 或业绩承诺；无定义的相关性显示为空。
ltcma.resultHint.en-US: Returns are model inputs under the stated conventions, not CAGR or performance guarantees. Undefined correlations remain blank.

ltcma.readonly.zh-CN: 此版本只读。调整假设请复制为新研究，不会改写已有 SAA。
ltcma.readonly.en-US: This version is read-only. Copy it to change assumptions without rewriting existing SAA policies.

ltcma.retireHint.zh-CN: 停止后不能新建 SAA 引用；已有政策和历史记录保留，不会物理删除。
ltcma.retireHint.en-US: Retirement blocks new SAA references. Existing policies and history remain intact.

ltcma.retireReason.zh-CN: 停止引用的原因（至少 5 字）

ltcma.retireConfirm.zh-CN: 确认停止此版本的新引用

ltcma.embeddedFees.zh-CN: 保留来源已含费用，不重复扣费
ltcma.embeddedFees.en-US: Keep source-embedded fees without double deduction

ltcma.noFx.zh-CN: 同币种，不进行汇率转换

ltcma.saaSelectionHint.zh-CN: 这里只选择冻结假设；新建或修改请进入 LTCMA 中心。系统不会自动采用最新版本。
ltcma.saaSelectionHint.en-US: Select frozen assumptions here. Create or edit them in the LTCMA center. The latest version is never selected automatically.

ltcma.incompatible.zh-CN: 资产范围、币种或研究日不匹配
ltcma.incompatible.en-US: Scope, currency or research date does not match

ltcma.selectionMissing.zh-CN: 请先选择适用的 LTCMA 版本。
ltcma.selectionMissing.en-US: Select a compatible LTCMA version first.

mandate.centerDescription.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束用于明确这笔资金要实现什么、计划投资多久、能承担多大风险，以及需要保留多少现金。它对应投资政策声明（IPS）中的目标与限制，为后续配置提供统一依据。
mandate.centerDescription.en-US: Investment objectives and constraints define what the money should achieve, the investment horizon, acceptable risk and cash needs. They cover the objectives and constraints of an Investment Policy Statement (IPS), giving later allocation decisions a common basis.

mandate.savedObjectiveTitle.zh-CN: 已保存投资目标与约束

mandate.objectivesTable.zh-CN: 已发布投资目标与约束列表

mandate.deleteObjectiveConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除“{{name}}”？它会从可用列表移除，但历史研究审计记录仍保留。
mandate.deleteObjectiveConfirm.en-US: Delete “{{name}}”? It will be removed from the available list while its historical audit record remains.

mandate.deletedNotice.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束已从可用列表删除。
mandate.deletedNotice.en-US: The investment objective was removed from the available list.

mandate.noObjectives.zh-CN: 还没有投资目标与约束

mandate.noObjectivesHint.zh-CN: 先添加一套目标、风险等级和现金约束，保存后会出现在这里。
mandate.noObjectivesHint.en-US: Add an objective, risk level and cash constraints. Saved versions will appear here.

mandate.loadingObjectives.zh-CN: 正在读取投资目标与约束…

mandate.editingPublishedHint.zh-CN: 正在修改“{{name}}”。原版本保持只读；保存后新版本会替代它出现在主列表中。
mandate.editingPublishedHint.en-US: Editing “{{name}}”. The original remains read-only; after saving, the new version replaces it in the main list.

mandate.description.zh-CN: 先说明资金任务和成功标准，再用已确认的政策与风险标尺核验目标。系统给出建议，人确认最终授权。
mandate.description.en-US: Define the funding task and success criteria, then assess them against an explicit policy and risk scale. Confirm the authorization after reviewing the evidence.

mandate.simpleDescription.zh-CN: 只设置投资目标、最大风险等级和现金需求；系统用所选风险等级配置的参考参数计算目标是否可实现。
mandate.simpleDescription.en-US: Set only the investment objective, maximum risk level and cash needs. The system assesses feasibility using the selected risk scale's frozen reference assumptions.

mandate.pitDateLocked.zh-CN: PIT 已开启，研究日自动跟随当前 PIT，不能在本页修改。
mandate.pitDateLocked.en-US: PIT is enabled. The research date follows the active PIT date and is read-only here.

mandate.pitDateManual.zh-CN: PIT 已关闭，可手动选择研究日。
mandate.pitDateManual.en-US: PIT is off. Choose the research date manually.

mandate.pitOff.zh-CN: PIT 已关闭 · 研究日可手动选择
mandate.pitOff.en-US: PIT off · research date can be selected manually

mandate.chooseScaleFirst.zh-CN: 先在上方选择一个风险等级配置，这里会列出 C1–C5 的波动上限、参考收益和历史回撤。
mandate.chooseScaleFirst.en-US: Choose a risk-scale version above and C1–C5 will be listed here with their volatility caps, reference returns and historical drawdowns.

mandate.levelPortraitBasis.zh-CN: 卡片数值来自所选标尺冻结的参考口径，用于说明各等级大致意味着什么，不是本次组合的预测。
mandate.levelPortraitBasis.en-US: Card values come from the frozen reference basis of the chosen scale. They show roughly what each level means; they are not a forecast for this portfolio.

mandate.targetNeedsHigherLevel.zh-CN: 你的目标年收益 {{target}} 高于 C{{level}} 的参考收益 {{reference}}。参考口径下大致需要 C{{suggested}} 才能覆盖；也可以下调目标收益。诊断结果以下一步为准。
mandate.targetNeedsHigherLevel.en-US: Your {{target}} target return is above C{{level}}'s {{reference}} reference return. On the reference basis roughly C{{suggested}} would be needed; lowering the target also works. The next step gives the authoritative diagnosis.

mandate.targetAboveAllLevels.zh-CN: 你的目标年收益 {{target}} 高于该标尺所有等级的参考收益。请下调目标或换用其他风险等级配置。
mandate.targetAboveAllLevels.en-US: Your {{target}} target return is above the reference return of every level on this scale. Lower the target or use a different risk-scale version.

mandate.impactSummary.zh-CN: 本目标将约束后续研究

mandate.impactSummaryHint.zh-CN: 保存后，下列数值会被冻结并交给 SAA 与 TAA。填写过程中可以随时在这里看到它们成形。
mandate.impactSummaryHint.en-US: Once saved, the values below are frozen and handed to SAA and TAA. Watch them take shape as you fill the form.

mandate.impactVolatilityEffect.zh-CN: SAA 与 TAA 的组合预期波动一旦超过它就会被拦下。
mandate.impactVolatilityEffect.en-US: SAA and TAA reject any portfolio whose expected volatility exceeds it.

mandate.impactReturnEffect.zh-CN: SAA 只保留预期收益不低于它的候选组合。
mandate.impactReturnEffect.en-US: SAA keeps only candidate portfolios whose expected return is at least this value.

mandate.impactExcessEffect.zh-CN: SAA 会校验相对该等级代表组合的预期超额收益和跟踪误差。
mandate.impactExcessEffect.en-US: SAA checks expected excess return and tracking error against the level's representative portfolio.

mandate.impactFundingTargetEffect.zh-CN: 按现金流模拟达标概率；概率不足时候选组合不被接受。
mandate.impactFundingTargetEffect.en-US: Success probability is simulated from the cash flows; candidates that miss it are not accepted.

mandate.impactCashEffect.zh-CN: SAA 的现金角色资产权重不得低于它；股票 ETF 不算现金。
mandate.impactCashEffect.en-US: SAA cannot hold less than this in cash-role assets; an equity ETF does not count as cash.

mandate.impactExpiryEffect.zh-CN: 过期后采纳的 SAA 政策不能再用于当前应用，只能作为历史研究。
mandate.impactExpiryEffect.en-US: After this date the adopted SAA policy can no longer be applied, only kept as past research.

mandate.impactCurrencyEffect.zh-CN: 后续配置研究与现金预算必须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.impactCurrencyEffect.en-US: Later allocation research and the cash budget must use the same currency; no automatic FX conversion.

mandate.impactHorizonEffect.zh-CN: 决定现金流月数，后续配置研究必须沿用同一期限。
mandate.impactHorizonEffect.en-US: Sets the number of cash-flow months; later allocation research must reuse the same horizon.

mandate.reachability.zh-CN: 目标与风险上限是否匹配
mandate.reachability.en-US: Does the target fit the risk cap?

mandate.reachableUnderCap.zh-CN: 在 {{cap}} 的波动上限下，参考约束前沿最高可达年化 {{reachable}}。
mandate.reachableUnderCap.en-US: Under the {{cap}} volatility cap, the constrained reference frontier reaches at most {{reachable}} a year.

mandate.bindingVolatilityCap.zh-CN: 这低于你设定的 {{target}}，所以现在是波动上限在卡住目标。要达到 {{target}} 大约需要 {{volatility}} 的波动，即 {{level}}。请提高风险等级或下调目标收益。
mandate.bindingVolatilityCap.en-US: That is below your {{target}} target, so the volatility cap is what binds. Reaching {{target}} needs roughly {{volatility}} volatility, i.e. {{level}}. Raise the risk level or lower the target.

mandate.bindingUnreachable.zh-CN: 参考前沿上没有任何组合能达到 {{target}}，提高风险等级也不行。请下调目标收益或改用其他参考假设。
mandate.bindingUnreachable.en-US: No portfolio on the reference frontier reaches {{target}}, not even at a higher risk level. Lower the target or use different reference assumptions.

mandate.bindingNone.zh-CN: 目标 {{target}} 在当前波动上限内可达，风险上限没有卡住收益目标。
mandate.bindingNone.en-US: The {{target}} target is reachable within the current volatility cap; the risk cap is not binding.

mandate.reachabilityBasis.zh-CN: 以上基于所选标尺冻结的参考假设和本次现金约束，是研究证据，不构成本次 SAA 的采纳证明。
mandate.reachabilityBasis.en-US: Based on the frozen reference assumptions of the chosen scale plus this objective's cash constraint. Research evidence, not proof that a given SAA may be adopted.

mandate.reviewDateOptional.zh-CN: 可选。填写后，采纳的 SAA 政策到该日即失效，不能再用于当前应用；留空表示不设复核期限。
mandate.reviewDateOptional.en-US: Optional. The adopted SAA policy expires on this date and can no longer be applied; leave it blank for no review deadline.

mandate.objectiveTypeHint.zh-CN: 决定后续 SAA 用哪条门槛校验候选组合：收益下限、期末资金达标概率，或相对基准的超额收益。
mandate.objectiveTypeHint.en-US: Decides which test later SAA applies to candidate portfolios: a return floor, a terminal funding success rate, or excess return over the benchmark.

mandate.fundingGoalHint.zh-CN: 期初总资金、期末目标金额和期间投入、支付在下面「这笔钱的进出」里按发生顺序填：它们是同一笔账，服务端按同一条现金流轴求解。
mandate.fundingGoalHint.en-US: The starting capital, the terminal amount and the contributions and payments are filled under Money in and out below, in the order they happen: one ledger, solved by the server on a single cash-flow axis.

mandate.referenceBenchmarkHint.zh-CN: 基准自动取所选风险等级的代表组合，无需另选。后续 SAA 会同时校验相对它的超额收益和跟踪误差。
mandate.referenceBenchmarkHint.en-US: The benchmark is the representative portfolio of the selected risk level; no separate benchmark is needed. Later SAA checks both excess return and tracking error against it.

mandate.cashRequiredForFunding.zh-CN: 期末与期间目标需要本金和现金流计划
mandate.cashRequiredForFunding.en-US: Payments and terminal goals require a capital and cash-flow plan

mandate.cashOptionalSimple.zh-CN: 没有期间投入或支付时可不填写本金；最低现金占比仍可单独设置。
mandate.cashOptionalSimple.en-US: If there are no contributions or payments, capital can be omitted. A minimum cash weight can still be set separately.

mandate.capitalHint.zh-CN: 决定可投本金：扣除组合外储备后进入资金模拟，并换算成组合所需现金占比。
mandate.capitalHint.en-US: Sets the investable capital: after the outside reserve it drives the funding simulation and the portfolio's required cash weight.

mandate.cashModelConvention.zh-CN: 金额按名义口径计算；额外费用和通胀默认不另加，模型约定会随结果冻结。
mandate.cashModelConvention.en-US: Amounts use nominal terms; no extra fee or inflation is added by default. Model conventions are frozen with the result.

mandate.cashflowSimpleHint.zh-CN: 只填写真实投入和必要支付；现金底线由系统自动推导。
mandate.cashflowSimpleHint.en-US: Enter only real contributions and required payments. The cash floor is derived automatically.

mandate.studyScaleHint.zh-CN: 只显示研究日当时可用的已发布版本。选定后版本被冻结，本目标的计价币种和 C1–C5 波动上限都由它决定。
mandate.studyScaleHint.en-US: Only versions published and usable on the research date are listed. The chosen version is frozen; it fixes this objective's currency and its C1–C5 volatility caps.

mandate.derivedCurrencyHint.zh-CN: 由风险等级配置带入，本页不重复设置。后续配置研究与现金预算必须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.derivedCurrencyHint.en-US: Inherited from the risk scale and not set again here. Later allocation research and the cash budget must use the same currency; there is no automatic FX conversion.

mandate.loadingStudyScales.zh-CN: 正在读取该研究日可用的风险等级配置…
mandate.loadingStudyScales.en-US: Loading risk scales available on this research date…

mandate.noStudyScales.zh-CN: 这个研究日没有可用的风险等级配置
mandate.noStudyScales.en-US: No risk scale is available on this research date

mandate.noStudyScalesHint.zh-CN: 请先在风险等级配置中心发布适用于该日期的版本，或在 PIT 关闭时调整研究日。
mandate.noStudyScalesHint.en-US: Publish a version applicable to this date in Risk Scale Settings, or change the research date when PIT is off.

mandate.maxRiskLevelHint.zh-CN: 选定后冻结成一个数值波动上限（例如 C3 即该标尺的 C3 上限）。后续 SAA 与 TAA 的组合预期波动一旦超过它就会被拦下。
mandate.maxRiskLevelHint.en-US: The chosen level is frozen into a numeric volatility cap (C3 means the scale's C3 cap). Later SAA and TAA reject any portfolio whose expected volatility exceeds it.

mandate.minCashWeightHint.zh-CN: 与机构要求、现金流推导底线取最严的一个，成为后续 SAA 必须满足的现金下限；只认现金角色资产，股票 ETF 不算。
mandate.minCashWeightHint.en-US: The strictest of this value, any institutional requirement and the cash-flow-derived floor becomes the cash minimum later SAA must satisfy. Only cash-role assets count; an equity ETF does not.

mandate.riskLevelResolved.zh-CN: {{level}} 对应的冻结预期波动上限为 {{cap}}。
mandate.riskLevelResolved.en-US: {{level}} has a frozen expected-volatility cap of {{cap}}.

mandate.fixedBandsHint.zh-CN: C1–C5 始终来自所选风险等级配置。现金约束会改变有效前沿，但不会重新定义风险等级。
mandate.fixedBandsHint.en-US: C1–C5 always come from the selected risk scale. Cash constraints can change the frontier but never redefine the risk bands.

mandate.pitChanged.zh-CN: 研究口径已变化；目标研究日已同步，请重新选择该日期可用的风险等级配置。
mandate.pitChanged.en-US: The research context changed. The objective date was synchronized; choose a risk scale available on that date.

mandate.simpleDiagnosisHint.zh-CN: 系统将使用风险等级配置冻结的 Reference CMA，同时计算原参考前沿和加入当前现金约束后的新前沿。
mandate.simpleDiagnosisHint.en-US: The system uses the risk scale's frozen Reference CMA to compare its original frontier with a new frontier under the current cash constraint.

mandate.fundingDetails.zh-CN: 查看现金流与资金测算明细

mandate.diagnosisEmptySimple.zh-CN: 完成前两步后，点击“运行诊断”查看两条有效前沿和最低所需风险等级。
mandate.diagnosisEmptySimple.en-US: Complete the first two steps, then run the assessment to see both frontiers and the minimum required risk level.

mandate.currentSummaryHint.zh-CN: 本模块只冻结目标、风险等级和现金约束；正式 CMA 与 SAA 在后续步骤完成。
mandate.currentSummaryHint.en-US: This module freezes only the objective, risk level and cash constraints. Formal CMA and SAA are completed later.

mandate.referenceScopeSimple.zh-CN: 结果只使用所选风险等级配置冻结的参考大类和 Reference CMA；正式 CMA 后续会重新形成新的有效前沿。
mandate.referenceScopeSimple.en-US: This result uses only the selected risk scale's frozen reference asset classes and Reference CMA. A later formal CMA will produce a new frontier.

mandate.cashConstraintRule.zh-CN: 最终现金底线取主动要求与现金流推导值的较高者，只由风险标尺中的现金类承担。
mandate.cashConstraintRule.en-US: The effective floor is the higher of the requested reserve and the cash-flow-derived floor, and only the risk scale's cash asset can satisfy it.

mandate.twoFrontiers.zh-CN: 参考前沿与当前约束前沿

mandate.frontierChartDescription.zh-CN: 风险等级配置参考有效前沿与加入当前现金约束后的有效前沿对比，横轴为预期波动，纵轴为预期收益。
mandate.frontierChartDescription.en-US: Comparison of the risk scale reference efficient frontier and the frontier after current cash constraints, with expected volatility on the x-axis and expected return on the y-axis.

mandate.referenceLineMeaning.zh-CN: 虚线：风险等级配置发布时的原始参考前沿
mandate.referenceLineMeaning.en-US: Dashed: original frontier published with the risk scale

mandate.capLineMeaning.zh-CN: 竖线：本次授权上限 {{value}}，右侧灰色区域本次不能选
mandate.capLineMeaning.en-US: Vertical line: this authorization caps volatility at {{value}}; the grey area to its right is not selectable.

mandate.targetLineMeaning.zh-CN: 横线：目标年收益 {{value}}，前沿在竖线左侧穿过它才算可达
mandate.targetLineMeaning.en-US: Horizontal line: the {{value}} annual return target. It is reachable only where the frontier crosses it left of the cap.

mandate.constrainedLineMeaning.zh-CN: 实线：同一 Reference CMA 加入当前现金约束后的新前沿
mandate.constrainedLineMeaning.en-US: Solid: new frontier under current cash constraints using the same Reference CMA

mandate.frontierUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前输入无法形成两条可验证前沿，请查看上方问题后调整。
mandate.frontierUnavailable.en-US: The current inputs cannot produce two verified frontiers. Review the issues above and adjust the inputs.

mandate.currencyHint.zh-CN: 预算、CMA和风险标尺须同币种，不自动换汇。
mandate.currencyHint.en-US: Budget, CMA and risk scale must use the same currency. No automatic FX conversion.

mandate.horizonHint.zh-CN: 决定现金流的模型月数（期限×12）；后续配置研究必须沿用同一期限。1至30年整数，不自动舍入。
mandate.horizonHint.en-US: Sets the cash-flow horizon in model months (years × 12). Later allocation research must reuse the same horizon. Whole years, 1–30, never rounded.

mandate.useCashBudget.zh-CN: 这笔资金有明确本金、投入或支付计划
mandate.useCashBudget.en-US: This mandate has a capital balance, contributions or payment schedule

mandate.cashOptional.zh-CN: 现金预算可选。资金目标必须提供；绝对收益和相对基准目标也可以使用。
mandate.cashOptional.en-US: A cash budget is required for a funding goal and optional for absolute or benchmark-relative objectives.

mandate.cashScope.zh-CN: 只填写本组合的资金。组合外储备不参与本组合收益或支付；切换成功标准不会删除预算。
mandate.cashScope.en-US: Enter this portfolio’s funding only. External reserves do not earn returns or fund its payments. Changing the objective preserves this budget.

mandate.cashAdvancedHint.zh-CN: 默认保持名义金额、无额外费用即可；只有存在组合外储备、实值金额或额外费用时才需要展开调整。
mandate.cashAdvancedHint.en-US: Keep the defaults for nominal amounts and no extra fee. Expand this only for external reserves, real-value amounts, or additional fees.

mandate.outsideReserveHint.zh-CN: 只从总资金扣除一次；组合内现金保障另行计算。
mandate.outsideReserveHint.en-US: Deducted once from total capital. In-portfolio cash protection is calculated separately.

mandate.basisHint.zh-CN: 「按研究日购买力」＝先按年通胀折算成未来名义金额再进模型：期末金额乘 (1+通胀)^年数，现金流各自按发生月折算；「未来名义金额」＝按填写值直接使用。年通胀为0时两者算出来完全一样。
mandate.basisHint.en-US: Research-date purchasing power means the amount is inflated to future nominal money before the model sees it: the terminal amount by (1+π)^years, each flow by its own month. Future nominal uses the number as typed. With zero inflation the two give identical results.

mandate.inflationHint.zh-CN: 只对按购买力填写的现金流或期末目标换算，名义金额不重复加通胀。
mandate.inflationHint.en-US: Applied only to amounts entered in purchasing-power terms. Nominal amounts are not inflated again.

mandate.inflationActive.zh-CN: 按这个通胀，{{years}}年的折算倍数为 {{factor}}：按购买力填写的金额乘上它之后才进模型。
mandate.inflationActive.en-US: At this inflation the {{years}}-year conversion factor is {{factor}}: purchasing-power amounts are multiplied by it before the model sees them.

mandate.feeHint.zh-CN: 0表示未另计费用；净值中已扣除的费用不要重复填写。
mandate.feeHint.en-US: Zero means no additional fee. Do not duplicate fees already embedded in NAV.

mandate.cashflowTiming.zh-CN: 按等长模型月计算：先收益与费用，再月末投入，最后必要支付。同月不模拟逐日结算顺序。
mandate.cashflowTiming.en-US: Equal model months: returns and fees, then month-end contributions and required payments. Intramonth settlement is not modeled.

mandate.noFlows.zh-CN: 暂无期间现金流；可以仅按本金和期末目标测算。
mandate.noFlows.en-US: No intermediate cash flows. A capital balance and terminal goal can still be assessed.

mandate.returnRaisedByCashflow.zh-CN: 现金流要求的年化收益 {{required}} 高于你填的 {{stated}}，后续按 {{required}} 作为收益下限。
mandate.returnRaisedByCashflow.en-US: The cash flows require {{required}} a year, above the {{stated}} you entered; {{required}} becomes the return floor from here.

mandate.cashflowReturnCovered.zh-CN: 现金流要求的年化收益为 {{required}}，不高于你填的预期收益，收益下限按你填的数值。
mandate.cashflowReturnCovered.en-US: The cash flows require {{required}} a year, at or below the return you entered, so your number stays the floor.

mandate.cashflowReturnUnreachable.zh-CN: 现金流的支付要求在 500% 年化以内无解，请调整资金、支付计划或投资期限。
mandate.cashflowReturnUnreachable.en-US: No annual return up to 500% funds these payments; adjust the capital, the payments or the horizon.

mandate.cashflowReturnBasis.zh-CN: 资金计划给出扣费前固定年化复利要求，已计入计划费用；与组合算术收益按实际波动换算比较。
mandate.cashflowReturnBasis.en-US: The plan gives a fixed compound hurdle before fees, with planned fees already included. Comparisons with arithmetic returns account for portfolio risk.

mandate.returnCheckPending.zh-CN: 把上面的目标和资金填完整，这里会给出这套配置真正需要的年收益，并判断所选风险等级够不够。
mandate.returnCheckPending.en-US: Finish the objective and the money above and this states the annual return the configuration actually needs, then checks the chosen level against it.

mandate.returnCheckNotApplicable.zh-CN: 相对基准目标不设算术收益下限：成功口径是相对基准的超额收益，由后续诊断给出。
mandate.returnCheckNotApplicable.en-US: A relative objective carries no arithmetic return floor: its success is the excess over the benchmark, resolved by the diagnosis.

mandate.returnCheckNeedsLevel.zh-CN: 还没选风险等级：先在上面选一个 C1–C5，才能判断够不够。
mandate.returnCheckNeedsLevel.en-US: No risk level chosen yet: pick C1–C5 above before this can say whether it is enough.

mandate.requiredReturnFromTarget.zh-CN: 按填写的目标，需要年收益 {{required}}。
mandate.requiredReturnFromTarget.en-US: The stated objective needs {{required}} a year.

mandate.requiredReturnFromCashflow.zh-CN: 按期初总资金、期间投入支付和期末金额推算，这笔钱需要扣费前年复合收益 {{required}}。
mandate.requiredReturnFromCashflow.en-US: Against the opening capital, the flows and the end balance, this money needs {{required}} a year compounded, gross of model fee.

mandate.levelReachesRequired.zh-CN: 所选 C{{level}} 的参考组合收益 {{reference}}，达到这个要求。
mandate.levelReachesRequired.en-US: The chosen C{{level}} reference portfolio returns {{reference}}, which reaches it.

mandate.lastMonthHint.zh-CN: 由开始月与频率自动推导：按频率支付到投资期限内的最后一次。
mandate.lastMonthHint.en-US: Derived from the first month and frequency: payments run to the last one inside the horizon.

mandate.terminalTargetHint.zh-CN: 这是本目标的成功条件：期末余额达到它的概率须跨过门槛。和左边的总资金、下面的现金流是同一笔账。
mandate.terminalTargetHint.en-US: This is the objective's success condition: the probability of ending at or above it must clear the threshold. Same ledger as the capital beside it and the flows below.

mandate.fundingBridge.zh-CN: 可投资本金 {{capital}} ＋ 期间投入 {{contributions}} － 必要支付 {{withdrawals}} ＝ {{net}}；期末目标 {{target}}。
mandate.fundingBridge.en-US: Investable capital {{capital}} + contributions {{contributions}} − payments {{withdrawals}} = {{net}}; terminal amount {{target}}.

mandate.fundingBridgeGap.zh-CN: 缺口 {{gap}} 必须由投资收益补上。
mandate.fundingBridgeGap.en-US: The {{gap}} gap has to come from investment return.

mandate.fundingBridgeCovered.zh-CN: 现金本身已覆盖期末金额，收益要求来自支付时点而非总额。
mandate.fundingBridgeCovered.en-US: Cash alone already covers the terminal amount; the return requirement comes from payment timing, not the total.

mandate.returnBasisHint.zh-CN: 两种口径含义不同；切换后请重新填写目标。
mandate.returnBasisHint.en-US: The bases have different meanings. Enter the target again after switching.

mandate.returnConversion.zh-CN: 年化 {{annual}} ＝ {{years}} 年总收益 {{total}}。存入目标的是年化值；后续把它当算术年化收益下限使用，与几何口径不同。
mandate.returnConversion.en-US: {{annual}} a year = {{total}} over {{years}} years. The annual figure is what gets stored, and it is used downstream as an arithmetic return floor, which is a different basis from the geometric conversion.

mandate.statedBenchmark.zh-CN: 合同业绩比较基准（原文）

mandate.statedBenchmarkHint.zh-CN: 按合同或 IPS 原样记录，例如「沪深300×60%＋中债综合财富×40%」。只做留痕，不参与计算。
mandate.statedBenchmarkHint.en-US: Record it exactly as the contract or IPS states it, e.g. CSI 300 x 60% + ChinaBond Aggregate x 40%. It is kept as evidence and never enters the calculation.

mandate.statedBenchmarkProxy.zh-CN: 系统按上面的大类权重为这个基准建模：超额收益和跟踪误差都在大类轴上计算，与逐指数口径存在基差。
mandate.statedBenchmarkProxy.en-US: The system models that benchmark with the asset-class weights above: excess return and tracking error are both computed on the class axis, which carries basis risk against the index-by-index reading.

mandate.benchmarkSourceHint.zh-CN: 超额收益和主动风险都相对这个组合计算。权重落在所选风险标尺的大类资产轴上。
mandate.benchmarkSourceHint.en-US: Excess return and active risk are both measured against this portfolio. Weights sit on the asset axis of the selected risk scale.

mandate.benchmarkFromScale.zh-CN: 用所选风险等级的参考组合
mandate.benchmarkFromScale.en-US: Use the reference portfolio of the chosen risk level

mandate.benchmarkCashBasis.zh-CN: 现金资产 · 参考利率 {{rate}}

mandate.benchmarkWeightTotal.en-US: Weights total {{total}}; they must come to 100%.

mandate.terminalFloorHint.zh-CN: 留空＝只保障必要支付，收益按账户可归零推算。填了它，现金流要求的收益按这个期末余额重算，并启用资金成功概率诊断。它是底线，不是目标；若期末金额本身就是你的目标，请把目标类型改成「期末金额与期间支付」。
mandate.terminalFloorHint.en-US: Leave it empty and the plan only has to cover the payments, so the required return assumes the account may end at zero. Fill it in and the cash-flow required return is solved against this balance, and the funding probability diagnosis switches on. It is a floor, not a goal: if the terminal amount is your goal, switch the objective type to Payments and terminal balance.

mandate.successQuestion.zh-CN: 这笔资金以什么为成功标准？
mandate.successQuestion.en-US: What defines success for this mandate?

mandate.returnHint.zh-CN: 后续 SAA 只保留预期收益不低于此值的候选，低于它的组合会被直接拦下。年度算术总收益，不是保底、CAGR或业绩承诺。
mandate.returnHint.en-US: Later SAA keeps only candidates whose expected return is at least this value; anything below is rejected. Annual arithmetic total return, not a guarantee or CAGR.

mandate.fundingSuccess.zh-CN: 所有必要支付均完成，而且期末仍达到约定余额，才算成功。所需复合收益不直接作为CMA算术收益门槛。
mandate.fundingSuccess.en-US: Success requires every necessary payment and the terminal balance. Required compound growth is not substituted for the CMA arithmetic return.

mandate.completeCashFirst.zh-CN: 请返回“资金任务”补齐本金与预算；已填写的成功标准会保留。
mandate.completeCashFirst.en-US: Return to Funding task to complete the capital and budget. These criteria will be retained.

mandate.probabilityHint.zh-CN: 来自明确政策。判断使用模拟区间下界，区间不包含模型误差。
mandate.probabilityHint.en-US: An explicit policy threshold. Assessment uses the simulation interval’s lower bound, which does not cover model error.

mandate.excessReturn.zh-CN: 目标年超额收益（百分点）

mandate.benchmarkTe.zh-CN: 相对基准主动风险上限（%）

mandate.benchmarkTeHint.zh-CN: 这是相对本页基准的风险预算，不是TAA相对SAA的偏离预算。
mandate.benchmarkTeHint.en-US: Risk relative to this benchmark, not TAA deviation from SAA.

mandate.noBenchmarkScope.zh-CN: 尚无可用大类方案，须先构建真实大类后定义可计算基准。
mandate.noBenchmarkScope.en-US: Create an actual asset universe before defining a computable benchmark.

mandate.cashProtectionHint.zh-CN: 收益目标之外，另行核验必要支付；没有金额目标时不编造期末余额。
mandate.cashProtectionHint.en-US: Check payment protection separately from the return objective. Do not invent a terminal target.

mandate.noProtection.zh-CN: 仅资金算账，不定义资金成功率
mandate.noProtection.en-US: Budget arithmetic only; no cash success probability

mandate.paymentsAndFloor.zh-CN: 完成支付并保护期末余额
mandate.paymentsAndFloor.en-US: Payments plus a protected terminal balance

mandate.liquidFloorHint.zh-CN: 这是可变现资产预算；资金保障另用现金角色资产检查，不把股票ETF当作经营现金。
mandate.liquidFloorHint.en-US: A tradable-asset budget. Cash protection separately requires cash-role assets; equity ETFs are not operating cash.

mandate.illiquidCap.zh-CN: 最高非流动性资产占比（%）

mandate.taaTeHint.zh-CN: 0表示只保持SAA；此授权独立于绝对波动上限，不自动推导剩余风险预算。
mandate.taaTeHint.en-US: Zero permits no tactical tilt. This authorization is independent of the absolute volatility cap.

mandate.contributionStress.zh-CN: 压力下可收到的投入比例（%）

mandate.stressHint.zh-CN: 这是压力假设，不是情景发生概率。请依据政策明确填写。
mandate.stressHint.en-US: A stress assumption, not a scenario probability. Enter it from the stated policy.

mandate.boundaryReason.zh-CN: 风险与流动性边界的依据

mandate.preferences.zh-CN: 效用偏好、预警与复核规则
mandate.preferences.en-US: Utility preferences, alerts and review rules

mandate.aversionHint.zh-CN: 仅为效用候选参数，不是风险测评，也不定义C1–C5。
mandate.aversionHint.en-US: A utility-model parameter, not a risk profile or the definition of C1–C5.

mandate.rebalanceNote.zh-CN: 再平衡触发与恢复规则

mandate.riskMode.zh-CN: 怎样确定本次风险上限？
mandate.riskMode.en-US: How should this risk cap be determined?

mandate.riskModeHint.zh-CN: 模型给出参考建议，最高授权始终由人明确确认。
mandate.riskModeHint.en-US: The model offers reference evidence. The maximum authorization must be explicitly confirmed.

mandate.explicitNumeric.zh-CN: 使用有依据的数值授权（高级）

mandate.suggestionNeedsBudget.zh-CN: 资金建议需要先填写现金预算和非空的资金成功条件。
mandate.suggestionNeedsBudget.en-US: A funding recommendation requires a cash budget and a nonempty success condition.

mandate.scaleFreezeHint.zh-CN: 明确选择后冻结版本；全局默认变化不会改写本目标。
mandate.scaleFreezeHint.en-US: The selected version is frozen. Later default changes do not rewrite this mandate.

mandate.referencePending.zh-CN: 暂不引用，保存为参考待补充
mandate.referencePending.en-US: No reference yet; save as pending

mandate.noScales.zh-CN: 没有同币种、同风险口径的已发布标尺。可以先保存输入，不会自动填入风险上限。
mandate.noScales.en-US: No published scale matches this currency and basis. Inputs can be saved without inventing a risk cap.

mandate.openRiskCenter.zh-CN: 前往风险等级配置中心

mandate.chooseDefault.zh-CN: 明确选择当前默认标尺

mandate.authorizationHint.zh-CN: 来自明确授权，不由现金流或模型自动决定。
mandate.authorizationHint.en-US: From explicit authorization, not automatically inferred from cash flows or a model.

mandate.capNotFloor.zh-CN: C3表示不超过C3上限；实际组合可以是C1或C2，不要求主动增加风险。
mandate.capNotFloor.en-US: C3 is an upper limit. An actual C1 or C2 portfolio is permitted; taking more risk is not required.

mandate.portraitNotGuarantee.zh-CN: 参考收益与历史回撤只描述代表组合，不是同档所有组合的保证。
mandate.portraitNotGuarantee.en-US: Reference returns and drawdowns describe representative portfolios, not every portfolio in the band.

mandate.scaleCurrentBlocked.zh-CN: 该版本目前需要复核或已失效；历史结果仍可读取，新研究由服务端核验适用日期。
mandate.scaleCurrentBlocked.en-US: This version requires review or is no longer current. Historical evidence remains readable; the server checks research-date eligibility.

mandate.scaleLoadFailed.zh-CN: 风险标尺读取失败，请重试；不会用默认值补齐。
mandate.scaleLoadFailed.en-US: Risk scale loading failed. Retry; no substitute values will be used.

mandate.policyHint.zh-CN: 记录已明确的政策及来源，不使用隐藏的成功概率或现金窗口默认值。这里只确认研究政策，不代替外部审批。
mandate.policyHint.en-US: Record the explicit policy and its source. No hidden probability or cash-window defaults are used. This is not external approval.

mandate.cashRoleHint.zh-CN: 最终取此值、机构现金要求和资金推导底线的更严值；只认现金角色资产。
mandate.cashRoleHint.en-US: The effective floor is the stricter of this value, institutional requirements and funding needs. Only cash-role assets qualify.

mandate.confirmPolicy.zh-CN: 我已核对政策来源和参数；这些数值是明确要求，不是模型自动推断。
mandate.confirmPolicy.en-US: I have checked the policy source and parameters. These are explicit requirements, not model-inferred preferences.

mandate.referenceDiagnosis.zh-CN: 全局参考诊断与风险建议
mandate.referenceDiagnosis.en-US: Global reference assessment and risk recommendation

mandate.referenceScopeHint.zh-CN: 此处使用冻结全局参考。实际资产和CMA形成后，SAA仍须重新核验，不能继承此成功率。
mandate.referenceScopeHint.en-US: This uses the frozen global reference. SAA must recheck the actual assets and CMA; this success rate is not inherited.

mandate.capitalAdjustment.zh-CN: 查看固定候选下的本金调整
mandate.capitalAdjustment.en-US: Inspect capital adjustment for this fixed candidate

mandate.capitalAdjustmentHint.zh-CN: 金额已按同一路径、同一门槛回灌核验。改变本金后需建立新研究，重新计算现金预算和候选，不自动修改原目标。
mandate.capitalAdjustmentHint.en-US: Amounts are replay-checked on the same paths and gate. Changing capital requires a new study and new cash/candidate checks; the mandate is not edited automatically.

mandate.capitalDiagnosticOnly.zh-CN: 这只是已授权范围内一个固定候选的调整测算，不是通过验证的配置建议；原目标和风险授权未改变。
mandate.capitalDiagnosticOnly.en-US: This is an adjustment estimate for one fixed, authorized candidate, not a validated allocation recommendation. The original goal and authorization are unchanged.

mandate.capitalUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前路径数不足以支持该门槛的资本估计，不提供虚假金额。
mandate.capitalUnavailable.en-US: The current path count cannot support a capital estimate at this gate. No artificial amount is shown.

mandate.searchValidationEvidence.zh-CN: 搜索种子 {{search}}；独立验证种子 {{validation}}；每组 {{paths}} 条路径。验证失败不重选候选。
mandate.searchValidationEvidence.en-US: Search seed {{search}}; independent-validation seed {{validation}}; {{paths}} paths per stream. Failed validation does not trigger reselection.

mandate.clockUnknown.zh-CN: 平台知识截止日尚未确认，请先恢复 PIT 设置；草稿保留，暂不能诊断或保存。
mandate.clockUnknown.en-US: The research cutoff is unknown. Restore PIT settings before assessment or confirmation. Your draft is retained.

mandate.cmaMismatch.zh-CN: 已选CMA不在当前日期、币种及大类范围内，请重新选择或明确取消。
mandate.cmaMismatch.en-US: The CMA does not match the date, currency or universe. Reselect or explicitly remove it.

mandate.savedClockChanged.zh-CN: 知识截止日已变化；当前只读版本仍显示保存时的诊断，不代表新截止日下可用。复制为新研究后须重新核对。
mandate.savedClockChanged.en-US: The cutoff changed. The read-only version retains its original assessment, not current eligibility. Copy it into a new study to reassess.

mandate.clockChanged.zh-CN: 知识截止日已变化，请重新核对输入并运行诊断。
mandate.clockChanged.en-US: The cutoff changed. Review the inputs and run a new assessment.

mandate.inputChanged.zh-CN: 输入已更新，请重新运行诊断。
mandate.inputChanged.en-US: Inputs changed. Run the assessment again.

mandate.savedNotice.zh-CN: 已保存不可变目标版本；授权来源、诊断状态和模型依据一并保留。
mandate.savedNotice.en-US: An immutable mandate version was saved with authorization sources, assessment status and model evidence.

mandate.readingSaved.zh-CN: 正在查看已保存版本，输入只读；复制为新研究后才能修改。
mandate.readingSaved.en-US: Viewing a saved, read-only version. Copy it into a new study to edit.

mandate.copiedNotice.zh-CN: 已复制输入，原版本未改变；请核对研究日期后重新诊断。
mandate.copiedNotice.en-US: Inputs copied; the original version is unchanged. Check the date and reassess.

mandate.openSaa.zh-CN: 使用此目标进入长期配置 →

mandate.institutionContext.zh-CN: 机构背景与人工核验（可选）

mandate.assetAuthorizations.zh-CN: 指定资产与分组授权（高级）

mandate.diagnosisHint.zh-CN: 先按冻结风险标尺做全局参考诊断。有匹配的实际CMA时，也可在下方选择；两类结果不会混为一种证明。
mandate.diagnosisHint.en-US: Assess the frozen global reference first. An available actual CMA can also be selected below; the two evidence scopes remain separate.

mandate.actualCma.zh-CN: 另选实际CMA进行诊断（可选）
mandate.actualCma.en-US: Assess an actual CMA as well (optional)

mandate.cmaHint.zh-CN: 只列出匹配日期、币种和范围的版本，不使用未来假设。
mandate.cmaHint.en-US: Only matching dates, currencies and universes are listed. Future assumptions are excluded.

mandate.noMatchingCma.zh-CN: 暂无匹配CMA。可使用全局参考，或先保存输入后建立长期假设，不会用示例数据补成功概率。
mandate.noMatchingCma.en-US: No matching CMA. Use the global reference, or save inputs and build assumptions later. No example probabilities are substituted.

mandate.simulationSettings.zh-CN: 模拟与不确定性设置（高级）

mandate.uncertaintyPenalty.zh-CN: 均值不确定性惩罚倍数

mandate.computingHint.zh-CN: 正在按当前输入计算；尚无完成结果，不显示预测数值。
mandate.computingHint.en-US: Calculating from the current inputs. No estimated results are shown before completion.

mandate.diagnosisEmpty.zh-CN: 运行后在这里查看资金要求、约束冲突和风险建议。
mandate.diagnosisEmpty.en-US: Run the assessment to see funding needs, constraint conflicts and risk recommendations.

mandate.confirmationTitle.zh-CN: 确认的是目标与边界，不是收益承诺
mandate.confirmationTitle.en-US: Confirm objectives and boundaries, not a return promise

mandate.pendingAuthorization.zh-CN: 风险授权待补齐，不可进入SAA采纳
mandate.pendingAuthorization.en-US: Risk authorization pending; SAA adoption is unavailable

mandate.reviewOnly.zh-CN: 这里只记录政策与复核约定，不自动交易，不代替外部审批。
mandate.reviewOnly.en-US: This records policy and review terms only. It neither trades automatically nor replaces external approval.

mandate.saveIsNotPass.zh-CN: 此次保存仅固定输入和当前诊断状态。SAA仍须实际计算并满足目标，不能凭已保存绕过检查。
mandate.saveIsNotPass.en-US: Saving freezes inputs and the current assessment status. SAA must still meet its actual checks; a saved record is not a pass.

mandate.historicalReviewDue.zh-CN: 这是已过复核日的历史目标，可以保存研究，但不能直接用于当前应用。
mandate.historicalReviewDue.en-US: This historical mandate is past its review date. It can be saved for research, not applied directly today.

mandate.finalAcknowledgement.zh-CN: 我已核对输入、最终授权上限、诊断状态和模型限制；此确认不是外部审批或收益保证。
mandate.finalAcknowledgement.en-US: I have checked the inputs, final cap, assessment status and model limitations. This is not external approval or a return guarantee.

mandate.acknowledgementHint.zh-CN: 核对后勾选确认，服务端将重新计算并检查输入是否变化。
mandate.acknowledgementHint.en-US: Acknowledge after reviewing. The server recalculates and checks for changed inputs.

mandate.journeyHint.zh-CN: 资金任务 → 成功标准 → 风险预算 → 诊断 → 确认。已有成果可以直接选择，旧版本保持只读。
mandate.journeyHint.en-US: Funding → success criteria → risk budgets → assessment → confirmation. Reuse existing results; saved versions remain read-only.

mandate.noVersions.zh-CN: 尚无版本；完成诊断后可保存输入和结果。
mandate.noVersions.en-US: No saved versions. Assess the inputs before confirming a version.

mandate.catalogUnavailable.zh-CN: 目录不可用时仍可填写目标；读取失败不代表不存在历史版本。
mandate.catalogUnavailable.en-US: You can keep editing while the catalog is unavailable. A loading error does not mean no historical versions exist.

mandate.cashRollRequired.zh-CN: 现金预算仍以 {{from}} 为基准，当前研究日为 {{to}}。请核对并更新本金、储备和未来现金流；确认后，现金流月份才改以新研究日起算。确认前不能诊断或保存。
mandate.cashRollRequired.en-US: The cash budget is still dated {{from}}, while the research date is {{to}}. Review and update capital, reserves and future cash flows. Confirmation rebases the flow months to the new research date. Diagnosis and saving remain blocked until confirmed.

mandate.confirmCashRoll.zh-CN: 我已核对资金和现金流，确认按新研究日使用
mandate.confirmCashRoll.en-US: I reviewed capital and cash flows; use the new research date

landing.heroDescription1.zh-CN: 一站式基金量化投研平台。

landing.heroDescription2.zh-CN: 从研究到实践，连接数据、算法与投资决策。
landing.heroDescription2.en-US: Bring data, algorithms, and investment decisions together.

landing.workflowDescription.zh-CN: 从研究到实践，让每一步投资决策都有据可依。
landing.workflowDescription.en-US: Give every investment decision a foundation in research.

landing.workflowNote.zh-CN: 产品研究持续进行，投资结果反馈给研究与模型；组合登记和会计核算贯穿投中与投后。
landing.workflowNote.en-US: Research is ongoing. Outcomes feed back into models; portfolio registration and accounting support execution and review.

landing.coreDescription.zh-CN: 把工具交给平台，把精力留给研究。
landing.coreDescription.en-US: Less time managing tools. More time exploring ideas.

landing.quoteLine2.zh-CN: 始于经得起验证的研究。
landing.quoteLine2.en-US: with research that stands up to scrutiny.

landing.dataDescription1.zh-CN: 整合多源数据，沉淀统一的研究序列。
landing.dataDescription1.en-US: Bring multiple sources into a shared research language.

landing.dataDescription2.zh-CN: 从一条净值曲线，开始你的下一次发现。
landing.dataDescription2.en-US: Your next discovery can start with a single time series.

landing.calloutAlpha.en-US: Turn data into a research process

landing.quickDescription.zh-CN: 少一点寻找，多一点专注。

landing.footerStatus.zh-CN: 研究示例非投资建议 · 不提供下单
landing.footerStatus.en-US: Research examples, not investment advice · No order placement

landing.searchScope.zh-CN: 搜索已有功能入口，不检索产品数据或执行计算。
landing.searchScope.en-US: Search existing feature destinations, not product data or calculations.

landing.historyHelp.zh-CN: 访问模块后，返回首页可从这里继续。
landing.historyHelp.en-US: Visit a module, then return here to continue.

landing.storageFailed.zh-CN: 无法清除浏览器访问记录，请检查浏览器存储设置。
landing.storageFailed.en-US: Could not clear visits. Check browser storage settings.

landing.tourTitle.zh-CN: 让研究与投资流程连接起来

landing.aboutTitle.zh-CN: 以研究为中心的工作台

landing.aboutBody.zh-CN: 产品研究持续沉淀可复用的产品池；投前形成研究方案；真实组合承接投中与投后；数据、指标和情景算法提供共同的研究基础。
landing.aboutBody.en-US: Product research builds reusable product pools. Allocation research produces proposals. Registered portfolios connect execution with review, supported by data, indicators and scenario algorithms.

landing.aboutNote.zh-CN: 本页入口连接现有业务模块。各模块以其实际能力和数据状态为准；不提供自动下单，也不承诺投资收益。
landing.aboutNote.en-US: Links open existing workspaces. Capabilities and data availability are stated within each module. No automatic orders or promised investment returns.

landing.helpBody.zh-CN: 点击流程卡或精选功能进入工作台；用顶部搜索或 Command / Ctrl + K 查找入口。平台导览说明研究、配置与复盘之间的关系。
landing.helpBody.en-US: Open a workflow stage or shortcut. Search from the header or press Command / Ctrl + K. The tour explains how research, allocation and review connect.

landing.helpNote.zh-CN: 研究示例只说明研究方向，不是假造的运行结果。最近访问记录仅保存在当前浏览器，可单独清空；不会删除任何研究数据。
landing.helpNote.en-US: Examples describe research ideas, not fabricated results. Visits are stored only in this browser; clearing them never deletes research data.

landing.workspaceBody.zh-CN: K 是界面标识，不代表已登录账户。首页不创建身份、账户或交易，也不会触发数据下载或指标计算。
landing.workspaceBody.en-US: K is a visual identifier, not an authenticated account. The homepage creates no identity, accounts or trades and starts no downloads or calculations.

landing.workspaceNote.zh-CN: 语言沿用系统语言设置；最近打开只记录访问过的功能模块，不保存产品编号、查询条件或研究内容。
landing.workspaceNote.en-US: Language follows the application settings. Recent visits store only module identifiers, never product IDs, query parameters or research content.

landing.exampleNotice.zh-CN: 此内容为研究方向示例，不是已完成的研究结果，也不是投资建议。
landing.exampleNotice.en-US: This is a research idea, not a completed result or investment recommendation.

landing.example.regime.zh-CN: 沪深 300 历史情景识别

landing.exampleBody.regime.zh-CN: 可在情景算法工作台选择实际可用的指数研究序列，定义市场状态并校验历史区间。打开入口不会自动选择数据或计算。
landing.exampleBody.regime.en-US: Choose an available index series in the scenario workbench, define market states and validate historical periods. Opening it does not select data or run calculations.

landing.exampleBody.evaluation.zh-CN: 可在产品评价与分类工作台选择真实产品和版本化指标方案，开展比较与评价。示例未预先创建模型或评价结果。
landing.exampleBody.evaluation.en-US: Choose real products and a versioned indicator plan in the evaluation workspace. This example creates no model or evaluation result.

landing.exampleBody.allocation.zh-CN: 可从战略资产配置入口建立大类资产，研究目标权重、风险预算与回测表现。研究方案与真实组合持仓严格区分。
landing.exampleBody.allocation.en-US: Build asset classes and explore weights, risk budgets and backtests. Research proposals remain distinct from actual portfolio holdings.

landing.tour.0.title.zh-CN: 先理解产品，再形成判断。
landing.tour.0.title.en-US: Understand the product. Form a view.

landing.tour.0.body.zh-CN: 从产品研究与评价出发，沉淀可复用的产品池。数据、指标和情景算法为每个研究问题提供共同基础。
landing.tour.0.body.en-US: Start with product research and evaluation. Build reusable product pools supported by shared data, indicators and scenario algorithms.

landing.tour.1.title.en-US: Put allocation hypotheses to the test.

landing.tour.1.body.zh-CN: 围绕投资目标组织 SAA、TAA 与产品配置研究，再进行回测和风险检查。研究方案不等于真实持仓。
landing.tour.1.body.en-US: Explore strategic, tactical and within-class allocation. Validate with backtests and risk checks. A research proposal is not an actual holding.

landing.tour.2.body.zh-CN: 组合中心登记真实组合，衔接投中、基金会计与投后，最后把结论反馈给研究。部分环节为静态功能演示，以工作台提示为准。
landing.tour.2.body.en-US: The portfolio center registers actual portfolios and connects execution, accounting and review. Feed conclusions back into research. Some stages are static demonstrations, as marked in their workspaces.

landing.summary.products.zh-CN:
多维数据研究
深度分析基金产品
landing.summary.products.en-US:
Research the data.
Understand each fund.

landing.summary.decision.zh-CN:
组合构建与方案研究
验证你的配置假设
landing.summary.decision.en-US:
Build a portfolio.
Test allocation hypotheses.

landing.summary.portfolio.zh-CN:
真实组合登记
账户与目标版本
landing.summary.portfolio.en-US:
Register portfolios.
Link accounts and targets.

landing.summary.execution.zh-CN:
交易计划与事实核对
监控与跟踪
landing.summary.execution.en-US:
Plan and reconcile.
Monitor and follow up.

landing.summary.post.zh-CN:
业绩归因与风险分析
持续监控与评估
landing.summary.post.en-US:
Explain performance.
Review risk and exposure.

landing.summary.feedback.zh-CN:
策略复盘与优化
形成持续迭代闭环
landing.summary.feedback.en-US:
Review and refine.
Close the learning loop.

landing.summary.data.zh-CN:
多源数据接入
