rollingScope.intro.zh-CN: 选择一个区间指标，设置窗口，系统每天对最近一段数据重新计算。
rollingScope.intro.en-US: Choose an interval metric and a window. Recalculate the entire metric at each date.

rollingScope.summary.zh-CN: 对最近 {{window}} 个{{unit}}逐日计算“{{name}}”。
rollingScope.summary.en-US: Calculate {{name}} over the latest {{window}} {{unit}} at each date.

rollingScope.invalidWindow.zh-CN: 请输入 1 至 5000 的整数窗口。
rollingScope.invalidWindow.en-US: Enter an integer window from 1 to 5000.

rollingScope.ruleText.zh-CN: 每个窗口独立执行完整计算图。默认要求完整有效窗口；已设置最少有效观察数的指标按其计算图处理缺失，不补零、不改变日期位置、不读取未来数据。
rollingScope.ruleText.en-US: Recompute the interval graph in each window. Complete valid windows are required by default; explicit minimum-count definitions handle missing data in their graph, without filling, date compression or future data.

rollingScope.parameters.zh-CN: 生成后可在“计算参数”中开放窗口调整；在其他页面修改只影响本次计算。
rollingScope.parameters.en-US: After generation, expose the window in Calculation parameters. Overrides affect only the current run.

rollingScope.supported.zh-CN: 支持滚动计算 · 每个窗口独立重算完整指标
rollingScope.supported.en-US: Rolling supported: recompute the entire metric in each window

rollingScope.unknown.zh-CN: 尚未确认区间聚合能力，请先保存并校验指标。
rollingScope.unknown.en-US: Interval capability is not confirmed. Save and validate the metric first.

rollingScope.graphHint.zh-CN: 滚动计算连接的是可执行的区间计算图，不是已算好的全样本标量；上游计算内容会在每个窗口内重新运行。
rollingScope.graphHint.en-US: A rolling node receives an executable interval graph, not a precomputed full-sample value. Its body runs independently inside each window.

outputAuthoring.locked.zh-CN: 请等待当前操作完成，并应用画布改动后再编辑结果。
outputAuthoring.locked.en-US: Finish the current operation and apply graph changes before editing outputs.

indicatorParameters.editorHint.zh-CN: 先完成公式或应用画布，再识别可调输入。未开放的输入保持固定；同值常量不会自动合并。
indicatorParameters.editorHint.en-US: Complete the formula or apply the canvas, then inspect eligible inputs. Unopened inputs stay fixed; equal constants are not automatically linked.

indicatorParameters.showUsage.zh-CN: 查看公式中的使用位置

indicatorParameters.noCandidates.zh-CN: 没有其他可开放的输入。数据输入和公式结构常量保持固定。
indicatorParameters.noCandidates.en-US: No other eligible inputs. Data inputs and structural constants stay fixed.

indicatorParameters.confirmFix.zh-CN: 将“{{name}}”的全部引用固定为默认值？保存指标后生效，历史版本不变。
indicatorParameters.confirmFix.en-US: Fix all references to “{{name}}” at its default? This takes effect after saving; historical revisions stay unchanged.

indicatorParameters.pending.zh-CN: 参数设置尚未应用，请先应用再校验或保存指标。
indicatorParameters.pending.en-US: Apply these parameter settings before validating or saving the indicator.

indicatorParameters.definitionError.zh-CN: 请填写名称及合法数值；默认值必须在范围内并符合类型、步长，步长必须大于 0。
indicatorParameters.definitionError.en-US: Enter a name and valid values. The default must match the range, type and step; step must be positive.

indicatorParameters.requestError.zh-CN: 参数操作失败，请检查公式后重试。
indicatorParameters.requestError.en-US: Parameter operation failed. Check the formula and retry.

indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.zh-CN: 请先完成当前操作并应用画布，再设置参数。
indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.en-US: Complete the current operation and apply the canvas before editing parameters.

indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.zh-CN: 调整参数只影响本次查看，不会改动指标定义。
indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.en-US: Adjusting parameters affects this view only; the saved indicator is unchanged.

indicatorParameters.unapplied.zh-CN: 参数已修改，点击“应用参数”后重算。
indicatorParameters.unapplied.en-US: Parameters edited. Choose Apply parameters to recalculate.

indicatorParameters.error.required.zh-CN: 请输入参数值，不能留空。
indicatorParameters.error.required.en-US: Enter a value; this field cannot be empty.

indicatorParameters.error.integer.en-US: This parameter must be an integer.

indicatorParameters.error.range.en-US: The value is outside the allowed range.

indicatorParameters.error.step.zh-CN: 请从最小值起按指定步长取值。
indicatorParameters.error.step.en-US: Use the specified step starting at the minimum.

indicatorParameters.parameterNode.zh-CN: 可变参数：{{code}}。默认值和范围在计算参数面板设置。
indicatorParameters.parameterNode.en-US: Adjustable parameter: {{code}}. Edit its default and range in Calculation parameters.

indicatorParameters.connectionError.zh-CN: 可变参数只能连接系统允许的算子参数位置。
indicatorParameters.connectionError.en-US: Adjustable parameters can connect only to eligible operator inputs.

indicatorParameters.fixedHint.zh-CN: 此版本未开放可变参数，按固定公式计算。
indicatorParameters.fixedHint.en-US: This revision has no adjustable parameters and uses its fixed formula.

i18n.matrix.finishCell.zh-CN: 正在编辑单元格：按 Enter 确认或 Esc 取消后，再保存或切换页面。
i18n.matrix.finishCell.en-US: Editing a cell: press Enter to commit or Esc to cancel before saving or changing views.

i18n.matrix.batchLimit.zh-CN: 单次最多修改 1000 个单元格，请先保存当前修改。此次粘贴未应用。
i18n.matrix.batchLimit.en-US: Edit up to 1,000 cells per batch. Save the current changes first. This paste was not applied.

i18n.matrix.hint.zh-CN: 第一列是稳定代码，每列是一种语言。双击或按 Enter 编辑；方向键移动，Shift＋点击选择区域，可粘贴 Excel 矩形区域。修改后统一保存。
i18n.matrix.hint.en-US: Stable codes stay in the first column. Double-click or press Enter to edit. Use arrows to navigate, Shift+click to select, and paste rectangular Excel ranges. Save changes together.

i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；缺少内置译文时明确显示回退内容，不把回退值记为已翻译。
i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Missing translations show a fallback preview, not a completed translation.

i18n.matrix.editHint.zh-CN: Enter 确认，Shift＋Enter 换行，Esc 取消本次编辑。清空译文恢复默认。
i18n.matrix.editHint.en-US: Enter commits, Shift+Enter inserts a line, Esc cancels this edit. Clear text to restore the default.

i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.zh-CN: 粘贴区域无效或超过当前页/语言列范围，未应用任何修改。请只复制译文区域，不要包含表头或系统代码。
i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.en-US: Invalid paste or range exceeds this page/language columns. Nothing changed. Copy translation cells only, without headers or system codes.

i18n.matrix.invalidCell.zh-CN: 译文超长、含不允许内容或占位符不匹配；未应用修改。
i18n.matrix.invalidCell.en-US: Translation is too long, contains disallowed content or has mismatched placeholders. No changes applied.

i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.zh-CN: 语言列已保存，现有译文和计算定义不变。
i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.en-US: Language columns saved. Existing translations and calculations are unchanged.

i18n.matrix.languageExample.en-US: For example ja-JP, fr-FR or zh-Hant-TW

i18n.matrix.addHint.zh-CN: 新增的是业务译文列，不会自动翻译。没有系统语言包时，菜单使用所选内置回退语言。语言代码保存后不可改名或删除，可停用并保留译文。
i18n.matrix.addHint.en-US: A new business translation column is not automatic translation. Menus use the selected built-in fallback when no system pack exists. Saved codes cannot be renamed or deleted; disable to retain translations.

i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.zh-CN: 请填写有效且不重复的语言代码和名称。最多 24 种语言。
i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.en-US: Enter a valid unique language code and name. Up to 24 languages.

i18n.matrix.saveFirst.zh-CN: 请先保存或取消译文草稿，再修改语言列。
i18n.matrix.saveFirst.en-US: Save or discard translation drafts before managing language columns.

i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.zh-CN: 其他分类或页面中仍有未保存的译文。
i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.en-US: Other categories or pages contain unsaved translations.

errors.I18N_DUPLICATE_LOCALE.en-US: This language code is already registered.

errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.zh-CN: 内置语言不能修改或停用。
errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.en-US: Built-in languages cannot be changed or disabled.

errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.zh-CN: 请先更换工作区默认语言，再停用该语言。
errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.en-US: Change the workspace default before disabling this language.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.zh-CN: 请先添加对应语言列，再填写或导入译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.en-US: Add the language column before editing or importing translations.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.zh-CN: 语言不能删除，可停用并保留译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.en-US: Languages cannot be deleted. Disable them to retain translations.

i18n.refreshReview.zh-CN: 已刷新当前译文，未保存修改已保留。请检查修改预览后再保存。
i18n.refreshReview.en-US: Translations refreshed. Your unsaved changes are preserved. Review the preview before saving.

navigation.directoryHint.zh-CN: 选择一个流程节点进入对应工作区。已有能力直接复用，静态演示节点使用预置示例数据呈现未来功能与交互边界。
navigation.directoryHint.en-US: Choose a workflow step to open its workspace. Available features are operational; prototype steps illustrate planned functionality using sample data.

graph.restoreHint.zh-CN: 不会用旧公式覆盖当前输入。可返回高级公式模式修复，或重新构建。
graph.restoreHint.en-US: Your current input will not be replaced by an older formula. Fix it in the formula editor, or start again.

graph.messages.changed.zh-CN: 画布已修改。检查并应用后，才能保存或预览新计算。
graph.messages.changed.en-US: Graph changed. Check and apply it before saving or previewing the new calculation.

graph.messages.restoring.zh-CN: 正在从当前公式还原画布…
graph.messages.restoring.en-US: Restoring the graph from the current formula…

graph.messages.restoreFailed.zh-CN: 当前公式暂不能还原。可以返回公式模式修复，或从空白画布重新构建。
graph.messages.restoreFailed.en-US: This formula cannot be restored as a graph. Fix it in the formula editor or start with an empty graph.

graph.messages.ready.zh-CN: 从左到右：输入数据 → 计算步骤 → 最终输出。点击任一步骤即可修改。
graph.messages.ready.en-US: Read left to right: inputs → calculation steps → final outputs. Click any step to edit it.

graph.messages.incomplete.zh-CN: 请先补全标记的输入与输出。
graph.messages.incomplete.en-US: Complete the marked inputs and outputs first.

graph.messages.invalid.zh-CN: 画布未通过检查。点击问题可定位需要修改的步骤。
graph.messages.invalid.en-US: Graph validation failed. Select an issue to locate the affected step.

graph.messages.applied.zh-CN: 画布已应用到指标草稿。保存指标或前往“校验与预览”运行真实计算。
graph.messages.applied.en-US: Graph applied to the indicator draft. Save the indicator or open Validation and preview to calculate.

graph.messages.valid.zh-CN: 结构与类型检查通过；尚未编译或执行数值计算。
graph.messages.valid.en-US: Structure and types are valid. No numerical compilation or calculation has been performed.

graph.messages.layoutSaved.zh-CN: 画布布局已保存，指标版本和计算结果不变。
graph.messages.layoutSaved.en-US: Layout saved. The indicator revision and calculation results are unchanged.

graph.messages.blank.zh-CN: 空白画布：先添加数据和算子，再连接到最终输出。
graph.messages.blank.en-US: Empty graph: add data and operators, then connect the final output.

graph.selectInput.en-US: Choose an upstream step or constant

graph.outputIdentifierHint.zh-CN: 字母或下划线开头，可含数字；用于区分输出通道。
graph.outputIdentifierHint.en-US: Start with a letter or underscore; digits are allowed. Identifies the output channel.

graph.outputIdentifierError.zh-CN: 通道标识不能重复，只能使用字母、数字或下划线，且不能以数字开头。
graph.outputIdentifierError.en-US: Use a unique channel identifier containing letters, digits and underscores; it must not start with a digit.

graph.outputPlacementHint.zh-CN: 图表位置由使用指标的研究页面决定，此处只定义计算和数值展示。
graph.outputPlacementHint.en-US: The research page decides where charts appear. This editor defines calculations and number presentation only.

graph.selectStep.zh-CN: 点击画布中的步骤或输出，查看输入、设置常量及选择上游。
graph.selectStep.en-US: Select a step or output to inspect inputs, configure constants and choose upstream steps.

graph.sharedHint.zh-CN: 这个步骤被 {{count}} 处引用。修改会影响所有下游；只改一条分支时，请复制步骤后重新连接。
graph.sharedHint.en-US: This step has {{count}} references. Editing affects all consumers. Duplicate and reconnect it to change only one branch.

graph.booleanHint.zh-CN: 判断值（选中为“是”，未选中为“否”）

graph.deleteHint.zh-CN: 删除会断开下游输入，可通过“撤销”恢复。
graph.deleteHint.en-US: Deleting disconnects downstream inputs. Undo restores them.

graph.constantHint.zh-CN: 固定数值写入指标版本，不随运行条件变化。
graph.constantHint.en-US: The constant is fixed in the indicator revision and does not vary with execution context.

graph.saveDefinitionFirst.zh-CN: 计算已修改，请先保存指标。
graph.saveDefinitionFirst.en-US: The calculation changed. Save the indicator first.

graph.layoutOnly.zh-CN: 只保存布局，不增加指标版本。
graph.layoutOnly.en-US: Save layout only, without creating an indicator revision.

graph.defaultInstructions.zh-CN: 点击节点编辑参数；拖动端口连接依赖。
graph.defaultInstructions.en-US: Click a node to edit its parameters; drag ports to connect dependencies.

graph.emptyHint.zh-CN: 从节点库添加节点，或载入一个可修改的流程。
graph.emptyHint.en-US: Add nodes from the library or load an editable workflow.

graph.constantSync.zh-CN: 这里修改的是相连的常量节点，画布与参数同步更新。
graph.constantSync.en-US: This edits the connected constant node. The graph and parameter update together.

graph.sharedConstant.zh-CN: 此常量被 {{count}} 处引用，修改会同步影响这些输入。
graph.sharedConstant.en-US: This constant is referenced {{count}} times; editing it changes all those inputs.

app.home.zh-CN: 基金量化投研平台主页

navigation.viewAll.zh-CN: 查看本阶段全部流程节点
navigation.viewAll.en-US: View all steps in this stage

navigation.journeyBlockedMandate.zh-CN: 先选定投资目标与约束

navigation.journeyHandoff.zh-CN: 从 TAA 保存页交接
navigation.journeyHandoff.en-US: Hand off from the saved TAA page

navigation.resumeHint.zh-CN: 本页只按地址栏显示，地址栏没带的一律按未选择处理。
navigation.resumeHint.en-US: This page reads the address bar only; anything missing there counts as unselected.

navigation.searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 输入功能、阶段或路径名称

navigation.searchEmpty.zh-CN: 没有匹配的功能。换一个关键词，或用顶部主导航按阶段查找。
navigation.searchEmpty.en-US: No match. Try another keyword, or browse by stage in the top navigation.

navigation.searchHint.zh-CN: ↑↓ 选择 · Enter 打开 · Esc 关闭
navigation.searchHint.en-US: Arrow keys to move, Enter to open, Esc to close

common.page.zh-CN: 第 {{page}} / {{pages}} 页 · 共 {{total}} 项

common.unsavedConfirm.zh-CN: 当前有未保存修改，放弃修改并继续？

i18n.description.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；业务术语可以自定义。显示名称变化不会修改公式、内部标识或计算结果。
i18n.description.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Business terminology can be customized without changing formulas, identifiers or results.

i18n.browserHint.zh-CN: 只影响当前浏览器，不改变币种、时区、计算精度或其他人的语言偏好。
i18n.browserHint.en-US: Affects this browser only, not currency, time zone, calculation precision or another user's preference.

i18n.defaultHint.zh-CN: 影响尚未单独设置语言的浏览器。业务翻译在当前工作区共享；本系统尚无独立的翻译管理员角色。
i18n.defaultHint.en-US: Applies to browsers without a language preference. Business translations are shared in this workspace; there is no separate translation administrator role.

i18n.defaultSaved.zh-CN: 工作区默认语言已保存。

i18n.systemHint.zh-CN: 菜单、按钮和系统提示由内置语言包维护。此表没有修改入口；业务导入和接口也不能覆盖这里的词条。
i18n.systemHint.en-US: Menus, buttons and system messages are maintained in built-in packs. These entries cannot be changed through business imports or APIs.

i18n.businessHint.zh-CN: 这里只修改业务名称和说明。指标名称、步骤备注等用户原始内容不会自动翻译。清空自定义值后保存即可恢复默认。
i18n.businessHint.en-US: Edit business names and descriptions only. User-authored indicator names and notes are not translated. Clear an override and save to restore the default.

i18n.matrix.searchHint.zh-CN: 搜索系统代码或任意语言译文
i18n.matrix.searchHint.en-US: Search system code or any language translation

i18n.importHint.zh-CN: 只合并列出的业务词条，不删除文件中未提及的覆盖；空值表示恢复默认。系统词条禁止导入。
i18n.importHint.en-US: Merges the listed business entries only; unlisted overrides are kept. A null value resets an entry. System entries cannot be imported.

i18n.invalidFile.zh-CN: 文件不是有效的业务翻译包，或超过 1 MB。
i18n.invalidFile.en-US: The file is not a valid business translation pack, or exceeds 1 MB.

i18n.restoreConfirm.zh-CN: 将业务翻译恢复到修订 {{revision}}？这会创建一个新修订，不改变系统翻译和语言偏好。
i18n.restoreConfirm.en-US: Restore business translations to revision {{revision}}? This creates a new revision and does not change system translations or language preferences.

i18n.historyHint.zh-CN: 保留最近 50 个业务修订，恢复历史会产生新修订。
i18n.historyHint.en-US: The most recent 50 business revisions are retained. Restoring creates a new revision.

i18n.offline.zh-CN: 翻译服务暂不可用，正在使用当前可用词条。共享修改需恢复连接后保存。
i18n.offline.en-US: Translation service is unavailable. Currently loaded entries remain usable. Reconnect to save shared changes.

i18n.conflict.zh-CN: 翻译已被其他操作更新。你的草稿已保留；请刷新词条并核对后再保存。
i18n.conflict.en-US: Translations were updated elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; refresh and review before saving.

i18n.coverage.zh-CN: 已登记词条：{{total}}；本语言缺失：{{missing}}。此统计不代表所有旧页面已迁移。
i18n.coverage.en-US: Registered entries: {{total}}; missing in this language: {{missing}}. This does not imply all legacy pages have been migrated.

i18n.scopeWarning.zh-CN: 菜单、语言设置和已接入的业务标签支持即时切换。未迁移的旧页面文案保留原文，不自动翻译用户内容。
i18n.scopeWarning.en-US: Menus, language settings and integrated business labels update immediately. Unmigrated legacy text remains unchanged; user content is never automatically translated.

i18n.validation.zh-CN: 译文校验未通过，请检查内容、长度和占位符。
i18n.validation.en-US: Translation validation failed. Check text, length and placeholders.

graph.hint.zh-CN: 变量与常量 → 计算算子 → 指标输出；点击节点编辑，参数与常量节点同步。
graph.hint.en-US: Variables and constants → operators → outputs. Click a node to edit it; parameters and constant nodes stay synchronized.

graph.instructions.zh-CN: 拖动节点排布，拖动端口连接；也可点击节点后下拉选择上游。Shift 框选，Ctrl/⌘+Z 撤销。
graph.instructions.en-US: Drag nodes to arrange and ports to connect, or choose an upstream step in its settings. Shift selects; Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes.

graph.resourceHint.zh-CN: 点击添加，或拖到画布指定位置。已有指标会展开成独立步骤。
graph.resourceHint.en-US: Click to add or drag to the canvas. Existing indicators expand into independent steps.

graph.formulas.zh-CN: 查看生成公式与数据依赖

graph.dependencies.zh-CN: 数据依赖：{{names}}。这里只做结构检查，实际数据覆盖和数值结果在“校验与预览”中确认。
graph.dependencies.en-US: Dependencies: {{names}}. This checks structure only. Confirm data coverage and numerical results in Validation and preview.

graph.noteHint.zh-CN: 可选，说明这一步做什么

primitiveAuthoring.singleHint.zh-CN: 一个指标对应一个结果。分别选择多个指标时，系统自动复用相同的计算步骤。
primitiveAuthoring.singleHint.en-US: Each metric has one result. Selected metrics reuse identical calculation steps automatically.

primitiveAuthoring.stateHint.zh-CN: 这是共享计算的中间结果。请连接字段提取算子，再生成一个独立指标结果。
primitiveAuthoring.stateHint.en-US: This is an intermediate computation state. Use a field projection to produce one independent metric result.

riskScales.nameForDraft.zh-CN: 填写名称后可保存草稿。
riskScales.nameForDraft.en-US: Enter a name to save a draft.

riskScales.purposeHint.zh-CN: 可选。用于补充说明这套风险标尺适用于什么场景。
riskScales.purposeHint.en-US: Optional. Add context about where this risk scale is intended to be used.

riskScales.totalReturnVolatility.zh-CN: 总收益口径的年化波动率

riskScales.priceReturnVolatility.zh-CN: 价格口径的年化波动率

riskScales.draftSaved.zh-CN: 已保存修订 {{revision}}；未发布标尺。
riskScales.draftSaved.en-US: Revision {{revision}} saved. The scale has not been published.

riskScales.existingCmaHint.zh-CN: 直接引用冻结假设与资产轴，不重复录入或重新拟合。币种及口径不匹配的版本不可选。
riskScales.existingCmaHint.en-US: Use frozen assumptions and asset order without re-entry or refitting. Incompatible currency or basis is unavailable.

riskScales.datesInvalid.zh-CN: 研究日不能在未来，复核日须在研究日之后。
riskScales.datesInvalid.en-US: The research date cannot be in the future. Review must be due after it.

riskScales.horizonInvalid.zh-CN: 预测期限须为 1–30 年的整数。
riskScales.horizonInvalid.en-US: The forecast horizon must be an integer from 1 to 30 years.

riskScales.boundsInvalid.zh-CN: 上下限须为 0%–100% 的有限数值，且下限不能高于上限。
riskScales.boundsInvalid.en-US: Bounds must be finite values from 0% to 100%, with lower no greater than upper.

riskScales.capsInvalid.zh-CN: 请填写五个非负、严格递增的有限风险上限；空白不代表零。
riskScales.capsInvalid.en-US: Enter five finite, non-negative and strictly increasing caps. Blank does not mean zero.

riskScales.rationaleRequired.zh-CN: 请填写至少 5 个字符的人工阈值依据。
riskScales.rationaleRequired.en-US: Provide a manual threshold rationale of at least 5 characters.

riskScales.referenceDatesRequired.zh-CN: 填写参考名称和完整样本区间，开始日须早于截止日，截止日不得晚于研究日。
riskScales.referenceDatesRequired.en-US: Enter a reference name and full sample window, with start before end and end no later than the research date.

riskScales.assetsRequired.zh-CN: 请至少添加一个大类，并填写每个大类的名称。
riskScales.assetsRequired.en-US: Add at least one asset class and give each asset a name.

riskScales.cashCountInvalid.zh-CN: 一套风险标尺最多定义一个纯现金大类。
riskScales.cashCountInvalid.en-US: A risk scale can contain at most one pure cash asset.

riskScales.cashAssetInvalid.zh-CN: 现金只允许填写年化收益率，不能带代理或再平衡规则。
riskScales.cashAssetInvalid.en-US: Cash only accepts an annual return and cannot have proxies or a rebalancing rule.

riskScales.marketAssetInvalid.zh-CN: 请为非现金大类选择至少一个代理，并保留有效的再平衡规则。
riskScales.marketAssetInvalid.en-US: Select at least one proxy for each non-cash asset and keep a valid rebalancing rule.

riskScales.weightsInvalid.zh-CN: 非现金代理权重须为有限非负数并明确合计 100%；不会自动归一化。
riskScales.weightsInvalid.en-US: Non-cash proxy weights must be finite, non-negative and explicitly total 100%. They are never automatically normalized.

riskScales.confirmUpstreamRequired.zh-CN: 核对来源、警告与保存范围后，请勾选明确确认。
riskScales.confirmUpstreamRequired.en-US: Review sources, warnings and what will be saved, then explicitly confirm.

riskScales.notReady.zh-CN: 计算服务尚未就绪，请稍后重新加载。
riskScales.notReady.en-US: The calculation service is not ready. Reload when ready.

riskScales.confirmPublishRequired.zh-CN: 请确认全部警告及本次不可变发布内容。
riskScales.confirmPublishRequired.en-US: Acknowledge all warnings and confirm this immutable publication.

riskScales.previewUpdating.zh-CN: 分档设置已变化，正在自动更新结果…
riskScales.previewUpdating.en-US: Segmentation changed. Updating the result automatically…

riskScales.previewPending.zh-CN: 请完成有效的分档边界输入，系统会自动更新结果。
riskScales.previewPending.en-US: Complete valid segmentation boundaries and the result will update automatically.

riskScales.confirmReference.zh-CN: 确认保存参考资产与代理

riskScales.upstreamReview.zh-CN: 核对将保存的参考版本
riskScales.upstreamReview.en-US: Review the reference version to save

riskScales.confirmReferenceText.zh-CN: 我已核对来源与警告，确认保存参考资产、代理和收益面板；此操作不发布风险标尺。
riskScales.confirmReferenceText.en-US: I reviewed the sources and warnings and confirm saving reference assets, proxies and the return panel. This does not publish a risk scale.

riskScales.confirmPublishText.zh-CN: 我已核对当前内容，确认发布该版本。设为系统默认将在发布后另行确认。
riskScales.confirmPublishText.en-US: I reviewed the current content and confirm publishing this version. Setting it as the system default requires a separate confirmation.

riskScales.sourceLimits.zh-CN: 指数直接使用用户选择的指数值；ETF／基金使用复权价格或复权净值。代理不受市场、币种或产品池限制；样本区间自动取所有非现金代理的共同历史交集。
riskScales.sourceLimits.en-US: Indices use the selected index level directly. ETFs/funds use adjusted price or adjusted NAV. Proxy selection is not gated by market, currency or product pool; the sample window is the strict common historical intersection across non-cash proxies.

riskScales.noSourcesHint.zh-CN: 尝试其他名称、代码或来源类型；也可先在数据中心准备合格数据，再重试。
riskScales.noSourcesHint.en-US: Try another name, code or source type, or prepare qualified data in the data center and retry.

riskScales.unsupportedSource.zh-CN: 来源、字段或数据覆盖尚不支持
riskScales.unsupportedSource.en-US: Source, field or coverage is not supported

riskScales.selectedSourcesEmpty.zh-CN: 尚未选择；勾选后可一次确认。
riskScales.selectedSourcesEmpty.en-US: Nothing selected yet; check sources and confirm once.

riskScales.categorySummary.zh-CN: 共 {{total}} 个大类 · {{ready}} 个可用 · {{pending}} 个待完成

riskScales.categoryLimit.zh-CN: 每个范围最多 30 类资产。
riskScales.categoryLimit.en-US: A scope holds at most 30 categories.

riskScales.quickAddHint.zh-CN: 点一下即可按已保存的配置添加大类，代理一并带入。
riskScales.quickAddHint.en-US: One click adds the category together with its saved research proxy.

riskScales.moreReuse.zh-CN: 展开其余 {{count}} 个常用大类

riskScales.colRule.zh-CN: 再平衡 / 现金收益率

riskScales.proxyEmpty.en-US: No index or product selected yet

riskScales.templateHint.zh-CN: 模板仅提供现金、利率债、信用债、权益和黄金的分类起点，不包含虚构收益或已发布默认。
riskScales.templateHint.en-US: The template starts with cash, rates, credit, equity and gold. It contains no invented returns or published default.

riskScales.referenceBasis.zh-CN: 当前独立输入：CNY、SSE、日频，年化 252；费用按来源内含口径，不另计费，不隐式换汇。
riskScales.referenceBasis.en-US: Standalone inputs: CNY, SSE, daily, annualization 252; source-embedded fees, no extra fee or implicit currency conversion.

riskScales.cashReferenceRate.zh-CN: 参考：中国银行非定期存款挂牌利率 0.05%（仅供参考，不自动带入）。
riskScales.cashReferenceRate.en-US: Reference: Bank of China non-term deposit listed rate 0.05% (reference only; not applied automatically).

riskScales.cashHint.zh-CN: 现金只能填写年化收益率，不能选择代理或再平衡；默认收益率 0%，波动率及与其他资产协方差固定为 0。
riskScales.cashHint.en-US: Cash only accepts an annual return and cannot use proxies or rebalancing. Its return defaults to 0%; volatility and covariance with other assets are fixed at zero.

riskScales.marketHint.zh-CN: 非现金大类选择指数、ETF 或基金代理生成参考收益；默认每日按目标权重计算加权收益率。
riskScales.marketHint.en-US: Non-cash assets use index, ETF or fund proxies to build reference returns; by default the target weights are restored daily.

riskScales.rebalance.daily.zh-CN: 默认。每个有值日按目标权重计算当日加权收益率。
riskScales.rebalance.daily.en-US: Default. Restore target weights on every valued date before calculating the next daily return.

riskScales.rebalance.monthly.zh-CN: 在每月最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.monthly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each month; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.quarterly.zh-CN: 在每季最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.quarterly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each quarter; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.yearly.zh-CN: 在每年最后一个共同有值日期收盘后恢复目标权重，其余时间随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.yearly.en-US: Restore target weights after the last common valued date of each year; weights drift between resets.

riskScales.rebalance.buy_and_hold.zh-CN: 初始按目标权重配置后不再平衡，权重随价格漂移。
riskScales.rebalance.buy_and_hold.en-US: Allocate at target weights initially, then never rebalance; weights drift with prices.

riskScales.cashFixedCma.zh-CN: 现金收益率 {{value}}；波动率、均值不确定性及与其它资产协方差固定为 0。
riskScales.cashFixedCma.en-US: Cash return {{value}}; volatility, mean uncertainty and covariance with other assets are fixed at zero.

riskScales.cashCorrelationFixed.zh-CN: 当前没有需要填写的非现金相关系数；现金相关项固定为 0。
riskScales.cashCorrelationFixed.en-US: There are no non-cash correlations to enter. Cash correlations are fixed at zero.

riskScales.manualSourceRequired.zh-CN: 人工假设必须说明来源或依据，至少 3 个字符。
riskScales.manualSourceRequired.en-US: Manual assumptions require a source or rationale of at least 3 characters.

riskScales.historicalSourceOptional.zh-CN: 可选。历史统计的结构化来源、样本区间和版本已由系统保存。
riskScales.historicalSourceOptional.en-US: Optional. Historical statistics already retain structured source, sample-window and version evidence.

riskScales.historicalHint.zh-CN: 样本均值作为本次参考预期；计算由共享后端完成，不保证未来收益。
riskScales.historicalHint.en-US: The sample mean is used as the reference expectation, calculated by the shared backend. It does not guarantee future returns.

riskScales.manualHint.zh-CN: 填写人工收益、波动和完整相关矩阵；缺失项不填零，不修复或替代输入。
riskScales.manualHint.en-US: Enter manual returns, volatility and a complete correlation matrix. Missing inputs are not filled with zero, repaired or substituted.

riskScales.correlationHint.zh-CN: 相关系数 -1 至 1；对称项同步，主对角为 1。
riskScales.correlationHint.en-US: Correlation from -1 to 1. Symmetric entries stay aligned; diagonal entries equal 1.

riskScales.constraintHint.zh-CN: 默认不设置单大类或分组约束；无做空、无杠杆，权重合计 100%。需要限制时再展开配置。
riskScales.constraintHint.en-US: Asset and group bounds are unconstrained by default. No shorting or leverage; weights total 100%. Expand only when limits are needed.

riskScales.groupConstraintsHint.zh-CN: 分组约束与大类边界共同生效，由后端统一核验可行性。
riskScales.groupConstraintsHint.en-US: Group and asset bounds apply together. The backend checks feasibility.

riskScales.methodHint.frontier_shape_dp_.zh-CN: 按弧长加权的局部方向变化寻找连续分段；不是二阶微分曲率，也不代表客观投资偏好。
riskScales.methodHint.frontier_shape_dp_.en-US: Find contiguous segments using arc-length-weighted local directions. This is not differential curvature or an objective investor preference.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_volatility_v.zh-CN: 在有效前沿的风险跨度内寻找等距分界，再匹配有序有效节点。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_volatility_v.en-US: Find equal risk intervals across the efficient frontier, then match ordered valid nodes.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_arclength_v1.zh-CN: 按标准化风险收益曲线的累计弧长分段。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_arclength_v1.en-US: Segment by cumulative arc length of the normalized risk-return curve.

riskScales.methodHint.equal_return_v1.zh-CN: 按有效前沿最低到最高的预期年收益跨度等分五段，并将各收益分界点对应的波动率作为风险等级边界。
riskScales.methodHint.equal_return_v1.en-US: Split the efficient-frontier expected-return span into five equal ranges, then use the volatility at each return cut as the risk-level boundary.

riskScales.methodHint.manual_volatility_.zh-CN: 明确填写五个上限及依据；超出参考前沿的区间保持未校准。
riskScales.methodHint.manual_volatility_.en-US: Specify five caps and a rationale. Intervals beyond the reference frontier remain uncalibrated.

riskScales.unsupportedMethod.en-US: This algorithm is not currently executable

riskScales.manualCapsHint.zh-CN: 首项可为零，五项必须严格递增。没有有效代表点的档位不会生成收益或权重。
riskScales.manualCapsHint.en-US: The first cap may be zero; all five must strictly increase. Empty bands have no invented returns or weights.

riskScales.manualSeedRationale.zh-CN: 基于当前算法边界人工调整
riskScales.manualSeedRationale.en-US: Manual adjustment based on current algorithm boundaries

riskScales.boundaryAdjustmentHint.zh-CN: 算法先给出初始边界；可精确微调 C1–C5 上限。边界采用前开后闭，修改后代表组合、预期收益、波动率和画像会自动重算。
riskScales.boundaryAdjustmentHint.en-US: The algorithm supplies initial boundaries. Fine-tune the C1–C5 caps precisely. Bands are open-left/closed-right; representative portfolios, expected return, volatility and portraits update automatically.

riskScales.reuseFrontier.zh-CN: 切换分档算法或人工阈值只重新分档，复用同一条已计算的有效前沿，不重复读取历史数据。
riskScales.reuseFrontier.en-US: Changing the segmentation algorithm or manual caps only re-segments the same computed efficient frontier without reloading historical data.

riskScales.comparisonHint.zh-CN: 各方法使用同一输入和前沿。对比结果不会改变当前选定方法，发布只采用一种。
riskScales.comparisonHint.en-US: Methods use the same inputs and frontier. Comparison does not change the selected method; publication uses exactly one.

riskScales.notPublishable.zh-CN: 尚未满足发布条件，请处理下列问题。
riskScales.notPublishable.en-US: Publication requirements are not met. Resolve the issues below.

riskScales.chartDescription.zh-CN: 目标收益网格的最小方差有效前沿；完整数值可从下方表格读取。
riskScales.chartDescription.en-US: Minimum variance frontier over a target-return grid. The table below provides the values.

riskScales.noFrontier.zh-CN: 没有通过核验的前沿点

riskScales.noFrontierHint.zh-CN: 检查来源和约束后重试；未成功的目标不会通过插值补齐。
riskScales.noFrontierHint.en-US: Check sources and bounds, then retry. Failed targets are not interpolated.

riskScales.capMeaning.zh-CN: C3 表示最高允许风险，不要求组合达到 C3 的下界。边界相等归入较低档。
riskScales.capMeaning.en-US: C3 is a maximum allowance, not a minimum risk band. Equality belongs to the lower level.

riskScales.representativeMeaning.zh-CN: 收益、ES 和回撤属于参考代表组合，不是整档的收益或损失承诺；缺失指标不等于零。
riskScales.representativeMeaning.en-US: Return, ES and drawdown describe a representative portfolio, not a promise for the entire band. Missing metrics are not zero.

riskScales.tableHelp.zh-CN: 选择任一等级可高亮代表组合，展开详情可读权重与指标。
riskScales.tableHelp.en-US: Select a level to highlight its representative. Expand details for weights and metrics.

riskScales.fallback.zh-CN: 算法已记录退化原因：{{reason}}。未将其隐瞒为用户主动选择。
riskScales.fallback.en-US: The algorithm recorded a fallback reason: {{reason}}. This is distinct from an explicit method selection.

riskScales.noRepresentative.zh-CN: 该档没有有效代表组合，收益、权重及画像不可用。
riskScales.noRepresentative.en-US: This band has no valid representative. Return, weights and portraits are unavailable.

riskScales.noConfiguredHint.zh-CN: 点击“新建标尺”开始配置 C1–C5 风险等级。
riskScales.noConfiguredHint.en-US: Select New Risk Scale to configure C1–C5 risk levels.

riskScales.deletePublishedConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除“{{name}}”？该版本将不再出现在可用列表中，但历史审计仍保留。
riskScales.deletePublishedConfirm.en-US: Delete {{name}}? It will leave the available list, while historical audit records remain.

riskScales.deleteDraftConfirm.zh-CN: 确认删除草稿“{{name}}”？草稿删除后不可恢复。
riskScales.deleteDraftConfirm.en-US: Delete draft {{name}}? Draft deletion cannot be undone.

riskScales.deleteReason.zh-CN: 用户从风险等级配置中心删除该配置
riskScales.deleteReason.en-US: Deleted from the risk scale configuration center

riskScales.researchDayFromPit.zh-CN: 参考研究日自动使用当前 PIT 日期：{{date}}
riskScales.researchDayFromPit.en-US: The reference research date automatically uses the current PIT date: {{date}}

riskScales.researchDayFromToday.zh-CN: 当前未选择 PIT 日期，参考研究日自动使用今天：{{date}}
riskScales.researchDayFromToday.en-US: No PIT date is selected. The reference research date automatically uses today: {{date}}

riskScales.researchDayPending.zh-CN: 正在读取当前 PIT 口径，确认前不能开始风险标尺计算。
riskScales.researchDayPending.en-US: Loading the current PIT context. Risk-scale calculation stays disabled until it is resolved.

riskScales.researchDatePitHint.zh-CN: 由当前 PIT 日期自动生成，不可手工修改。
riskScales.researchDatePitHint.en-US: Automatically generated from the current PIT date and cannot be edited manually.

riskScales.researchDateTodayHint.zh-CN: 当前无 PIT 日期，因此自动使用今天；不可手工修改。
riskScales.researchDateTodayHint.en-US: No PIT date is active, so today is used automatically and cannot be edited manually.

riskScales.reviewDateOptionalHint.zh-CN: 可选。提前 30 天提示临近复核，到期后继续提醒；不会自动让标尺失效。
riskScales.reviewDateOptionalHint.en-US: Optional. A reminder appears 30 days before review and remains after the due date; it does not expire the scale automatically.

riskScales.referencePreviewTitle.zh-CN: 核对历史数据与共同区间
riskScales.referencePreviewTitle.en-US: Review historical data and common window

riskScales.intersectionMeaning.zh-CN: 系统按所有非现金代理实际可用日期取严格交集；现金不会缩短该区间。
riskScales.intersectionMeaning.en-US: The system uses the strict intersection of actual available dates across all non-cash proxies; cash does not shorten the window.

riskScales.referenceRequired.zh-CN: 请先核对并冻结参考资产历史数据。
riskScales.referenceRequired.en-US: Review and freeze the reference-asset history first.

riskScales.marketAssetRequired.zh-CN: 至少需要一个非现金大类用于构建有效前沿。
riskScales.marketAssetRequired.en-US: At least one non-cash asset is required to build the efficient frontier.

riskScales.coveragePending.zh-CN: 覆盖区间将在读取后核验
riskScales.coveragePending.en-US: Coverage will be verified after loading

riskScales.reviewReminder.zh-CN: 预计复核日：{{date}}。该提醒不影响标尺继续使用。
riskScales.reviewReminder.en-US: Review due date: {{date}}. This reminder does not stop the scale from being used.

riskScales.selectVersion.zh-CN: 选择 {{name}} v{{version}} 进行比较

riskScales.noSchemesHint.zh-CN: 调整筛选，或使用新建标尺完成参考输入、校准和发布。
riskScales.noSchemesHint.en-US: Adjust filters, or create a scale to complete reference inputs, calibration and publication.

riskScales.noDrafts.zh-CN: 暂无已保存草稿；新建后可显式保存。
riskScales.noDrafts.en-US: No drafts saved yet. Create a scale and save it explicitly.

riskScales.includeRetired.zh-CN: 显示已停用的历史版本

riskScales.portraitMonthlyRebalance.zh-CN: ES 与回撤画像：代表组合外层按月再平衡，代理内部使用各自的冻结再平衡规则。
riskScales.portraitMonthlyRebalance.en-US: ES and drawdown portraits: the outer representative portfolio rebalances monthly; each proxy uses its own frozen internal rebalance rule.

riskScales.portraitRebalanceUnknown.zh-CN: 此历史版本未记录代表组合外层再平衡口径，不能据此假定买入持有。
riskScales.portraitRebalanceUnknown.en-US: This historical version did not record the outer portfolio rebalance rule; do not assume buy-and-hold.

riskScales.exactlyTwo.zh-CN: 请选择恰好两个不同的版本。

riskScales.copyInputs.en-US: Copy inputs to a new study

riskScales.readonlyHint.zh-CN: 本页读取发布时冻结的结果，不会重新拟合或计算。
riskScales.readonlyHint.en-US: This page reads the exact frozen publication and never refits or recomputes it.

riskScales.alreadyDefault.zh-CN: 此版本已是系统默认，无需重复切换。
riskScales.alreadyDefault.en-US: This version is already the system default.

riskScales.retiredNotice.zh-CN: 已停止新引用；历史冻结结果仍可读取。
riskScales.retiredNotice.en-US: New references are disabled. Historical frozen results remain readable.

riskScales.defaultChanged.zh-CN: 默认已更新；已有引用保持原版本。
riskScales.defaultChanged.en-US: Default updated. Existing references retain their original version.

riskScales.defaultImpact.zh-CN: 仅影响后续选择。已有目标与研究继续引用原版本，历史数值不会改写。
riskScales.defaultImpact.en-US: This affects future selections only. Existing objectives and studies retain their original version and values.

riskScales.retireReason.zh-CN: 停用依据（至少 5 个字符）

riskScales.clearDefault.zh-CN: 我明确确认同时清空当前默认，不自动选择替代版本。
riskScales.clearDefault.en-US: I explicitly confirm clearing the current default without automatically choosing a replacement.

riskScales.confirmGovernance.zh-CN: 我已核对版本及本次操作的影响。
riskScales.confirmGovernance.en-US: I reviewed the version and impact of this action.

riskScales.governanceRequired.zh-CN: 请填写必要依据并确认；停用默认版本还需明确勾选清空默认。
riskScales.governanceRequired.en-US: Provide the required reason and confirmation. Retiring the default also requires explicitly clearing it.

riskScales.compareVersions.zh-CN: 比较两个风险标尺版本

riskScales.compareFromList.zh-CN: 返回列表，勾选两个精确版本后再进入比较。
riskScales.compareFromList.en-US: Return to the list and select two exact versions.

riskScales.compatibleComparison.zh-CN: 口径兼容；以下为右侧相对左侧的后端边界差异，不作优劣排名。
riskScales.compatibleComparison.en-US: Compatible basis. Boundary differences below are calculated by the backend as right minus left, without ranking.

riskScales.incompatibleComparison.zh-CN: 币种或风险语义不兼容，仅并列阅读，不叠加曲线或比较数值差。
riskScales.incompatibleComparison.en-US: Currency or risk semantics are incompatible. Read side by side without overlaying curves or numerical differences.

riskScales.numberRequired.zh-CN: 请输入完整的有限数值；空白不代表零。
riskScales.numberRequired.en-US: Enter a complete finite number. Blank does not mean zero.

riskScales.groupsInvalid.zh-CN: 分组须有唯一名称、至少一个资产及合法上下限。
riskScales.groupsInvalid.en-US: Groups require unique names, at least one asset and valid bounds.

riskScales.dataWindow.zh-CN: 实际数据区间 {{start}} 至 {{end}}；{{observations}} 个收益观测。
riskScales.dataWindow.en-US: Actual data window {{start}} to {{end}}; {{observations}} return observations.

riskScales.stability.unstable_calibratio.zh-CN: 网格复核不稳定，请核对边界移动
riskScales.stability.unstable_calibratio.en-US: Grid validation is unstable; review boundary shifts

riskScales.stability.manual_policy_thres.zh-CN: 人工政策阈值，非自动校准稳定性结论
riskScales.stability.manual_policy_thres.en-US: Manual policy thresholds, not an automatic stability finding

riskScales.stability.manual_adjustment.zh-CN: 已基于算法结果人工微调边界
riskScales.stability.manual_adjustment.en-US: Boundaries manually fine-tuned from the algorithm result

riskScales.metricUnit.daily_es_95_decima.zh-CN: 日频，95% 经验尾部损失

riskScales.correlationInvalid.zh-CN: 相关矩阵仍有空项或超出 -1 至 1 的系数，请展开矩阵补齐。
riskScales.correlationInvalid.en-US: The correlation matrix has blank entries or values outside -1 to 1. Expand it and complete the entries.

riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_REFEREN.zh-CN: 参考资产与固定成分为事后研究，不证明历史时点可投资。
riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_REFEREN.en-US: Reference assets and fixed components are retrospective research, not proof of historical investability.

riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_INPUT_INVALI.zh-CN: 冻结风险矩或约束无法形成可验证前沿；不会修补矩阵或放宽约束。
riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_INPUT_INVALI.en-US: The frozen risk matrix or bounds cannot produce a verified frontier. Inputs will not be repaired or bounds relaxed.

riskScales.problem.RESEARCH_SCALE.zh-CN: C1–C5 是本工作区研究标尺，不是跨机构适当性评级。
riskScales.problem.RESEARCH_SCALE.en-US: C1–C5 is this workspace's research scale, not a universal suitability rating.

riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_UNVERIFIED.zh-CN: 前沿存在未验证点或求解失败，不能发布；请查看诊断。
riskScales.problem.FRONTIER_UNVERIFIED.en-US: The frontier has unverified or failed points and cannot be published. Review the diagnostics.

riskScales.problem.NEAR_LINEAR_FRONTIER.zh-CN: 形状算法检测到近直线，按其内部规则采用弧长切分。
riskScales.problem.NEAR_LINEAR_FRONTIER.en-US: The shape method detected a near-linear frontier and applied its documented arc-length fallback.

riskScales.problem.MANUAL_POLICY_THRESHO.zh-CN: 人工阈值依据由研究者提供，超出参考范围的部分未校准。
riskScales.problem.MANUAL_POLICY_THRESHO.en-US: Manual thresholds are supported by researcher evidence. Portions beyond the reference range remain uncalibrated.

riskScales.problem.BOUNDARY_ADJUSTED.zh-CN: 分档边界已在算法结果上人工微调；代表组合和相关指标已按调整后的区间重新计算。
riskScales.problem.BOUNDARY_ADJUSTED.en-US: Boundaries were manually fine-tuned from the algorithm result. Representative portfolios and related metrics were recalculated for the adjusted bands.

riskScales.problem.UNSTABLE_CALIBRATION.zh-CN: 101/200 点复核未稳定，请核对差异后再采用。
riskScales.problem.UNSTABLE_CALIBRATION.en-US: The 101 / 200 point check is unstable. Review differences before adopting the result.

riskScales.problem.ENDPOINT_MISMATCH.zh-CN: 两次前沿端点不一致，无法完成稳定性验证。
riskScales.problem.ENDPOINT_MISMATCH.en-US: The two frontier endpoint sets differ; stability validation cannot be completed.

riskScales.problem.STABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 200 点分档验证失败，当前自动标尺不能发布。
riskScales.problem.STABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: The 200-point segmentation check failed. This automatic scale cannot be published.

riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_PORTRAI.zh-CN: 风险画像仅为事后参考；ES 为日频经验值，不是年度损失保证。
riskScales.problem.RETROSPECTIVE_PORTRAI.en-US: Risk portraits are retrospective references. ES is an empirical daily value, not an annual loss guarantee.

riskScales.problem.VERSION_RETIRED.zh-CN: 版本已退休，仅供历史读取。
riskScales.problem.VERSION_RETIRED.en-US: The version is retired and available for historical reading only.

riskScales.problem.VERSION_EXPIRED.en-US: The version has passed its hard expiry date.

riskScales.problem.REVIEW_DUE.zh-CN: 版本已到复核日，请建立复核后的新版本。
riskScales.problem.REVIEW_DUE.en-US: The review date has arrived. Create a newly reviewed version.

riskScales.problem.FROZEN_REFERENCE_UNAV.zh-CN: 冻结参考来源不可读、失效或校验失败。
riskScales.problem.FROZEN_REFERENCE_UNAV.en-US: A frozen reference is unreadable, expired or failed validation.

riskScales.problem.DEFAULT_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 默认版本不可读或已不具备引用资格。
riskScales.problem.DEFAULT_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: The default version is unreadable or no longer eligible for new references.

multiCma.hint.zh-CN: 按研究权重平均收益与协方差，不加入模型分歧项；权重不是贝叶斯后验概率。
multiCma.hint.en-US: Research weights average returns and covariance without adding model disagreement. They are not Bayesian posterior probabilities.

multiCma.weightInvalid.zh-CN: 每项权重须非负，合计为 100%；请修改权重或明确选择等权。
multiCma.weightInvalid.en-US: Weights must be nonnegative and total 100%. Edit them or explicitly choose equal weights.

multiCma.empty.zh-CN: 尚未选择 CMA。添加至少一个已确认版本后再比较。
multiCma.empty.en-US: No CMA selected. Add at least one confirmed version before comparing.

multiCma.loading.zh-CN: 正在读取全部冻结版本，完成前不能比较。
multiCma.loading.en-US: Loading all frozen versions. Comparison is unavailable until they are complete.

multiCma.continue.zh-CN: 核对权重并进入政策比较

multiCma.limit.zh-CN: 最多选择 20 个 CMA；兼容性将在比较时完整核验。
multiCma.limit.en-US: Select up to 20 CMAs. Full compatibility is checked when comparing.

multiCma.crossHint.zh-CN: 同一组权重在各原 CMA 下重新测量。采纳门禁采用融合参数，原模型失败不代表融合失败，也不能称为全模型稳健。
multiCma.crossHint.en-US: The same weights are measured under every original CMA. Adoption uses the averaged parameters. An original-model failure is not an aggregate failure; this is not all-model robustness.

multiCma.uncertainty.zh-CN: 融合均值不确定性未联合校准；各模型共享数据时，不假设估计误差相互独立。
multiCma.uncertainty.en-US: Mean uncertainty is not jointly calibrated. Shared data does not imply independent estimation errors.

multiCma.frozen.zh-CN: 冻结的融合来源与权重

multiCma.crossMissing.zh-CN: 交叉评估证据缺失，请重新比较。
multiCma.crossMissing.en-US: Cross-evaluation evidence is missing. Compare again.

multiCma.reloadMismatch.zh-CN: 所选 CMA 的版本或哈希不一致，请重新选择。
multiCma.reloadMismatch.en-US: The selected CMA version or hash does not match. Select it again.

multiCma.ready.zh-CN: 已读取全部冻结版本；改变成员或权重后须重新比较。
multiCma.ready.en-US: All frozen versions are loaded. Compare again after changing members or weights.

multiCma.scroll.zh-CN: 左右滑动表格，可查看全部列。
multiCma.scroll.en-US: Scroll horizontally to see all columns.

multiCma.tacticalTrackingError.zh-CN: 相对 SAA 的前瞻主动风险

multiCma.commonHint.zh-CN: 同一组配置须通过每个原 CMA 的收益、风险及适用的资金检查；任一模型失败均不能采纳。
multiCma.commonHint.en-US: The same allocation must pass return, risk and applicable funding checks under every original CMA. Any failure blocks adoption.

multiCma.commonContinue.zh-CN: 核对模型并进入共同配置

multiCma.minimax_regret.zh-CN: 最小化最大收益机会损失

multiCma.infeasibleBound.zh-CN: 最小约束松弛量的下界为 {{bound}}，大于零，原约束无法同时满足。
multiCma.infeasibleBound.en-US: The lower bound on minimum constraint relaxation is {{bound}}, above zero: the original constraints cannot all hold.

multiCma.approximateRegret.zh-CN: 个别模型的最优收益尚未收敛；机会损失基准仅为近似或尚不可用。
multiCma.approximateRegret.en-US: Some individual optimum returns are unresolved; regret references are approximate or unavailable.

multiCma.anchors.zh-CN: 查看各模型单独求解及交叉检查

multiCma.anchorsHint.zh-CN: 单模型结果用于衡量机会损失，再在共同约束下直接求解最终权重。相对目标使用相对基准的预期超额收益。
multiCma.anchorsHint.en-US: Individual optima define regret references. Final weights are solved directly under the common constraints. Relative objectives use expected benchmark excess return.

multiCma.summaryBasis.zh-CN: 下表逐项取各模型最不利值，并不代表同一个概率分布。资金成功率仅筛选已生成的共同候选；未通过不代表全部权重空间无解。
multiCma.summaryBasis.en-US: Each metric summarizes its worst model and does not describe one distribution. Funding probability filters only the generated candidate; failure does not prove infeasibility over all weights.

multiCma.solver.converged.zh-CN: 收益与风险约束已通过，目标上下界在容差内。
multiCma.solver.converged.en-US: Return and risk constraints verified; objective bounds agree within tolerance.

multiCma.solver.verified_feasible.zh-CN: 收益与风险约束已通过，目标上下界尚未闭合。
multiCma.solver.verified_feasible.en-US: Return and risk constraints verified; objective gap remains open.

multiCma.solver.infeasible.zh-CN: 已证明：这些约束无法同时满足。
multiCma.solver.infeasible.en-US: Verified: these constraints cannot all be satisfied.

multiCma.solver.phase_one_unresolved.zh-CN: 尚未找到可验证的可行起点，不能判定无解。
multiCma.solver.phase_one_unresolved.en-US: A feasible start is unresolved; infeasibility is not established.

multiCma.solver.time_budget.zh-CN: 已达到时间预算；尚未完成求解。

multiCma.solver.iteration_limit.zh-CN: 已达到迭代预算；尚未完成求解。

multiCma.solver.master_iteration_limit.zh-CN: 线性子问题达到迭代预算；尚未完成求解。
multiCma.solver.master_iteration_limit.en-US: Linear subproblem iteration budget reached; solution unresolved.

multiCma.solver.numerical_failure.zh-CN: 数值校验未通过，不能采纳本次结果。
multiCma.solver.numerical_failure.en-US: Numerical verification failed; this result cannot be adopted.

multiCma.solver.cut_budget.zh-CN: 已达到风险约束细化预算；尚未完成求解。
multiCma.solver.cut_budget.en-US: Risk refinement budget reached; solution unresolved.

ltcma.selectCma.zh-CN: 勾选一个或多个已确认 CMA，再进入战略资产配置。
ltcma.selectCma.en-US: Select one or more confirmed CMAs to continue to SAA.

ltcma.singleSaaHint.zh-CN: 使用这份 CMA 研究资产配置，自动带入研究范围和已绑定的投资目标。
ltcma.singleSaaHint.en-US: Use this CMA for allocation, carrying its scope and linked investment objective.

ltcma.multipleSaaHint.zh-CN: 进入 SAA 后，选择加权融合或共同约束；不会自动平均。
ltcma.multipleSaaHint.en-US: In SAA, choose weighted averaging or all-model constraints. No automatic averaging.

ltcma.handoffClock.zh-CN: 研究日期尚未加载，请稍后重试。
ltcma.handoffClock.en-US: The research date has not loaded. Please retry shortly.

ltcma.handoffLimit.zh-CN: 最多选择 20 个不同的 CMA，请移除多余或重复的选择。
ltcma.handoffLimit.en-US: Select up to 20 distinct CMAs. Remove excess or duplicate selections.

ltcma.handoffRetired.zh-CN: 有 CMA 已停止引用，请移除后重新选择。
ltcma.handoffRetired.en-US: A CMA is retired. Remove it and select another version.

ltcma.handoffFuture.zh-CN: 研究日晚于当前可用日期，请选择更早的 CMA。
ltcma.handoffFuture.en-US: The research date is beyond the current cutoff. Choose an earlier CMA.

ltcma.handoffScopeMissing.zh-CN: 研究范围已不可用，请回研究范围库检查后再继续。
ltcma.handoffScopeMissing.en-US: The research scope is unavailable. Check it in the scope library before continuing.

ltcma.handoffLegacy.zh-CN: 旧版 CMA 可单独使用；多选请先复制并重新确认。
ltcma.handoffLegacy.en-US: Older CMAs can be used alone. Copy and reconfirm them before selecting multiple versions.

ltcma.handoffScope.zh-CN: 资产范围不同，不能一起使用。
ltcma.handoffScope.en-US: Different asset scopes cannot be used together.

ltcma.handoffDate.zh-CN: 研究日不同，请选择同一天的 CMA。
ltcma.handoffDate.en-US: Research dates differ. Select CMAs with the same research date.

ltcma.handoffCurrency.zh-CN: 计价币种不同，不能一起使用。
ltcma.handoffCurrency.en-US: CMAs in different currencies cannot be used together.

ltcma.handoffBasis.zh-CN: 收益、风险或费用口径不同，请核对后再选择。
ltcma.handoffBasis.en-US: Return, risk or fee conventions differ. Review them before selecting.

ltcma.handoffAssets.zh-CN: 大类资产的定义或顺序不同，不能直接一起使用。
ltcma.handoffAssets.en-US: Asset definitions or ordering differ. These CMAs cannot be combined directly.

ltcma.handoffChanged.zh-CN: 所选记录已变化，请刷新列表后重新选择。
ltcma.handoffChanged.en-US: A selected record changed. Refresh the list and select again.

ltcma.handoffMandateUnavailable.zh-CN: 绑定的投资目标已不可用，请在研究范围中核对目标后再继续。
ltcma.handoffMandateUnavailable.en-US: The linked investment objective is unavailable. Review the scope’s objective before continuing.

ltcma.handoffNeedsMandate.zh-CN: 已带入所选 CMA 和研究范围。该范围尚未绑定投资目标，请在下方补选，再继续配置。
ltcma.handoffNeedsMandate.en-US: Your CMAs and scope are loaded. This scope has no linked objective; select one below to continue.

ltcma.chooseCmaUse.zh-CN: 所选方案已带入，请选择如何使用它们。
ltcma.chooseCmaUse.en-US: Your selected CMAs are loaded. Choose how to use them.

ltcma.chooseCmaMode.zh-CN: 请选择 CMA 使用方式
ltcma.chooseCmaMode.en-US: Choose how to use the CMAs

ltcma.averageUseHint.zh-CN: 加权融合：为各 CMA 设置权重，合成一组收益与风险参数，再计算资产配置。
ltcma.averageUseHint.en-US: Weighted averaging: set CMA weights, combine return and risk parameters, then calculate an allocation.

ltcma.commonUseHint.zh-CN: 共同约束：不填模型权重，要求同一资产配置在每个 CMA 下都满足目标与约束。
ltcma.commonUseHint.en-US: All-model constraints: no model weights; the allocation must satisfy objectives and constraints under every CMA.

ltcma.methodHelp.long_term_scenario.zh-CN: 选择一项历史情景研究。资产范围和研究代理沿用当前配置，情景占比、收益与风险由系统计算。
ltcma.methodHelp.long_term_scenario.en-US: Choose a historical scenario study. The system uses the current asset scope and research proxies to calculate scenario shares, returns and risk.

ltcma.methodHow.long_term_scenario.zh-CN: 先按情景统计资产表现，用分段历史检验决定各情景结果应参考多少整体历史表现，再按历史时间占比合成并年化；另用连续历史片段反复抽样，估计平均收益可能有多大误差。
ltcma.methodHow.long_term_scenario.en-US: Measure asset behavior in each scenario. Checks across successive historical periods determine how much each estimate draws on the overall history. Combine by historical time shares and annualize. Repeatedly resample consecutive historical blocks to estimate uncertainty in average returns.

ltcma.methodResult.long_term_scenario.zh-CN: 与“历史情景”相比，多了自动调整估计和平均收益误差评估；占比固定采用历史时间比例，不能手调。两者都不使用实时情景，也不预测未来情景概率。
ltcma.methodResult.long_term_scenario.en-US: Compared with Historical scenarios, this adds automatic adjustment of estimates and uncertainty in average returns. Shares are fixed to historical time proportions and cannot be edited. Neither method uses real-time scenarios or predicts future scenario probabilities.

ltcma.methodHelp.conditional_scenario.zh-CN: 选择历史情景、与其匹配的已校准实时情景研究，以及预测区间；当前状态概率来自该实时研究。
ltcma.methodHelp.conditional_scenario.en-US: Select historical scenarios, matching calibrated real-time research and a forecast horizon. Current state probabilities come from that real-time study.

ltcma.methodHow.conditional_scenario.zh-CN: 从当前概率出发，按历史估计的状态转移推演期末概率和期间平均占比；结合各状态的联合资产分布，递推累计收益矩，并模拟分位数和亏损概率。
ltcma.methodHow.conditional_scenario.en-US: Starts from current probabilities and uses historically estimated state transitions to project end-state probabilities and average time shares. Joint state-dependent asset distributions supply cumulative return moments and simulated quantiles and loss probabilities.

ltcma.methodResult.conditional_scenario.zh-CN: 用于比较特定区间的条件结果，当前仅供研究，不能用于 SAA。年化摘要不等于累计风险或 CAGR；当前识别已校准，也不代表未来预测已经验证。
ltcma.methodResult.conditional_scenario.en-US: Useful for comparing conditional outcomes over a specific horizon. Currently research-only and unavailable for SAA. Annualized summaries are not cumulative risk or CAGR; calibrated current recognition does not validate future forecasts.

ltcma.scenarioHistoryHint.zh-CN: 按历史区间分析全部资产，不限识别频率；移到不可用项可查看原因。
ltcma.scenarioHistoryHint.en-US: Applies historical intervals to all assets, regardless of classification frequency. Hover or focus unavailable choices for reasons.

ltcma.scenarioRealtimeHint.zh-CN: 使用同一历史情景下已校准的概率；识别分数不能代替概率。
ltcma.scenarioRealtimeHint.en-US: Uses calibrated probabilities tied to the same historical reference. Recognition scores are not probabilities.

ltcma.conditionalHorizonHint.zh-CN: 区间会参与情景演变和累计收益计算。1 年按 252 个交易日换算。
ltcma.conditionalHorizonHint.en-US: This period affects regime evolution and cumulative returns. One year uses 252 trading days.

ltcma.scenarioFiltered.zh-CN: 已有情景研究，但均不符合当前研究日或数据要求。
ltcma.scenarioFiltered.en-US: Existing regime studies do not meet the current date or data requirements.

ltcma.scenarioMissing.zh-CN: 还没有可用的历史情景研究，请先到情景研究中心保存研究。
ltcma.scenarioMissing.en-US: No historical regime study is available. Save one in the scenario center first.

ltcma.scenarioRealtimeMissing.zh-CN: 尚无匹配的实时概率研究，请在情景研究中心完成识别与概率校准。
ltcma.scenarioRealtimeMissing.en-US: No matching real-time probability study is available. Complete recognition and probability calibration in the scenario center.

ltcma.scenarioAutomatic.zh-CN: 系统自动计算情景占比、各类资产收益与风险。研究代理沿用资产范围，可展开核对。
ltcma.scenarioAutomatic.en-US: Regime weights, asset returns and risk are calculated automatically. Research proxies are inherited from the scope and can be reviewed below.

ltcma.scenarioConditionalResearchOnly.zh-CN: 条件结果可保存用于比较；完成未来预测和 SAA 适配验证前，不能用于 SAA。
ltcma.scenarioConditionalResearchOnly.en-US: Conditional results can be saved for comparison. SAA use requires independent forecast and adapter validation.

ltcma.scenarioMandateTooLong.zh-CN: 投资目标超过当前支持的 10 年。下方区间仅作比较研究，不会缩短投资目标。
ltcma.scenarioMandateTooLong.en-US: The objective exceeds the supported 10-year range. The selected comparison period does not shorten the investment objective.

ltcma.scenarioMandateFailed.zh-CN: 投资目标暂时未能读取，请返回目标页面检查后重试。
ltcma.scenarioMandateFailed.en-US: The investment objective could not be loaded. Check its page and retry.

ltcma.scenarioLoading.zh-CN: 正在按研究日匹配情景研究…
ltcma.scenarioLoading.en-US: Matching scenario studies to the research date…

ltcma.methodOptionsLoading.zh-CN: 正在读取此方法需要的研究资料，可继续编辑其他内容。
ltcma.methodOptionsLoading.en-US: Loading studies for this method. You can continue editing other fields.

ltcma.methodOptionsFailed.zh-CN: 此方法的研究资料读取失败，请重试。
ltcma.methodOptionsFailed.en-US: Could not load studies for this method. Please retry.

ltcma.scenarioHandoffBlocked.zh-CN: 此情景结果仅供研究，尚不能用于 SAA。
ltcma.scenarioHandoffBlocked.en-US: This scenario result is research-only and cannot yet be used for SAA.

ltcma.scenarioProbabilityHint.zh-CN: 期末概率与期间平均占比含义不同，不代表期间至少发生一次的概率。
ltcma.scenarioProbabilityHint.en-US: Endpoint probability and average occupancy are different quantities. Neither is the probability of occurring at least once.

ltcma.scenarioLongProbabilityHint.zh-CN: 按历史时间占比混合各情景；收益与风险由对应资产数据计算。
ltcma.scenarioLongProbabilityHint.en-US: Regimes are mixed by historical time shares; asset data determine returns and risk.

ltcma.scenarioHorizonResults.zh-CN: 预测区间内的累计收益
ltcma.scenarioHorizonResults.en-US: Cumulative returns over the forecast period

ltcma.scenarioHorizonResultHint.zh-CN: 模拟期间情景切换与收益复合；下表为累计结果，与上方年化指标分开展示。
ltcma.scenarioHorizonResultHint.en-US: Simulates regime transitions and compound returns. These cumulative results are separate from the annualized metrics above.

ltcma.scenarioAnnualHint.zh-CN: 以下为基础期收益的年化摘要，不是预测区间累计收益。
ltcma.scenarioAnnualHint.en-US: These are annualized periodic moments, not cumulative returns over the forecast period.

ltcma.handoffGoalCurrency.zh-CN: CMA 的币种与绑定的投资目标不同，请选择同币种的 CMA。
ltcma.handoffGoalCurrency.en-US: The CMA currency differs from the linked objective. Select a CMA in the same currency.

ltcma.handoffGoalDate.zh-CN: CMA 研究日不在投资目标的有效期内，请选择该目标有效期内的 CMA。
ltcma.handoffGoalDate.en-US: The CMA research date is outside the objective’s valid period. Select a CMA within that period.

ltcma.handoffCashDate.zh-CN: 此投资目标含资金测算，请使用与目标研究日相同的 CMA。
ltcma.handoffCashDate.en-US: This objective includes cash-flow planning. Use a CMA with the same research date as the objective.

ltcma.scenarioOptionsUnavailable.zh-CN: 情景研究列表暂不可用，请重试读取。
ltcma.scenarioOptionsUnavailable.en-US: Scenario studies are unavailable. Please retry loading them.

ltcma.scenarioChooseHistory.zh-CN: 请选择当前研究日可用的历史情景研究。
ltcma.scenarioChooseHistory.en-US: Choose a historical regime study available on this research date.

ltcma.scenarioHistoryUnavailable.zh-CN: 这项历史情景暂不适用于本次研究。
ltcma.scenarioHistoryUnavailable.en-US: This historical regime study is not available for this research.

ltcma.scenarioRealtimeUnavailable.zh-CN: 这项实时研究尚未完成概率校准。
ltcma.scenarioRealtimeUnavailable.en-US: This real-time study has not completed probability calibration.

ltcma.scenarioPublishConfirm.zh-CN: 我已阅读结果；此条件情景仅作比较研究，暂不能用于 SAA。
ltcma.scenarioPublishConfirm.en-US: I have reviewed the results. This conditional study is for comparison and is not yet eligible for SAA.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.unabl.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束目录读取失败，暂时无法确认所选目标；请刷新页面后重试。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.unabl.en-US: Unable to load investment objectives and constraints or verify the selected objective. Refresh and try again.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.noPub.zh-CN: 还没有已发布投资目标与约束；请先在投资目标中心发布后再锁定研究范围。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.noPub.en-US: No published investment objectives and constraints. Publish one in the objectives center before locking the research scope.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.inves.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束为必填：请先选择已发布的投资目标与约束，再锁定研究范围并继续后续研究。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.inves.en-US: Investment objectives and constraints are required. Select a published objective before locking the scope and continuing research.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.unabl.en-US: Unable to remove this item from the list. Please retry.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.start.zh-CN: 先做战略研究：独立资产范围

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.selec.en-US: Select published investment objectives and constraints

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.thePa.zh-CN: 当前页面 PIT 尚未确认，暂无法核对所选投资目标与约束的研究日；不影响本次选择。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.thePa.en-US: The page PIT context is not yet confirmed, so the objective's research date cannot be checked. You can still select it.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.pitIs.zh-CN: 当前页面 PIT 已关闭，没有知识截止日可核对；所选投资目标与约束的研究日
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.pitIs.en-US: PIT is off on this page, so no knowledge cutoff is available for comparison. The selected objective's research date

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.theSe.zh-CN: 所选投资目标与约束的研究日

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.useTh.zh-CN: 需要先确定资产配置框架时选择；先定义战略资产范围，再把可投资产品映射到各资产。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.useTh.en-US: Use this when defining the allocation framework first. Define strategic assets, then map investable products to each asset.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.useTh.zh-CN: 已有明确产品候选时选择；先锁定产品池，再从产品归类构建战略资产范围。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.useTh.en-US: Use this when you already have a product shortlist. Lock the product pools, then build strategic assets from their classification.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.loadi.zh-CN: 正在读取投资目标与约束…

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.noPub.zh-CN: 还没有已发布投资目标与约束。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.noPub.en-US: No published investment objectives and constraints yet.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.theSe.zh-CN: 所选目标会贯穿后续 CMA、SAA、TAA 与产品配置；切换目标会清除旧的下游决策引用。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.theSe.en-US: The selected objective carries through CMA, SAA, TAA and product allocation. Changing it clears previous downstream decision references.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.resum.zh-CN: 继续研究按保存时的版本恢复；编辑会保存新版本，历史研究保留原版本；复制新建会生成独立草稿。
preInvestment.productPoolSelection.resum.en-US: Resume restores the saved version. Editing saves a new version while historical research retains the original. Copying creates an independent draft.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.noSav.en-US: No saved {{p0}} yet. Select “New research scope” to start.

preInvestment.productPoolSelection.fromT.en-US: ” from the list? Historical research referencing it will be retained.

preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.u.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束目录读取失败，暂时无法确认所选目标；请刷新页面后重试。
preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.u.en-US: Unable to load investment objectives and constraints or verify the selected objective. Refresh and try again.

preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.t.zh-CN: 该目标已停用或被新版本替代，历史约束仍可查看；继续新研究请复制范围并选择可用目标。

preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.n.zh-CN: 还没有已发布投资目标与约束；请先在投资目标中心发布后再锁定研究范围。
preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.n.en-US: No published investment objectives and constraints. Publish one in the objectives center before locking the research scope.

preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.i.zh-CN: 投资目标与约束为必填：请先选择已发布的投资目标与约束，再锁定研究范围并继续后续研究。
preInvestment.productPoolWorkspacePage.i.en-US: Investment objectives and constraints are required. Select a published objective before locking the scope and continuing research.

preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.zh-CN: 按共同观察期推进持仓，符合决策、滞后、执行机会和阈值时才调整；其他期间持仓随收益自然漂移。费用采用明确选择的口径，共同观察日不等于实际交易或申赎时点。
preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.en-US: Holdings advance on common observation dates. Adjustments occur only when decision, lag, execution opportunity and threshold conditions are met; otherwise weights drift with returns. Costs follow the selected convention. Observation dates are not necessarily trading or subscription/redemption dates.

preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.zh-CN: 原研究口径：按共同观察期每日恢复目标权重，费用基于半数绝对权重变化。
preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.en-US: Original research convention: restore target weights daily on common observation dates; costs use half the absolute weight change.

preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.zh-CN: 训练结束后的数据仅做独立验证；当前数据版本与观点仍可能缺少完整历史 PIT 证明。
preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.en-US: Post-training data are for independent validation only. The current data vintage and views may still lack full historical PIT evidence.

preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.zh-CN: 明确训练与验证日期，运行后查看净值、净超额、风险、换手与成本；没有数据时不会生成示例业绩。
preInvestment.tacticalAllocationWorkspac.en-US: Set training and validation dates, then review NAV, net excess return, risk, turnover and costs. No sample performance is generated when data are missing.
