preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.checkingMod.en-US: Checking model inputs and calculating preview…

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.continueEnt.zh-CN: 继续使用原长期假设表单填写收益、波动和相关性。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.continueEnt.en-US: Continue entering returns, volatility and correlations in the original long-term assumption form.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.provideMark.zh-CN: 市场权重必须由你明确提供。没有观点时，结果等于市场均衡先验加无风险收益；资产风险沿用下方输入协方差。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.provideMark.en-US: Provide market weights explicitly. Without views, the result equals the market equilibrium prior plus the risk-free return. Asset risk uses the covariance matrix below.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.marketRiskA.zh-CN: 市场风险厌恶系数 δ

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.priorMeanUn.zh-CN: 先验均值不确定性系数 τ

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.finitePosit.zh-CN: 有限正数；仅缩放均值先验协方差，不改变资产风险。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.finitePosit.en-US: Finite positive number. Scales only prior mean covariance, not asset risk.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.onlyScenari.zh-CN: 只有明确概率的情景才能混合。结果包含情景之间的均值差异风险，是单期矩匹配，不是尾部风险预测。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.onlyScenari.en-US: Only scenarios with explicit probabilities can be mixed. Results include risk from differences in scenario means. This is one-period moment matching, not a tail-risk forecast.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.explicitlyS.zh-CN: 明确共用一个风险矩阵

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.provideARis.en-US: Provide a risk matrix per scenario

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.afterChangi.zh-CN: 切换风险口径后，请重新填写对应矩阵，原矩阵不会被自动复制。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.afterChangi.en-US: After changing the risk convention, enter the corresponding matrices again. Existing matrices are not copied automatically.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.noScenarios.zh-CN: 尚无情景，请添加情景并填写概率、每项资产收益及风险依据。
preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.noScenarios.en-US: No scenarios yet. Add scenarios and enter probabilities, asset returns and risk evidence.

preInvestment.cmaModelEditor.theLimitOf6.en-US: The limit of 60 scenarios has been reached.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.setMinimu.zh-CN: 设置各大类的最低和最高配置比例；组合仍须满足投资目标与约束。战术偏离幅度在下一阶段 TAA 中设置。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.setMinimu.en-US: Set minimum and maximum weights for each asset class. The portfolio must still meet investment objectives and constraints. Tactical deviations are configured in the next TAA step.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.jointCons.zh-CN: 联合约束与候选搜索设置
preInvestment.policyCandidates.jointCons.en-US: Joint constraints and candidate search settings

preInvestment.policyCandidates.comparePo.zh-CN: 比较符合目标的政策候选

preInvestment.policyCandidates.compareFi.zh-CN: 先比较，再决定采用哪个

preInvestment.policyCandidates.theseUseT.zh-CN: 以下来自同一组可行候选，不保证全局最优。保守收益采用已冻结的均值椭球，不是资产收益的概率分位数。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.theseUseT.en-US: These use the same feasible candidate set; global optimality is not guaranteed. Conservative returns use the frozen mean ellipsoid, not a quantile of asset returns.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.theseUseT.zh-CN: 以下来自同一组可行候选，不保证全局最优。保守收益按声明的均值不确定区间扣减，不是概率分位数。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.theseUseT.en-US: These use the same feasible candidate set; global optimality is not guaranteed. Conservative returns deduct the stated mean uncertainty range, not a probability quantile.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 在满足收益目标、波动上限和全部权重约束的候选中，选预期年波动最小的组合。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: Among candidates meeting the return target, volatility cap and all weight limits, the one with the lowest expected annual volatility.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 按投资目标的风险厌恶系数，在预期收益与波动之间取折中，选“收益减风险惩罚”得分最高的组合。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: Uses the objective's risk aversion to trade expected return against volatility and picks the highest return-minus-risk-penalty score.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 先按声明的均值不确定区间把预期收益往下扣，再按同样的折中取得分最高的组合，比名义效用更保守。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: Haircuts expected returns by the declared mean uncertainty first, then applies the same trade-off; more conservative than nominal utility.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 在波动上限和全部约束内，选预期年收益最高的组合。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: The highest expected annual return within the volatility cap and all constraints.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 选（预期年收益 − 无风险利率）÷ 预期年波动最高的组合。无风险利率 {{p0}}，来源：{{p1}}。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: Highest (expected annual return − risk-free rate) ÷ expected annual volatility. Risk-free rate {{p0}}; source: {{p1}}.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 按长期假设模拟 {{p0}} 条、{{p1}} 个月的月度路径，选平均最大回撤最小的组合。这是模型估计，不是历史回撤。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: Simulates {{p0}} monthly paths over {{p1}} months from the long-term assumptions and picks the lowest mean max drawdown. A model estimate, not historical drawdown.

preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.zh-CN: 选风险贡献最接近你声明的风险预算的组合（有限搜索）。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.methodHel.en-US: The candidate whose risk contributions are closest to your declared risk budget (finite search).

preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeS.zh-CN: 研究范围中现金大类“{{p0}}”的预期年化收益
preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeS.en-US: expected annual return of the scope cash class "{{p0}}"

preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeR.zh-CN: 范围未设现金收益，采用风险标尺“{{p0}}”中现金大类“{{p1}}”的收益
preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeR.en-US: the scope sets no cash return, so the cash class "{{p1}}" in risk scale "{{p0}}" is used

preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeD.zh-CN: 范围和风险标尺都没有现金收益，默认按 0
preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskFreeD.en-US: neither the scope nor a risk scale gives a cash return, so 0 is used

preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskContr.zh-CN: 风险贡献保留正负号，负值表示分散作用；零方差时贡献未定义。风险预算距离是有符号贡献与目标的平方距离，有限搜索不保证精确匹配。
preInvestment.policyCandidates.riskContr.en-US: Risk contributions retain their signs; negative values indicate diversification. Contributions are undefined at zero variance. Risk budget distance is the squared distance between signed contributions and targets; a finite search does not guarantee an exact match.

policyFrontier.checkingTarget.zh-CN: 正在核验当前配置能否达到目标，请稍候。
policyFrontier.checkingTarget.en-US: Checking whether this configuration can meet the target. Please wait.

policyFrontier.blockedBounds.zh-CN: 权重、现金或流动性限制相互冲突，请调整下方配置或投资目标与约束。
policyFrontier.blockedBounds.en-US: Weight, cash or liquidity limits conflict. Adjust the configuration below or the investment objective and constraints.

policyFrontier.blockedTarget.zh-CN: 当前配置无法同时满足年收益至少 {{target}}、年化波动不超过 {{cap}}。请调整收益或风险目标，或更换大类配置、LTCMA。
policyFrontier.blockedTarget.en-US: This configuration cannot achieve an annual return of at least {{target}} with volatility no higher than {{cap}}. Review the return or risk target, asset allocation, or LTCMA.

policyFrontier.blockedRisk.zh-CN: 当前配置无法将年化波动控制在 {{cap}} 以内。请调整风险目标或大类配置。
policyFrontier.blockedRisk.en-US: This configuration cannot keep annual volatility within {{cap}}. Review the risk limit or asset allocation.

policyFrontier.blockedCommon.zh-CN: 不存在能同时满足所有已选 LTCMA 收益、风险及配置限制的同一组权重。请调整目标、配置或 LTCMA 选择。
policyFrontier.blockedCommon.en-US: No single set of weights satisfies the return, risk and allocation limits across all selected LTCMA models. Review the targets, allocation or selected models.

policyFrontier.targetUndetermined.zh-CN: 前沿尚未完成可达性验证。可重算上方前沿，或继续比较候选；这不表示目标不可达。
policyFrontier.targetUndetermined.en-US: Frontier feasibility is not yet verified. Recalculate the frontier above or continue comparing candidates; this does not mean the target is unreachable.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.unableToCal.zh-CN: 前沿暂时无法计算，请重试。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.unableToCal.en-US: Unable to calculate the frontier. Please retry.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.theHorizont.zh-CN: 横轴是年化波动，纵轴是预期年收益。目标收益{{p0}}，风险上限{{p1}}。目标区域位于收益线以上、风险线左侧。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.theHorizont.en-US: The horizontal axis is annual volatility; the vertical axis is expected annual return. Target return {{p0}}, risk limit {{p1}}. The target region is above the return line and left of the risk line.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.completeObj.zh-CN: 请先完成目标与 LTCMA 选择，并核对研究日。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.completeObj.en-US: Complete objective and LTCMA selection, then check the research date.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.calculating.zh-CN: 正在计算当前配置的有效前沿…
preInvestment.policyFrontier.calculating.en-US: Calculating the efficient frontier for this configuration…

preInvestment.policyFrontier.weightCashO.zh-CN: 当前权重与现金等约束相互冲突，无法形成配置前沿；虚线仍显示资产原本的配置空间。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.weightCashO.en-US: Weight, cash or other constraints conflict, so no constrained frontier can be formed. The dashed line still shows the original asset allocation space.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.theTargetAn.zh-CN: 目标年收益为 {{p0}}；当前约束下，即使暂不限制波动，收益上限也只有 {{p1}}，因此无法达到目标。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.theTargetAn.en-US: The target annual return is {{p0}}. Under current constraints, the return ceiling is only {{p1}} even without a volatility limit, so the target is unattainable.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.verifiedPoi.zh-CN: 当前约束前沿上存在进入目标区域的已验证点。是否可采纳，还需比较配置候选并完成其余目标检查。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.verifiedPoi.en-US: Verified points on the constrained frontier enter the target region. Adoption still requires candidate comparison and all remaining objective checks.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.noVerifiedF.zh-CN: 当前已验证前沿点未进入目标区域。请核对收益要求、风险上限与配置边界；求解未完成或点间空隙不能据此断言无解。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.noVerifiedF.en-US: No verified frontier point enters the target region. Review return requirements, risk limits and allocation bounds. Unfinished solving or gaps between points do not prove infeasibility.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.someFrontie.zh-CN: 部分前沿未求解成功，缺失位置不连线；不把缺失结果当作零收益或零风险。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.someFrontie.en-US: Some frontier points could not be solved. Gaps are not connected or treated as zero return or risk.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.theChartCom.zh-CN: 图表只比较年收益与波动；基准超额收益、主动风险和资金成功条件由候选计算另行检验，不将这些条件画成年收益目标点。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.theChartCom.en-US: The chart compares annual return and volatility only. Benchmark excess return, active risk and funding success conditions are checked separately for candidates, not plotted as annual-return target points.

preInvestment.policyFrontier.theChartUse.zh-CN: 图中使用本次选定的 LTCMA 假设；目标点是收益下限与风险上限的交点，不要求组合恰好落在该点。悬停曲线可查看具体收益与风险。
preInvestment.policyFrontier.theChartUse.en-US: The chart uses the selected LTCMA assumptions. The target point is the intersection of the return floor and risk limit; a portfolio need not sit exactly there. Hover over a curve for returns and risk.

preInvestment.riskBudgetEditor.enterANon.zh-CN: 请填写每项资产的非负风险预算；空白不代表零。
preInvestment.riskBudgetEditor.enterANon.en-US: Enter a nonnegative risk budget for each asset. Blank does not mean zero.

preInvestment.riskBudgetEditor.riskBudge.zh-CN: 风险预算百分比必须合计100%。

preInvestment.riskBudgetEditor.specifyEa.zh-CN: 填写希望各资产承担的风险比例。与原四类候选共用约束和有限搜索；距离最小不代表精确风险平价。
preInvestment.riskBudgetEditor.specifyEa.en-US: Specify each asset's desired risk share. Uses the same constraints and finite search as the original four candidates; minimum distance does not mean exact risk parity.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.unableToSave.en-US: Unable to save the SAA baseline.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.longTermPort.zh-CN: 长期组合：{{p0}} · 更换 / 新建

preInvestment.baselineSetup.whichLongTer.en-US: Which long-term portfolio is the starting point?

preInvestment.baselineSetup.lockSaaWeigh.zh-CN: 锁定 SAA 权重和资产范围，再研究临时调整。
preInvestment.baselineSetup.lockSaaWeigh.en-US: Lock SAA weights and asset scope, then research temporary adjustments.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.loadingSaaBa.zh-CN: 正在读取 SAA 基准…

preInvestment.baselineSetup.selectASaved.zh-CN: 请选择已保存的 SAA 基准

preInvestment.baselineSetup.defineTheLon.zh-CN: 先确定长期配置，再讨论偏离
preInvestment.baselineSetup.defineTheLon.en-US: Define the long-term allocation before deviations

preInvestment.baselineSetup.selectAndCar.zh-CN: 在 SAA 选择组合并带入，或从已有资产分类新建研究基准。这里不会预填合成收益。
preInvestment.baselineSetup.selectAndCar.en-US: Select and carry over a portfolio from SAA, or create a research baseline from existing asset classes. Synthetic returns are not prefilled.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.setLongTermW.zh-CN: 手动确定长期权重。保存后将冻结真实资产数据与产品映射；这一步不代表通过历史 PIT 验证。
preInvestment.baselineSetup.setLongTermW.en-US: Set long-term weights manually. Saving freezes actual asset data and product mappings; it does not certify historical PIT validity.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.buildAndSave.zh-CN: 请先在 SAA 中构建资产分类并保存。
preInvestment.baselineSetup.buildAndSave.en-US: Build and save asset classes in SAA first.

preInvestment.baselineSetup.returnToThis.zh-CN: 返回本次 SAA 方案

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterVali.zh-CN: 请填写有效的执行滞后、最小持有期和权重阈值。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterVali.en-US: Enter valid execution lag, minimum holding period and weight threshold.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.addAtLeas.zh-CN: 请添加至少一个有来源的信号分量。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.addAtLeas.en-US: Add at least one signal component with a source.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.theSignal.zh-CN: 信号定义不完整，请重新添加信号分量。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.theSignal.en-US: The signal definition is incomplete. Add the component again.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.signalWei.zh-CN: 各信号权重须完整且合计为 100%，缺失分量不会重新分配权重。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.signalWei.en-US: Signal weights must be complete and total 100%. Missing components do not redistribute weights.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterASou.zh-CN: 请填写每个信号的来源和研究标准化方法。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterASou.en-US: Enter a source and research normalization method for each signal.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterAVal.zh-CN: 请填写有效的观察窗口和信号有效期。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterAVal.en-US: Enter a valid observation window and signal validity period.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.externalS.zh-CN: 外部信号需要日期化的研究标准值，不能用净值替代。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.externalS.en-US: External signals require dated research scores; NAV cannot substitute for them.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.externalS.zh-CN: 外部信号须完整覆盖资产轴，标准值在 [-1, 1]，观察日 ≤ 可得日 ≤ 到期日。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.externalS.en-US: External signals must cover the full asset axis, use scores in [-1, 1], and satisfy observed date ≤ available date ≤ expiry date.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.datedScor.zh-CN: 日期化标准值（JSON 数组）

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.eachRowCo.zh-CN: 每行包含 observed_on、available_on、expires_on、values；values 以完整资产 ID 为键，数值范围 [-1, 1]，0 为中性。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.eachRowCo.en-US: Each row contains observed_on, available_on, expires_on and values. values must include every asset ID, with scores in [-1, 1]; zero is neutral.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.jsonIsInc.zh-CN: JSON 尚不完整，补全后才能计算。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.jsonIsInc.en-US: JSON is incomplete. Complete it before calculating.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.whenToDec.en-US: When to decide and when to adjust?

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.decisions.zh-CN: 决策更新目标；执行机会与滞后满足后才模拟交易。未交易时持仓随收益自然变化。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.decisions.en-US: Decisions update targets. Simulated trades occur only after execution opportunities and lags are satisfied. Otherwise holdings drift with returns.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.originalC.zh-CN: 原研究口径：每日恢复目标

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.retainsTh.zh-CN: 保留原日频目标与费用算法。旧版本按保存时口径阅读，复制为新研究后可更换。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.retainsTh.en-US: Retains the original daily-target and cost calculations. Saved versions use their frozen conventions; copy as new research to change them.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.weeklyMon.zh-CN: 周、月、季取周期首个已知共同观察点；共同净值日期不是交易所或基金申赎日历。费用分母独立设置；默认保持原半数绝对权重变化口径。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.weeklyMon.en-US: Weekly, monthly and quarterly schedules use the first known common observation in each period. Common NAV dates are not exchange or fund dealing calendars. Cost denominators are separate; the default remains half the absolute weight change.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.execution.zh-CN: 执行滞后、阈值与实际持仓时点
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.execution.en-US: Execution lag, thresholds and actual holdings dates

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.originalH.zh-CN: 原口径：半数绝对权重变化
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.originalH.en-US: Original: half the absolute weight change

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.twoSidedT.zh-CN: 双边成交：买入加卖出权重
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.twoSidedT.en-US: Two-sided turnover: buy plus sell weights

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.minimumHo.zh-CN: 最小持有期（共同观察期）

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.perAssetD.zh-CN: 单资产偏离阈值（百分点）

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.adjustWhe.zh-CN: 任一资产达到阈值（含等号）才调整；0 表示有差异就可调整。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.adjustWhe.en-US: Adjust when any asset reaches the threshold, including equality. Zero allows any nonzero difference to trigger adjustment.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterWeig.zh-CN: 权重在下方参考持仓中填写；时点必须等于研究日。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.enterWeig.en-US: Enter weights under reference holdings below. The snapshot date must equal the research date.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.requiredW.zh-CN: 启用最小持有期时必须填写。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.requiredW.en-US: Required when a minimum holding period is enabled.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.withoutAc.zh-CN: 缺少研究日实际持仓时，只能研究目标，不能判断阈值触发或交接交易；这里不会执行真实交易。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.withoutAc.en-US: Without actual holdings on the research date, only targets can be researched; threshold triggers and trading handoffs cannot be assessed. No actual trades are executed here.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.aMissingU.zh-CN: 。任一非零权重分量缺失、尚不可得或过期，则组合无效；不向其他信号转移权重。
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.aMissingU.en-US: . A missing, unavailable or expired nonzero-weight component invalidates the composite. Its weight is not transferred to other signals.

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.signalMax.zh-CN: 信号 {{p0}} 最长观察年龄（天）

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.signalNor.zh-CN: 信号 {{p0}} 标准化方法与依据

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.frozenNav.en-US: Frozen NAV window for this study

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.centerWin.zh-CN: 窗口收益中心化后按最大绝对偏差标准化；相同收益视为中性
preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.centerWin.en-US: Center window returns and normalize by maximum absolute deviation; equal returns are neutral

preInvestment.taaPolicySignals.upTo8Comp.en-US: Up to 8 components can be combined.

preInvestment.taaResearchContext.usesInd.zh-CN: 使用已保存研究范围中的指数、基金代理和现金收益假设；无需先配置实际交易产品。
preInvestment.taaResearchContext.usesInd.en-US: Uses indices, fund proxies and cash return assumptions from the saved scope; actual trading products need not be configured first.

preInvestment.taaResearchContext.usesSav.zh-CN: 使用 SAA 已保存的大类收益数据，研究相对战略权重的战术偏离。
preInvestment.taaResearchContext.usesSav.en-US: Uses saved SAA asset-class returns to research tactical deviations from strategic weights.

preInvestment.taaResearchContext.theRese.zh-CN: 当前研究日期与平台 PIT 冲突，请先处理上方日期提示。
preInvestment.taaResearchContext.theRese.en-US: The research date conflicts with platform PIT. Resolve the date notice above first.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.de.zh-CN: 按基金合同类型、投资类型、业绩基准与跟踪指数做确定性映射，直接输出所选层级的合同分类。大类个数由标签自然决定，是其它算法的对照基线。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.de.en-US: Deterministic mapping from fund contract type, investment type, benchmark and tracked index to the selected contract hierarchy. Labels determine the number of classes; this is a comparison baseline for other algorithms.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ag.zh-CN: 在收益相关性距离上做凝聚层次聚类。默认选项：无需初值、结果确定，且“为什么这两个产品在一起”可以回溯到合并树。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ag.en-US: Agglomerative hierarchical clustering on return-correlation distances. The default is deterministic, requires no initialization, and explains product groupings through the merge tree.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.zh-CN: 以真实产品作为类中心，每个大类天然得到一只代表产品，适合直接拿来做大类代理。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.en-US: Uses actual products as class centers, naturally selecting one representative per class for use as an asset proxy.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ce.zh-CN: 在标准化特征空间上做质心聚类。速度快，但类中心是虚拟点，对特征量纲更敏感。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ce.en-US: Centroid clustering in standardized feature space. Fast, but centers are synthetic points and more sensitive to feature scales.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.tr.zh-CN: 把相关性距离变成图，按归一化割在特征向量空间上切分。不假设类是圆的：从沪深300一路过渡到创业板的产品链会留在同一类，而不是被半径切开。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.tr.en-US: Transforms correlation distances into a graph and applies normalized cuts in eigenspace. Classes need not be spherical: a chain from CSI 300 to ChiNext products can remain together instead of being split by radius.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ga.zh-CN: 高斯混合 + EM，每个大类有自己的形状与松紧程度，输出的是归属概率而非硬标签。适合边界模糊、货币类很紧而主题类很散的产品池。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ga.en-US: Gaussian mixture with EM gives each class its own shape and dispersion, producing membership probabilities rather than hard labels. Useful for fuzzy boundaries and pools mixing tightly clustered money-market products with dispersed thematic products.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.zh-CN: 用日收益相关性距离 √(0.5(1-ρ))。大类资产的本质是同涨同跌，这是最贴合的度量。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.en-US: Uses daily return correlation distance √(0.5(1−ρ)). Co-movement is central to asset classes, making this a natural measure.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.zh-CN: 同样是相关性距离，但先用随机矩阵理论（Marchenko-Pastur）把落在噪声带内的特征值抹平，只留系统性模式。产品多、样本短时最有用。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.us.en-US: Uses correlation distance after random-matrix denoising (Marchenko–Pastur): flattens eigenvalues in the noise band and retains systematic patterns. Most useful with many products and short samples.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.eu.zh-CN: 用收益、波动、回撤、夏普、卡玛、折溢价与成交额画像做欧氏距离。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.eu.en-US: Euclidean distance on profiles of return, volatility, drawdown, Sharpe, Calmar, premiums/discounts and turnover value.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.de.zh-CN: 对相关矩阵做特征分解，用前几个主成分载荷聚类，识别共同的系统性驱动。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.de.en-US: Decomposes the correlation matrix and clusters leading principal-component loadings to identify common systematic drivers.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.cl.zh-CN: 风险收益画像与主成分载荷拼接后聚类。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.cl.en-US: Clusters combined risk/return profiles and principal-component loadings.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.li.zh-CN: 仅层次聚类需要连接方式，该算法不读取此项
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.li.en-US: Linkage is used only by hierarchical clustering; this algorithm ignores it

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ru.zh-CN: 规则映射本身就按合同分类，再分层没有意义
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ru.en-US: Rule mapping already uses contract categories; additional stratification is unnecessary

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.co.zh-CN: 规则映射的大类个数由合同标签自然决定
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.co.en-US: Contract labels determine the number of rule-mapped classes

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.cl.zh-CN: 只按净值行为聚类。相关性窗口可能把黄金 ETF 和权益 ETF 放进同一类。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.cl.en-US: Clusters NAV behavior only. A correlation window may put gold and equity ETFs in the same class.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ke.zh-CN: 权益/固收/商品/货币/海外/混合 之间不可混合，统计聚类只在同一资产大类内部细分。做 SAA 时的推荐口径。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.ke.en-US: Keeps equities, fixed income, commodities, money markets, overseas and mixed assets separate. Statistical clustering subdivides within each class. Recommended for SAA.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.al.zh-CN: 在资产大类之下再锁定二级类型（宽基规模/风格因子/行业/主题、利率债/信用债/可转债/同业存单…），聚类只区分同一类型内的差异。
preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.al.en-US: Also fixes second-level types within asset classes (broad market/style/sector/theme; rates/credit/convertibles/certificates of deposit, etc.), clustering only differences within each type.

preInvestment.autoAssetClassification.fi.zh-CN: 锁定到三级明细（大小盘、红利/低波/价值、八大行业、六大主题、国债/城投债…）。层级越细，块越多、每块可拆的类越少。

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.checkRiskAve.zh-CN: 请检查风险厌恶系数、τ（均须为有限正数）与无风险收益。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.checkRiskAve.en-US: Check risk aversion and τ (finite and positive), and the risk-free return.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.basketViewsN.zh-CN: 篮子观点须使用不重复、有效的资产和有限系数。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.basketViewsN.en-US: Basket views need unique valid assets and finite coefficients.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.absoluteBask.zh-CN: 篮子绝对观点系数合计为1，相对观点为0；不能全零，绝对值合计不超过4。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.absoluteBask.en-US: Absolute basket-view coefficients must sum to 1; relative views to 0. They cannot all be zero, and absolute coefficients must total no more than 4.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.eachViewNeed.zh-CN: 每条观点须指定有效资产；相对观点须选择另一资产。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.eachViewNeed.en-US: Each view needs valid assets. Relative views must select a different second asset.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.enterValidVi.zh-CN: 请填写有效观点收益与严格为正、可计算的观点标准差。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.enterValidVi.en-US: Enter valid view returns and a strictly positive, computable view standard deviation.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.viewsNeedEvi.zh-CN: 观点须有依据，且满足观察日 ≤ 可得日 ≤ 研究日。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.viewsNeedEvi.en-US: Views need evidence and must satisfy observation date ≤ availability date ≤ research date.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.add160Explic.zh-CN: 请添加1至60个明确情景，再填写概率和假设。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.add160Explic.en-US: Add 1–60 explicit scenarios, then enter probabilities and assumptions.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.scenarioProb.zh-CN: 情景概率须明确、非负并合计100%；不会自动归一化。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.scenarioProb.en-US: Scenario probabilities must be explicit, nonnegative and total 100%. No automatic normalization.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.chooseShared.zh-CN: 请选择共用或逐情景风险，并完整填写对应协方差。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.chooseShared.en-US: Choose shared or per-scenario risk and complete the corresponding covariance matrices.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.everyScenari.zh-CN: 每个情景须有名称与至少3字的依据。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.everyScenari.en-US: Every scenario needs a name and rationale of at least 3 characters.

preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.everyScenari.zh-CN: 每个情景须覆盖所有资产，年化收益范围为 -50% 至 200%。
preInvestment.cmaModelTypes.everyScenari.en-US: Every scenario must cover all assets, with annual returns between -50% and 200%.

preInvestment.customIndicators.calculati.zh-CN: 计算计划尚未准备完成。

preInvestment.mandateTypes.riskAuthoriza.zh-CN: 风险授权或独立验证记录不完整，请重新诊断。
preInvestment.mandateTypes.riskAuthoriza.en-US: Risk authorization or independent validation records are incomplete. Rerun the diagnosis.

preInvestment.portfolioResearch.historic.zh-CN: 组合历史情景条件统计

preInvestment.regimeGraph.theCurrentBack.zh-CN: 当前后端版本不支持{{p0}}，请更新并重启后端服务后重试。
preInvestment.regimeGraph.theCurrentBack.en-US: The current backend does not support {{p0}}. Update and restart the backend, then retry.

preInvestment.regimeGraph.batchExperimen.zh-CN: 批量实验必须引用已保存的精确定义版本。
preInvestment.regimeGraph.batchExperimen.en-US: Batch experiments must reference an exact saved definition version.

preInvestment.regimeGraph.aSavedDefiniti.zh-CN: 保存修订版前需要已保存的定义 ID 与 revision。
preInvestment.regimeGraph.aSavedDefiniti.en-US: A saved definition ID and revision are required before saving a revision.

preInvestment.regimeGraph.nodeResultPagi.zh-CN: 节点结果分页不完整或与当前预览不一致，请重新预览。
preInvestment.regimeGraph.nodeResultPagi.en-US: Node result pagination is incomplete or differs from the current preview. Preview again.

preInvestment.regimeGraph.formalRunsMust.zh-CN: 正式运行必须引用已保存的精确定义版本。
preInvestment.regimeGraph.formalRunsMust.en-US: Formal runs must reference an exact saved definition version.

preInvestment.regimeGraph.historicalRegi.zh-CN: 历史情景正式运行比较

preInvestment.riskModels.theServiceRetur.zh-CN: 服务没有返回可读取的研究数据，请检查后端连接。
preInvestment.riskModels.theServiceRetur.en-US: The service returned unreadable research data. Check the backend connection.

preInvestment.riskModels.researchOperati.zh-CN: 研究操作未完成，请检查输入与数据。
preInvestment.riskModels.researchOperati.en-US: Research operation did not complete. Check inputs and data.

preInvestment.strategyWeights.equalWeigh.zh-CN: 等权计算服务返回了无效响应（{{p0}}）
preInvestment.strategyWeights.equalWeigh.en-US: Equal-weight service returned an invalid response ({{p0}})

preInvestment.strategyWeights.theReturne.zh-CN: 等权计算服务返回的权重向量无效或资产数量不一致
preInvestment.strategyWeights.theReturne.en-US: The returned equal-weight vector is invalid or differs from the asset count

preInvestment.strategyWeights.theEqualWe.zh-CN: 等权计算服务未通过固定签名 NJIT 执行校验
preInvestment.strategyWeights.theEqualWe.en-US: The equal-weight service failed fixed-signature NJIT execution validation

preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.noPara.zh-CN: 未覆盖参数，使用冻结定义中的默认参数。
preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.noPara.en-US: No parameter overrides; defaults from the frozen definition are used.

preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.comple.zh-CN: 个已完成信号。样本外不重训，效用是训练选择依据，不是收益预测。
preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.comple.en-US: completed signals. No out-of-sample retraining. Utility is a training selection criterion, not a return forecast.

preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.noAvai.zh-CN: 没有可用的冻结选择，请检查训练样本与约束。
preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.noAvai.en-US: No available frozen selections. Check training samples and constraints.

preInvestment.timingTrainingAudit.viewCa.zh-CN: 查看候选方案训练对比

preInvestment.messages.selectAPublishedP.zh-CN: 请选择已发布产品暴露模型。
preInvestment.messages.selectAPublishedP.en-US: Select a published product exposure model.

preInvestment.messages.thePublishedScena.zh-CN: 现有发布情景尚未定义现金项，本次不自动删除现金并重分配风险持仓。
preInvestment.messages.thePublishedScena.en-US: The published scenario does not define cash. Cash will not be removed or risk holdings reweighted automatically.

preInvestment.messages.deterministicBuyA.zh-CN: 确定性买入持有压力诊断；不赋予场景概率，未计入交易费或残差风险。
preInvestment.messages.deterministicBuyA.en-US: Deterministic buy-and-hold stress diagnostic, without scenario probabilities, trading fees or residual risk.

preInvestment.messages.implementationRes.zh-CN: 已有实施研究正在计算，请稍后重试。
preInvestment.messages.implementationRes.en-US: Implementation research is already running. Retry later.

preInvestment.messages.aProductReference.en-US: A product references an unknown asset class.

preInvestment.messages.insufficientProdu.en-US: Insufficient product capacity within the class.

preInvestment.messages.thisCandidateSolv.zh-CN: 此候选求解未收敛，不能据此认定所有产品方案无解。
preInvestment.messages.thisCandidateSolv.en-US: This candidate solver did not converge; it does not prove all product allocations infeasible.

preInvestment.messages.historicalTeCandi.zh-CN: 历史 TE 候选仍按同一产品风险和单／A／B 门禁验收，不是多模型 QCQP 全局最优证明。
preInvestment.messages.historicalTeCandi.en-US: Historical TE candidates still face the same product risk and single/A/B checks; this is not proof of global multi-model QCQP optimality.

preInvestment.messages.theCopySourceMust.zh-CN: 复制来源必须是已保存的研究包版本。
preInvestment.messages.theCopySourceMust.en-US: The copy source must be a saved research package version.

preInvestment.messages.theCandidateOrRes.zh-CN: 候选或研究包已更新，请刷新后重新验证。
preInvestment.messages.theCandidateOrRes.en-US: The candidate or research package changed. Refresh and validate again.

preInvestment.messages.thisPackageIsFina.zh-CN: 此研究包已定稿，请复制重研。
preInvestment.messages.thisPackageIsFina.en-US: This package is finalized. Copy it for new research.

preInvestment.messages.theLockedCandidat.zh-CN: 候选锁定后已被新版本替代，本报告不能放行当前方案。
preInvestment.messages.theLockedCandidat.en-US: The locked candidate was superseded. This report cannot authorize the current plan.

preInvestment.messages.candidateValidati.zh-CN: 用户明确登记候选验证运行
preInvestment.messages.candidateValidati.en-US: Candidate validation run explicitly recorded by the user

preInvestment.messages.calculationOrSavi.zh-CN: 计算或保存失败，原始候选仍保留
preInvestment.messages.calculationOrSavi.en-US: Calculation or saving failed; the original candidate is retained

preInvestment.messages.calculationCodeCh.zh-CN: 计算代码已变化，请重新验证新版本。
preInvestment.messages.calculationCodeCh.en-US: Calculation code changed. Validate a new version.

preInvestment.messages.theCalculationEnv.zh-CN: 计算运行环境已变化，请重新验证新版本。
preInvestment.messages.theCalculationEnv.en-US: The calculation environment changed. Validate a new version.

preInvestment.messages.historicalInputSn.zh-CN: 历史输入快照已变化，请复制重研。
preInvestment.messages.historicalInputSn.en-US: Historical input snapshots changed. Copy for new research.

preInvestment.messages.theResearchPackag.en-US: The research package is due for review.

preInvestment.messages.reportFingerprint.zh-CN: 报告指纹不匹配，或尚未完成锁定候选验证。
preInvestment.messages.reportFingerprint.en-US: Report fingerprint mismatch, or locked-candidate validation is incomplete.

preInvestment.messages.notesCannotOverri.zh-CN: 硬约束失败或完整性缺失，不能通过备注放行。
preInvestment.messages.notesCannotOverri.en-US: Notes cannot override failed hard constraints or missing evidence.

preInvestment.messages.theNextReviewDate.zh-CN: 下次复核日期须晚于今天。
preInvestment.messages.theNextReviewDate.en-US: The next review date must be later than today.

preInvestment.messages.researchInputsRes.zh-CN:
冻结研究输入、结果及数组。当前应用资格单独记录；代码指纹含未提交工作树。
不是交易指令、PIT 认证或机构独立审批。
preInvestment.messages.researchInputsRes.en-US:
Research inputs, results and arrays are frozen. Current eligibility is recorded separately; code fingerprints include uncommitted work.
This is not a trading instruction, PIT certification or independent institutional approval.

preInvestment.messages.elapsedPeriodsExc.zh-CN: 已过期数不能超过原计划期限，请确认新目标版本。
preInvestment.messages.elapsedPeriodsExc.en-US: Elapsed periods exceed the original horizon. Confirm a new objective version.

preInvestment.messages.theBalanceDateIsN.zh-CN: 余额日不在原计划模型月边界；须先提供日期适配，不能取整剩余年数。
preInvestment.messages.theBalanceDateIsN.en-US: The balance date is not an original model-month boundary. Provide date alignment first; remaining years cannot be rounded.

preInvestment.messages.theReconciliation.zh-CN: 核对记录不属于冻结的原预算。
preInvestment.messages.theReconciliation.en-US: The reconciliation record does not belong to the frozen original budget.

preInvestment.messages.reconcileEveryDue.zh-CN: 请核对每笔已到期现金流；日期已过不代表已支付。
preInvestment.messages.reconcileEveryDue.en-US: Reconcile every due cash flow. A passed date does not prove payment.

preInvestment.messages.earlyPaymentsRequ.zh-CN: 提前支付需调整原预算版本，不能在月末适配中隐式移期。
preInvestment.messages.earlyPaymentsRequ.en-US: Early payments require revising the original budget; month-end alignment cannot silently move them.

preInvestment.messages.paidPartiallyPaid.zh-CN: 已付、部分支付或未付状态与金额不一致。
preInvestment.messages.paidPartiallyPaid.en-US: Paid, partially paid or unpaid status does not match amounts.

preInvestment.messages.investableValueAf.zh-CN: 费用后可投资价值为负，不支持融资续算。
preInvestment.messages.investableValueAf.en-US: Investable value after costs is negative. Financed continuation is unsupported.

preInvestment.messages.implementationCos.zh-CN: 实施成本计算尚未完成本进程预热。
preInvestment.messages.implementationCos.en-US: Implementation cost kernels have not completed process warmup.

preInvestment.messages.productPathKernel.zh-CN: 产品路径计算尚未完成本进程预热。
preInvestment.messages.productPathKernel.en-US: Product path kernels have not completed process warmup.

preInvestment.messages.confirmTheSensiti.zh-CN: 请确认未来使用声明费率不变的费用敏感性假设；当前费率不自动适用于整个未来期限。
preInvestment.messages.confirmTheSensiti.en-US: Confirm the sensitivity assumption that declared fees remain unchanged. Current rates do not automatically apply throughout the future horizon.

preInvestment.messages.futureOtcFundDeal.zh-CN: 场外基金的未来申赎依赖持有期费率表；当前单一费率仅用于本次调整和历史敏感性回放。
preInvestment.messages.futureOtcFundDeal.en-US: Future OTC fund dealing depends on holding-period fee schedules. A single current rate is used only for this adjustment and historical sensitivity replay.

preInvestment.messages.confirmSynchronou.zh-CN: 产品路径需逐项确认模型月末可同步结算及依据；有延迟或未知条款时不能假定即时到账。
preInvestment.messages.confirmSynchronou.en-US: Confirm synchronous model-month-end settlement and evidence for every product. Delayed or unknown terms cannot be treated as instant cash.

preInvestment.messages.productLevelPayme.zh-CN: 逐产品付款路径需要一个明确的现金项目，不能用总市值代替现金。
preInvestment.messages.productLevelPayme.en-US: Product-level payment paths require an explicit cash item. Total market value cannot substitute for cash.

preInvestment.messages.zeroPeriodsRemain.zh-CN: 剩余 0 期，只核对终值及未付事实。
preInvestment.messages.zeroPeriodsRemain.en-US: Zero periods remain; only terminal value and unpaid facts are checked.

preInvestment.messages.productPathArrays.zh-CN: 产品路径数组超过 64MB，请减少路径数或缩短研究期限。
preInvestment.messages.productPathArrays.en-US: Product path arrays exceed 64 MB. Reduce paths or shorten the horizon.

preInvestment.messages.perModelProductPa.zh-CN: 逐模型产品路径超过计算预算，请减少路径数、产品数或剩余期限。
preInvestment.messages.perModelProductPa.en-US: Per-model product paths exceed the computation budget. Reduce paths, products or remaining periods.

preInvestment.messages.jointLognormalAnn.zh-CN: 联合对数正态年度矩匹配，月度独立增量。
preInvestment.messages.jointLognormalAnn.en-US: Joint lognormal annual moment matching with independent monthly increments.

preInvestment.messages.modelMonthEndOrde.zh-CN: 交易、入金、支付按模型月末先到账、再调仓、再支付。
preInvestment.messages.modelMonthEndOrde.en-US: Model-month-end ordering: funds arrive, then rebalance, then pay.

preInvestment.messages.futureFeesRemainA.zh-CN: 未来交易费按当前声明费率不变作敏感性研究，不是全期限费率已获确认。
preInvestment.messages.futureFeesRemainA.en-US: Future fees remain at current declared rates for sensitivity research; full-horizon fee validity is not confirmed.

preInvestment.messages.buyAndHoldDoesNot.zh-CN: 买入持有不自动卖出补足现金；月度再平衡仍可能出现支付现金不足。
preInvestment.messages.buyAndHoldDoesNot.en-US: Buy-and-hold does not automatically sell to replenish cash. Monthly rebalancing can still leave payment shortfalls.

preInvestment.messages.confirmedSameMont.zh-CN: 逐产品已确认同月结算是模型适用前提，不认证盘中成交、延期或暂停情景。
preInvestment.messages.confirmedSameMont.en-US: Confirmed same-month settlement per product is a model prerequisite, not certification of intraday execution, delays or suspensions.

preInvestment.messages.adjustedNavIsARet.zh-CN: 复权净值是收益代理，不是可成交价格；费用为声明费率的研究估计。
preInvestment.messages.adjustedNavIsARet.en-US: Adjusted NAV is a return proxy, not an executable price. Costs are research estimates using declared rates.

preInvestment.messages.d0IsAForwardLooki.zh-CN: D=0 是前瞻模型假设，历史残差正交不证明未来正交。
preInvestment.messages.d0IsAForwardLooki.en-US: D=0 is a forward-looking assumption. Historical residual orthogonality does not prove future orthogonality.

preInvestment.messages.historicalPitAndC.zh-CN: 历史 PIT 与认证独立复核未验证，研究定稿不代表交易授权。
preInvestment.messages.historicalPitAndC.en-US: Historical PIT and certified independent review remain unverified. Finalized research is not trading authorization.

preInvestment.messages.policyObjectiveCm.zh-CN: 已核对政策、目标、CMA、产品域及映射版本。
preInvestment.messages.policyObjectiveCm.en-US: Policy, objective, CMA, product universe and mapping versions checked.

preInvestment.messages.productWeightsMus.zh-CN: 产品权重须合计 100%，并逐类匹配来源预算。
preInvestment.messages.productWeightsMus.en-US: Product weights must total 100% and match each source class budget.

preInvestment.messages.fundingItemsMatch.zh-CN: 各资金项目与确认总价值一致，组合外储备未重复扣除。
preInvestment.messages.fundingItemsMatch.en-US: Funding items match confirmed total value; external reserves are not deducted twice.

preInvestment.messages.alignedJointRegre.zh-CN: 同轴联合回归、独立时间留出和完整残差协方差已计算。
preInvestment.messages.alignedJointRegre.en-US: Aligned joint regression, independent time holdout and full residual covariance calculated.

preInvestment.messages.productVolatility.zh-CN: 产品波动、相对 SAA 总主动风险及适用基准约束通过。
preInvestment.messages.productVolatility.en-US: Product volatility, total active risk versus SAA and applicable benchmark constraints passed.

preInvestment.messages.proxyCmaAndProduc.zh-CN: 已声明代理、CMA 和产品收益口径一致；历史截距不作为未来主动收益。
preInvestment.messages.proxyCmaAndProduc.en-US: Proxy, CMA and product return conventions are declared consistent. Historical intercepts are not future active returns.

preInvestment.messages.confirmReturnConv.zh-CN: 请确认收益口径；确认前只显示风险，不生成资金成功率。
preInvestment.messages.confirmReturnConv.en-US: Confirm return conventions. Until then, only risk is shown, without funding success probabilities.

preInvestment.messages.initialEstablishm.zh-CN: 首次建仓和每边成交收费，扣费后金额与目标权重已对账。
preInvestment.messages.initialEstablishm.en-US: Initial establishment and each trade side incur costs. Post-cost amounts reconcile to target weights.

preInvestment.messages.registeredEventsS.zh-CN: 已登记事件未出现日末资金缺口。
preInvestment.messages.registeredEventsS.en-US: Registered events show no end-of-day cash shortfall.

preInvestment.messages.actualExecutionAn.zh-CN: 实际执行与全期付款日历
preInvestment.messages.actualExecutionAn.en-US: Actual execution and full payment calendar

preInvestment.messages.registeredDatesAn.zh-CN: 已登记日期与模型月末路径分别有效；尚未覆盖全期实际交收、盘中截止、申赎暂停、整数份额及成交容量。
preInvestment.messages.registeredDatesAn.en-US: Registered dates and model-month-end paths are separately valid. Full-horizon settlement, intraday cutoffs, dealing suspensions, whole units and capacity are not covered.

preInvestment.messages.originalBudgetOcc.zh-CN: 原预算发生额已核对，逾期和漏付事实独立保留。
preInvestment.messages.originalBudgetOcc.en-US: Original budget occurrences are reconciled; overdue and missed-payment facts remain separate.

preInvestment.messages.theOriginalPlanHa.en-US: The original plan has missed payments

preInvestment.messages.continuationSucce.zh-CN: 续算成功率不能消除过去漏付；当前研究须保留此事实。
preInvestment.messages.continuationSucce.en-US: Continuation success probabilities do not erase missed payments; this fact must remain in the study.

preInvestment.messages.theFrozenObjectiv.zh-CN: 冻结投资目标没有资金预算，未新增概率要求。
preInvestment.messages.theFrozenObjectiv.en-US: The frozen objective has no funding budget; no probability requirement is added.

preInvestment.messages.withZeroPeriodsRe.zh-CN: 剩余 0 期，直接核对已确认余额、原目标与未付款，不生成模拟成功率。
preInvestment.messages.withZeroPeriodsRe.en-US: With zero periods remaining, directly compare confirmed balances, original targets and unpaid amounts. No simulated success probability is generated.

preInvestment.messages.perModelContinuat.zh-CN: 逐模型续算超过 2000 万路径月，请减少模拟路径数。
preInvestment.messages.perModelContinuat.en-US: Per-model continuation exceeds 20 million path-months. Reduce simulation paths.

preInvestment.messages.aScalarProxyForAn.zh-CN: 任意剩余整月的标量代理；逐模型 Wilson 区间不是全部模型联合置信。
preInvestment.messages.aScalarProxyForAn.en-US: A scalar proxy for any remaining whole months. Per-model Wilson intervals are not joint confidence across all models.

preInvestment.messages.requiresCompleteC.zh-CN: 需完整费用与暴露、收益和期限口径确认，并选择月度标量代理。逐产品路径规则需单独验证。
preInvestment.messages.requiresCompleteC.en-US: Requires complete costs and exposures, confirmed return/horizon conventions and selection of the monthly scalar proxy. Product path rules require separate validation.

preInvestment.messages.productLevelPaths.zh-CN: 本次由逐产品路径承接资金检验。
preInvestment.messages.productLevelPaths.en-US: Product-level paths provide the funding assessment for this study.

preInvestment.messages.computesProductRe.zh-CN: 按明确的模型月末结算条款，逐产品计算收益、漂移、费用、现金支付和永久漏付标记。
preInvestment.messages.computesProductRe.en-US: Computes product returns, drift, fees, cash payments and permanent missed-payment flags under explicit model-month-end settlement terms.

preInvestment.messages.selectProductHold.zh-CN: 选择逐产品持有规则并补齐现金项目、费用及结算条款后可运行；标量续算不替代此验证。
preInvestment.messages.selectProductHold.en-US: Select product holding rules and complete cash, fees and settlement terms to run. Scalar continuation does not replace this validation.

preInvestment.messages.aNamedLocalResear.zh-CN: 本地具名研究记录不构成机构认证独立审批。
preInvestment.messages.aNamedLocalResear.en-US: A named local research record is not certified independent institutional approval.

preInvestment.messages.frozenSourcesDoNo.zh-CN: 本次冻结来源不能证明历史时点已可得。
preInvestment.messages.frozenSourcesDoNo.en-US: Frozen sources do not prove historical point-in-time availability.

preInvestment.messages.thisProcessHasNoP.zh-CN: 当前进程尚未接入匹配此产品轴的已发布情景适配。
preInvestment.messages.thisProcessHasNoP.en-US: This process has no published-scenario adapter matching the product axis.

preInvestment.messages.sourceFingerprint.zh-CN: 来源指纹不匹配，请重新选择原始版本。
preInvestment.messages.sourceFingerprint.en-US: Source fingerprint mismatch. Select the original version again.

preInvestment.messages.theSourceLacksCon.zh-CN: 来源缺少已确认的投资目标与长期政策，请先确认 SAA。
preInvestment.messages.theSourceLacksCon.en-US: The source lacks confirmed objectives and long-term policy. Confirm SAA first.

preInvestment.messages.implementationRes.zh-CN: 实施研究日不能早于来源。
preInvestment.messages.implementationRes.en-US: Implementation research date must not precede the source.

preInvestment.messages.taaMustUseItsFroz.zh-CN: TAA 应使用决策冻结的映射；更换映射须重新确认 TAA。
preInvestment.messages.taaMustUseItsFroz.en-US: TAA must use its frozen decision mapping. Changing it requires reconfirming TAA.

preInvestment.messages.thisPolicyDefines.zh-CN: 此政策未定义独立战略范围，不能添加不相关映射。
preInvestment.messages.thisPolicyDefines.en-US: This policy defines no independent strategic scope; unrelated mappings cannot be added.

preInvestment.messages.implementationMap.zh-CN: 实施映射与政策的战略范围不一致。
preInvestment.messages.implementationMap.en-US: Implementation mapping does not match the policy's strategic scope.

preInvestment.messages.sourceBudgetsAndA.zh-CN: 来源预算与资产轴不一致。
preInvestment.messages.sourceBudgetsAndA.en-US: Source budgets and asset axes differ.

preInvestment.messages.frozenLongTermAss.zh-CN: 长期假设冻结指纹不一致。

preInvestment.messages.thePolicyIsDueFor.zh-CN: 政策已到复核日，请重新确认。
preInvestment.messages.thePolicyIsDueFor.en-US: The policy is due for review. Reconfirm it.

preInvestment.messages.productImplementa.zh-CN: 产品实施计算尚未完成本进程预热。
preInvestment.messages.productImplementa.en-US: Product implementation kernels have not completed process warmup.

preInvestment.messages.completeValidBuyS.zh-CN: 请补齐有效买卖费率、收费基数、来源及 NAV 费用覆盖：
preInvestment.messages.completeValidBuyS.en-US: Complete valid buy/sell rates, fee bases, sources and NAV cost coverage:

preInvestment.messages.additionalAnnualF.zh-CN: 附加年费须注明来源，并确认未被 NAV 或原资金预算包含。
preInvestment.messages.additionalAnnualF.en-US: Additional annual fees need a source and confirmation they are absent from NAV and the original funding budget.

preInvestment.messages.productMarketValu.zh-CN: 产品市值＋可支付现金＋受限现金＋应收－应付与确认的可投资总价值不一致。组合外储备不再扣除。
preInvestment.messages.productMarketValu.en-US: Product market value + available cash + restricted cash + receivables − payables differs from confirmed investable value. External reserves are not deducted again.

preInvestment.messages.theCashItemSCurre.zh-CN: 现金项目的当前金额须与可支付现金一致，不能重复计入。
preInvestment.messages.theCashItemSCurre.en-US: The cash item's current amount must equal available cash, without double counting.

preInvestment.messages.forRestrictedCash.zh-CN: 含受限现金或未结算应收应付时，请先制定分期实施方案；当前连续目标不能提前使用这些余额。
preInvestment.messages.forRestrictedCash.en-US: For restricted cash or unsettled receivables/payables, prepare a phased implementation plan. Current continuous targets cannot use these balances early.

preInvestment.messages.ifAdjustmentCosts.zh-CN: 声明本次调整费用已计入余额时，当前持仓必须已达到目标权重；尚待执行的调整不能视为已付费。
preInvestment.messages.ifAdjustmentCosts.en-US: If adjustment costs are declared included in balances, holdings must already match targets. Pending adjustments cannot be treated as paid.

preInvestment.messages.cashEventsBeforeT.zh-CN: 余额日前的现金事件应先纳入确认余额，不能再次入账。
preInvestment.messages.cashEventsBeforeT.en-US: Cash events before the balance date must be incorporated in confirmed balances, not booked again.

preInvestment.messages.onlyRegisteredDat.zh-CN: 只核对已登记的日期事件；尚未认证未来所有赎回、支付及盘中截止时间。
preInvestment.messages.onlyRegisteredDat.en-US: Only registered dated events are checked. All future redemptions, payments and intraday cutoffs remain uncertified.

preInvestment.messages.balanceDateKnowle.zh-CN: 余额日不得晚于知识截止日，知识截止日不得晚于今天。
preInvestment.messages.balanceDateKnowle.en-US: Balance date ≤ knowledge cutoff ≤ today is required.

preInvestment.messages.eachPaymentOccurr.zh-CN: 同一支付发生额只能核对一次。
preInvestment.messages.eachPaymentOccurr.en-US: Each payment occurrence can be reconciled only once.

preInvestment.messages.cashEventIdentifi.zh-CN: 现金事件标识不得重复。
preInvestment.messages.cashEventIdentifi.en-US: Cash event identifiers must be unique.

preInvestment.messages.historicalStartMu.zh-CN: 历史开始日须早于研究日，研究日不能晚于今天。
preInvestment.messages.historicalStartMu.en-US: Historical start must precede the research date, which must not exceed today.

preInvestment.messages.fundingStateAndRe.zh-CN: 资金状态和研究包必须使用同一知识截止日。
preInvestment.messages.fundingStateAndRe.en-US: Funding state and research package must share a knowledge cutoff.

preInvestment.messages.searchAndIndepend.zh-CN: 搜索与独立验证必须采用不同随机流。
preInvestment.messages.searchAndIndepend.en-US: Search and independent validation must use different random streams.

preInvestment.messages.productsMustBeUni.zh-CN: 产品不可重复，现金最多一个独立项目。
preInvestment.messages.productsMustBeUni.en-US: Products must be unique; at most one separate cash item is allowed.

preInvestment.messages.doesNotBelongToAC.zh-CN: {{p0}} 不属于冻结映射的大类，请先确认产品归属。
preInvestment.messages.doesNotBelongToAC.en-US: {{p0}} does not belong to a class in the frozen mapping. Confirm its classification first.

preInvestment.messages.cashMustBelongToT.zh-CN: 现金必须归属于政策中的流动性大类。
preInvestment.messages.cashMustBelongToT.en-US: Cash must belong to the policy's liquidity class.

preInvestment.messages.605000IdenticalDa.zh-CN: 需要 60–5000 个产品与代理共享的相同日收益区间；缺失不补零。
preInvestment.messages.605000IdenticalDa.en-US: 60–5000 identical daily return intervals shared by products and proxies are required. Missing values are not zero-filled.

preInvestment.messages.atLeastOneNonCash.zh-CN: 至少需要一个非现金研究因子与产品。
preInvestment.messages.atLeastOneNonCash.en-US: At least one non-cash research factor and product are required.

preInvestment.messages.jointExposureTrai.zh-CN: 联合暴露的训练或留出验证未通过；请扩大样本或复核代理，不会填零或加岭修补。
preInvestment.messages.jointExposureTrai.en-US: Joint exposure training or holdout validation failed. Extend the sample or review proxies; no zero filling or ridge repair is applied.

preInvestment.messages.productPortfolioE.zh-CN: 产品组合的实际预期波动超过授权上限。
preInvestment.messages.productPortfolioE.en-US: Product portfolio expected volatility exceeds the authorized limit.

preInvestment.messages.totalActiveRiskVe.zh-CN: 相对 SAA 的总主动风险超过授权上限。
preInvestment.messages.totalActiveRiskVe.en-US: Total active risk versus SAA exceeds the authorized limit.

preInvestment.messages.productBridgedExp.zh-CN: 产品桥接预期收益低于授权下限。
preInvestment.messages.productBridgedExp.en-US: Product-bridged expected return is below the authorized floor.

preInvestment.messages.productActiveRisk.zh-CN: 产品相对授权基准的主动风险超过上限。
preInvestment.messages.productActiveRisk.en-US: Product active risk versus the authorized benchmark exceeds the limit.

preInvestment.messages.productReturnRela.zh-CN: 产品相对授权基准的收益低于目标。
preInvestment.messages.productReturnRela.en-US: Product return relative to the authorized benchmark misses the target.

preInvestment.messages.researchPackageNo.zh-CN: 未找到研究包，请重新选择。
preInvestment.messages.researchPackageNo.en-US: Research package not found. Select it again.

preInvestment.messages.researchPackageCh.zh-CN: 研究包已更新，请刷新后再操作；旧版本仍保留。
preInvestment.messages.researchPackageCh.en-US: Research package changed. Refresh before continuing; previous versions are retained.

preInvestment.messages.finalizedVersions.zh-CN: 已定稿版本不可修改，请复制重研。
preInvestment.messages.finalizedVersions.en-US: Finalized versions cannot be edited. Copy for new research.

preInvestment.messages.theSelectedArtifa.zh-CN: 所选成果不是实施验证报告。
preInvestment.messages.theSelectedArtifa.en-US: The selected artifact is not an implementation validation report.

preInvestment.messages.inputsChangedTheO.zh-CN: 输入已变化，旧报告不适用于当前候选，请重新验证。
preInvestment.messages.inputsChangedTheO.en-US: Inputs changed. The old report does not apply to this candidate; validate again.

preInvestment.messages.mustCoverExactlyT.zh-CN: {{p0}}必须逐项覆盖相同资产，不能缺项或混入其他资产。
preInvestment.messages.mustCoverExactlyT.en-US: {{p0}} must cover exactly the same assets, with no missing or extra assets.

preInvestment.messages.multiPeriodOutOfS.zh-CN: 多段样本外验证预热未完成

preInvestment.messages.noValidTrainingTr.zh-CN: 训练期没有有效趋势信号，各档强度无法形成有效比较，不能据此选出最优偏离。请检查观察窗口、信号有效期与数据公布日期。
preInvestment.messages.noValidTrainingTr.en-US: No valid training trend signals exist, so strengths cannot be compared meaningfully. Check the observation window, signal validity and publication dates.

preInvestment.messages.commonTrainingRet.zh-CN: 训练区 {{p0}} 条、验证区 {{p1}} 条共同收益；各至少需要 20 条。
preInvestment.messages.commonTrainingRet.en-US: {{p0}} common training returns and {{p1}} validation returns; at least 20 are required in each.

preInvestment.messages.trainingReturnVal.zh-CN: {{p0}} 个训练收益值在训练截止日尚不可得，不能用于选择偏离强度。
preInvestment.messages.trainingReturnVal.en-US: {{p0}} training return values were unavailable at the training cutoff and cannot select deviation strength.

preInvestment.messages.trainingReturnsLa.zh-CN: {{p0}} 个训练收益值缺少可得时间，仅可作研究，不能认证历史 PIT。
preInvestment.messages.trainingReturnsLa.en-US: {{p0}} training returns lack availability times; research-only, without historical PIT certification.

preInvestment.messages.adjustTheTraining.zh-CN: 按数据可得时间将训练截止日调整为 {{p0}}。
preInvestment.messages.adjustTheTraining.en-US: Adjust the training cutoff to {{p0}} based on data availability.

preInvestment.messages.switchToFixedHypo.zh-CN: 改为固定假设比较：不搜索强度，保留历史回放限制。
preInvestment.messages.switchToFixedHypo.en-US: Switch to fixed-hypothesis comparison: no strength search; historical replay limitations remain.

preInvestment.messages.theMostRecentKnow.zh-CN: 最近已知窗口超过信号有效期，当前建议回归 SAA。
preInvestment.messages.theMostRecentKnow.en-US: The most recent known window is older than the signal validity limit. Revert to SAA.

preInvestment.messages.allAssetsHaveTheS.zh-CN: 已知窗口内各资产趋势相同，当前保持 SAA。
preInvestment.messages.allAssetsHaveTheS.en-US: All assets have the same trend in the known window. Keep SAA.

preInvestment.messages.noCompleteAvailab.zh-CN: 没有完整且已可得的观察窗口，当前保持 SAA。
preInvestment.messages.noCompleteAvailab.en-US: No complete, available observation window. Keep SAA.

preInvestment.messages.deviationsMustSum.zh-CN: 偏离合计必须为 0；增配需要明确减配来源。
preInvestment.messages.deviationsMustSum.en-US: Deviations must sum to zero; overweights need explicit funding from underweights.

preInvestment.messages.marketStateServic.zh-CN: 市场状态服务不可用，请稍后重试。
preInvestment.messages.marketStateServic.en-US: Market state service unavailable. Retry later.

preInvestment.messages.publishTheHistori.zh-CN: 历史情景运行必须先发布到 TAA 或正式回测。
preInvestment.messages.publishTheHistori.en-US: Publish the historical regime run for TAA or formal backtesting first.

preInvestment.messages.setDeviationsForE.zh-CN: 请为每个已发布状态设置一组偏离。
preInvestment.messages.setDeviationsForE.en-US: Set deviations for every published state.

preInvestment.messages.deviationsMustSum.zh-CN: 每个市场状态的偏离合计必须为 0。
preInvestment.messages.deviationsMustSum.en-US: Deviations must sum to zero within each market state.

preInvestment.messages.stateWasUnavailab.zh-CN: 状态在本期开始时尚不可得
preInvestment.messages.stateWasUnavailab.en-US: State was unavailable at the start of this period

preInvestment.messages.tacticalActiveRis.zh-CN: 战术主动风险上限不得超过已确认政策预算；需要扩大时请回长期配置重新研究。
preInvestment.messages.tacticalActiveRis.en-US: Tactical active risk cannot exceed the confirmed policy budget. Return to long-term allocation to research a larger budget.

preInvestment.messages.someTrainingRetur.zh-CN: 部分训练收益在训练截止日尚不可得，不能用于选优；请先检查数据可得时间，调整训练边界或明确改为固定假设比较。
preInvestment.messages.someTrainingRetur.en-US: Some training returns were unavailable at the cutoff and cannot select candidates. Check availability, adjust training boundaries or explicitly choose fixed-hypothesis comparison.

preInvestment.messages.newStrategyTraini.zh-CN: 新策略训练期存在未知可得日期；请补齐证据或显式改为固定假设比较。
preInvestment.messages.newStrategyTraini.en-US: New-strategy training contains unknown availability dates. Supply evidence or explicitly choose fixed-hypothesis comparison.

preInvestment.messages.noValidTrainingTr.zh-CN: 训练期没有有效趋势信号，不能选择最优偏离；请调整观察窗口、信号有效期或明确改为固定假设比较。
preInvestment.messages.noValidTrainingTr.en-US: No valid training trend signals. Adjust windows or signal validity, or explicitly choose fixed-hypothesis comparison.

preInvestment.messages.theseRulesAndSaaW.zh-CN: 本次规则与 SAA 在当前研究中确定；历史回放不等于当时已部署，不能认定为正式 PIT 业绩。
preInvestment.messages.theseRulesAndSaaW.en-US: These rules and SAA were defined in this study. Historical replay does not imply historical deployment or formal PIT performance.

preInvestment.messages.usesFrozenDecisio.zh-CN: 按冻结决策与执行时钟推进；未交易时持仓漂移。SAA/TAA 使用同一执行规则与成本，训练和验证独立从 SAA 起步。
preInvestment.messages.usesFrozenDecisio.en-US: Uses frozen decision/execution clocks; holdings drift without trades. SAA/TAA share execution and cost rules, and training/validation start independently from SAA.

preInvestment.messages.dailyTargetRebala.zh-CN: 日频目标再平衡；SAA/TAA 使用相同交易成本。训练和验证分别从 SAA 起步。
preInvestment.messages.dailyTargetRebala.en-US: Daily target rebalancing; SAA/TAA use the same trading costs. Training and validation each start from SAA.

preInvestment.messages.candidateSelectio.zh-CN: 候选选择只看训练区；多次查看留出结果后调参会降低验证独立性。
preInvestment.messages.candidateSelectio.en-US: Candidate selection uses training only. Repeated tuning after viewing holdout results weakens validation independence.

preInvestment.messages.incompleteDatesWe.zh-CN: 数据存在不完整日期，已采用共同净值区间；年化按 252 个观察期估算，不代表连续日频实盘收益。
preInvestment.messages.incompleteDatesWe.en-US: Incomplete dates were excluded using common NAV coverage. Annualization assumes 252 observations and does not represent continuous daily live returns.

preInvestment.messages.availabilityIsChe.zh-CN: 可得时间按日期校验；实际 ETF 开盘与基金申赎时点需在产品执行层另行验证。
preInvestment.messages.availabilityIsChe.en-US: Availability is checked by date; actual ETF opens and fund dealing times require separate execution-layer verification.

preInvestment.messages.someTrainingAvail.zh-CN: 训练收益存在未知可得时间，排名仅为事后研究证据，留出结果不构成正式 PIT 验证。
preInvestment.messages.someTrainingAvail.en-US: Some training availability times are unknown. Rankings are retrospective research evidence; holdout results are not formal PIT validation.

preInvestment.messages.oneTimeTurnoverFr.zh-CN: 从当前实际持仓调整至目标的单次换手超过上限，请调整方案后再应用。
preInvestment.messages.oneTimeTurnoverFr.en-US: One-time turnover from actual holdings to target exceeds the limit. Adjust the plan before application.

preInvestment.messages.manualViewsAreRep.zh-CN: 人工观点在整段历史中作为固定假设重演，不代表观点在历史当时已经形成。
preInvestment.messages.manualViewsAreRep.en-US: Manual views are replayed as fixed assumptions throughout history, not treated as views known historically.

preInvestment.messages.theStateModelOrPu.zh-CN: 该市场状态模型或发布在研究时点尚不存在，本次仅为事后规则回放。
preInvestment.messages.theStateModelOrPu.en-US: The state model or publication did not exist at the research date. This is retrospective rule replay only.

preInvestment.messages.fixedHypothesisTr.zh-CN: 固定假设的训练实际持仓或风险预算超限；仅保留诊断，不可应用。
preInvestment.messages.fixedHypothesisTr.en-US: Fixed-hypothesis training holdings or risk budgets breach limits. Diagnostic only; not applicable.

preInvestment.messages.theSelectedCandid.zh-CN: 所选候选在留出区超出风险或换手约束；请复核，不自动改选其他候选。
preInvestment.messages.theSelectedCandid.en-US: The selected candidate breaches holdout risk or turnover constraints. Review it; no alternative candidate is selected automatically.

preInvestment.messages.assetOrGroupConst.zh-CN: 资产或分组约束缩小了偏离。
preInvestment.messages.assetOrGroupConst.en-US: Asset or group constraints reduced the deviation.

preInvestment.messages.keepTheSaaBaselin.zh-CN: 约束与当前信号下保留 SAA 基线。
preInvestment.messages.keepTheSaaBaselin.en-US: Keep the SAA baseline under current signals and constraints.

preInvestment.messages.comparePredefined.zh-CN: 按{{p0}}比较预设偏离强度；留出结果仅供验证。
preInvestment.messages.comparePredefined.en-US: Compare predefined deviation strengths using {{p0}}; holdout results are for validation only.

preInvestment.messages.useTheHighestScor.zh-CN: 采用训练窗口内可行候选中得分最高的强度；按最新可得信号生成当前权重。
preInvestment.messages.useTheHighestScor.en-US: Use the highest-scoring feasible training strength and the latest available signals to generate current weights.

preInvestment.messages.theCurrentSignalI.zh-CN: 当前信号已不可用，已有决策目标不能直接交接；等待下一次决策复核。
preInvestment.messages.theCurrentSignalI.en-US: The current signal is unavailable. Existing targets cannot be handed off directly; await the next decision review.

preInvestment.messages.theSelectedPathBr.zh-CN: 所选路径存在实际持仓、风险或换手预算超限，不能交接。
preInvestment.messages.theSelectedPathBr.en-US: The selected path breaches actual holdings, risk or turnover budgets. Handoff is blocked.

preInvestment.messages.theLatestDecision.zh-CN: 最新决策仍在等待滞后；拟议权重采用最近已满足滞后的决策，不能把新目标当作已成交。
preInvestment.messages.theLatestDecision.en-US: The latest decision is still within its lag. Proposed weights use the latest lag-eligible decision; new targets are not completed trades.

preInvestment.messages.theIntervalAndAss.zh-CN: 当前区间与资产数量生成的结果过大，请缩短回测区间后再比较。
preInvestment.messages.theIntervalAndAss.en-US: The interval and asset count generate excessive output. Shorten the backtest interval and compare again.

preInvestment.messages.historicalReplayR.zh-CN: 历史重演需要有效的起止日期。
preInvestment.messages.historicalReplayR.en-US: Historical replay requires valid start and end dates.

preInvestment.messages.historicalScenari.zh-CN: 历史情景结束日不能晚于研究时点。
preInvestment.messages.historicalScenari.en-US: Historical scenario end must not exceed the research date.

preInvestment.messages.atLeast3CommonNav.zh-CN: 历史情景至少需要 3 个共同净值日，请扩大区间。
preInvestment.messages.atLeast3CommonNav.en-US: At least 3 common NAV dates are needed. Extend the historical scenario interval.

preInvestment.messages.historicalScenari.zh-CN: 历史情景须位于本次预览范围 {{p0}} 至 {{p1}}；请先调整研究区间并重新比较。
preInvestment.messages.historicalScenari.en-US: Historical scenarios must lie within preview coverage {{p0}} to {{p1}}. Adjust the research interval and compare again.

preInvestment.messages.comparisonUnderSp.zh-CN: 这是指定冲击/历史条件下的比较，不是预测或发生概率。
preInvestment.messages.comparisonUnderSp.en-US: Comparison under specified shocks or historical conditions, not a forecast or occurrence probability.

preInvestment.messages.usesCurrentRecomm.zh-CN: 使用当前建议权重、每日恢复目标、同一成本；资产收益贡献扣除显式费用后与净收益对账；改善表示两者收益百分点之差。
preInvestment.messages.usesCurrentRecomm.en-US: Uses current recommended weights, daily target restoration and identical costs. Asset contributions reconcile to net return after explicit fees; improvement is the return difference in percentage points.

preInvestment.messages.inputsOrPlanChang.zh-CN: 输入数据或方案已变化，请重新预览后保存。
preInvestment.messages.inputsOrPlanChang.en-US: Inputs or plan changed. Preview again before saving.

preInvestment.messages.researchAndScenar.zh-CN: 研究版本与情景过大，请减少情景或缩短区间后保存。
preInvestment.messages.researchAndScenar.en-US: Research and scenarios exceed the size limit. Reduce scenarios or shorten intervals before saving.

preInvestment.messages.aProductAppearsAc.zh-CN: 同一产品跨大类出现，请在 SAA 中明确唯一预算归属后应用。
preInvestment.messages.aProductAppearsAc.en-US: A product appears across asset classes. Establish one budget assignment in SAA before application.

preInvestment.messages.saaConfigurationH.zh-CN: SAA 配置的 {{p0}} 存在多个版本，无法确定来源。

policyFrontier.commonHelp.zh-CN: 同图比较各个 LTCMA 的收益与风险边界；每条实线均包含本次权重、现金与流动性约束。
policyFrontier.commonHelp.en-US: Compare each LTCMA on the same axes. Each solid curve includes the current weight, cash and liquidity constraints.

policyFrontier.fusedHelp.zh-CN: 按设定比例融合各 LTCMA 的收益率与协方差，再计算一条有效前沿；不是对曲线取平均。
policyFrontier.fusedHelp.en-US: Blend LTCMA returns and covariances using the selected weights, then solve one frontier. The curves themselves are not averaged.

policyFrontier.singleHelp.zh-CN: 查看当前 LTCMA 在本次权重、现金与流动性约束下能达到的收益与风险。
policyFrontier.singleHelp.en-US: Explore attainable returns and risk under the current LTCMA, weight, cash and liquidity constraints.

policyFrontier.showReference.zh-CN: 显示无额外约束参考线

policyFrontier.referenceHelp.zh-CN: 虚线仅保留单项 0～100% 和总权重 100%，用于比较约束的影响，不代表满足投资目标。
policyFrontier.referenceHelp.en-US: Dashed curves retain only 0–100% asset bounds and a 100% total. They show the effect of constraints, not objective compliance.

policyFrontier.commonCaution.zh-CN: 各条前沿都进入目标区，也不代表同一组合能全部达标。圆点表示同一组配置权重在各模型下的结果，须逐模型检查。
policyFrontier.commonCaution.en-US: Individual frontiers entering the target region do not prove that one portfolio passes every model. Dots evaluate the same allocation under each model; check every result.

policyFrontier.pointTable.zh-CN: 共同组合在各 LTCMA 下的结果
policyFrontier.pointTable.en-US: Common portfolio results under each LTCMA

policyFrontier.noPoints.zh-CN: 完成政策候选比较后，展示共同组合在各模型下的位置；没有完整的逐模型结果时不画组合点。
policyFrontier.noPoints.en-US: Compare policy candidates to see the common portfolio under each model. Dots require complete per-model evidence.

saaScope.researchOnly.en-US: SAA sets long-term asset-class weights and does not require investment products. Select specific products at the product allocation stage.

preInvestment.scopeMandateSummary.fundin.en-US: Required annual return for the plan

preInvestment.scopeMandateSummary.fundin.zh-CN: 按本金、每笔投入与支出、费用及期末目标自动反推年化复利收益率，已考虑计划内费用。它是完成计划的收益要求，不是市场收益预测。要调整它，请在 01 修改资金安排或期末目标。
preInvestment.scopeMandateSummary.fundin.en-US: The annual compound return required by the plan is derived from starting capital, each contribution and payment, fees and the terminal target. Planned fees are included in this requirement. This is a funding requirement, not a market forecast. Adjust the cash-flow plan or terminal target in step 01 to change it.

saaCenter.description.en-US: Review saved long-term allocations and their objectives, research scope and LTCMA.

saaCenter.emptyHint.en-US: Create a new SAA plan, select a scope and confirmed LTCMA, then save the allocation.
