mandate.fundingReturnBasis.zh-CN: 按本金、投入、支出、费用与期末目标反推的年化复利要求，不是市场收益预测。
mandate.fundingReturnBasis.en-US: Annual compound return required by capital, contributions, payments, fees and the terminal target; not a market forecast.

scopeFeasibility.fundingPassed.zh-CN: 收益门槛与风险约束初筛通过
scopeFeasibility.fundingPassed.en-US: Return hurdle and risk screening passed

scopeFeasibility.fundingNotReached.zh-CN: 尚未找到达到收益门槛的组合
scopeFeasibility.fundingNotReached.en-US: No computed portfolio reaches the return hurdle

scopeFeasibility.fundingPassedHelp.zh-CN: 当前范围中已找到符合权重、现金等配置约束，且模型复利收益达到计划要求、波动不超过上限的组合。
scopeFeasibility.fundingPassedHelp.en-US: The current scope contains a portfolio satisfying allocation and cash constraints whose model compound return meets the plan hurdle within the volatility cap.

scopeFeasibility.fundingNotReachedHelp.zh-CN: 已计算的组合尚未同时达到复利收益门槛与风险上限。可调整范围、权重或资金计划；有限前沿点未达标，不等于已证明所有组合都不可行。
scopeFeasibility.fundingNotReachedHelp.en-US: No computed portfolio meets both the compound hurdle and volatility cap. Review the scope, weights or funding plan; finite frontier samples do not prove global infeasibility.

scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.return.zh-CN: 模型年化复利收益（中位数）

scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.descript.zh-CN: 横轴为年化波动，纵轴为模型年化复利收益（中位数）。资金计划要求为 {{target}}，风险上限为 {{cap}}。图下数值表可读取前沿与目标边界。
scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.descript.en-US: Horizontal axis: annual volatility; vertical axis: model annual compound return (median path). Funding hurdle: {{target}}; volatility cap: {{cap}}. Values are available below the chart.

scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.meaning.zh-CN: 横虚线是资金计划所需复利收益率，竖虚线是风险上限；浅色区域用于比较收益门槛与风险约束。三条前沿均按相同模型换算为复利口径，参考线不参与当前范围达标判断。进入该区域不代表已达到资金计划的成功概率要求。
scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.meaning.en-US: The horizontal line is the funding compound hurdle; the vertical line is the volatility cap. Shading compares these boundaries. All frontiers use the same compound transformation; reference curves cannot pass the current scope. Being in the region does not validate the funding success probability.

scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.noTarget.zh-CN: 各条前沿已统一为模型复利口径；缺少精确收益门槛或风险上限时，不绘制目标交点。请查看上方的计算状态。
scopeFeasibility.chart.compound.noTarget.en-US: All frontiers use the model compound basis. Without an exact hurdle or volatility cap, no target intersection is shown. See the calculation status above.

scopeFeasibility.compoundBasis.zh-CN: 三条曲线沿用各自的历史均值和风险参数，按 252 日、日收益独立的对数正态模型换算为扣除计划费用前的年化复利收益（中位数）；不是历史实际复合收益，也不是未来收益预测。
scopeFeasibility.compoundBasis.en-US: Each curve retains its historical mean and risk inputs, transformed using a 252-day independent daily lognormal model into annual median-path compound growth before planned fees. This is neither realized historical CAGR nor a forecast.

preInvestment.overview.title.zh-CN: 从投资目标，到研究定稿
preInvestment.overview.title.en-US: From investment objectives to a final research package

preInvestment.overview.description.zh-CN: 沿着三段流程推进；每一步的成果，都是后续研究的依据。
preInvestment.overview.description.en-US: Follow three phases. Each step supplies the evidence or inputs for the next.

preInvestment.overview.foundation.purpos.zh-CN: 明确要达到什么目标，用哪些资产来研究。
preInvestment.overview.foundation.purpos.en-US: Define the objective and the assets to study.

preInvestment.overview.foundation.handof.zh-CN: 目标与范围 + 已确认 LTCMA → SAA。先确认长期收益与风险，再研究配置比例。
preInvestment.overview.foundation.handof.en-US: Objectives and scope + confirmed LTCMA → SAA. Confirm long-term return and risk assumptions before allocating weights.

preInvestment.overview.allocation.purpos.zh-CN: 先定大类比例，再落实到具体产品。
preInvestment.overview.allocation.purpos.en-US: Set asset-class weights, then allocate to products.

preInvestment.overview.allocation.handof.zh-CN: 不做战术调整时，可从 SAA 进入产品配置；需要调整时，先做 TAA。产品配置保存后进入研究验证。
preInvestment.overview.allocation.handof.en-US: Use SAA directly for product allocation, or research tactical adjustments in TAA first. Save the product allocation before validation.

preInvestment.overview.review.purpose.zh-CN: 核对同一份方案，保留可复核的研究依据。
preInvestment.overview.review.purpose.en-US: Review the same candidate and retain its supporting evidence.

preInvestment.overview.review.handoff.zh-CN: 验证通过后定稿；发现问题先返回修改，再重新验证。定稿产出冻结研究包。
preInvestment.overview.review.handoff.en-US: Finalize after validation. If issues arise, revise and validate again. Finalization produces a frozen research package.

preInvestment.overview.objectives.action.zh-CN: 设定收益目标、风险上限、投资期限与现金需求。
preInvestment.overview.objectives.action.en-US: Set return objectives, risk limits, investment horizon and cash needs.

preInvestment.overview.product-pool.acti.zh-CN: 绑定投资目标，选择先定大类或先选产品池。
preInvestment.overview.product-pool.acti.en-US: Bind an objective and start with asset classes or a product pool.

preInvestment.overview.ltcma.action.zh-CN: 基于研究范围，估计长期收益、风险及相关性。
preInvestment.overview.ltcma.action.en-US: Estimate long-term returns, risks and correlations for the scope.

preInvestment.overview.saa.action.zh-CN: 引用目标、范围和 LTCMA，比较并保存长期配置。
preInvestment.overview.saa.action.en-US: Use objectives, scope and LTCMA to compare and save a strategic allocation.

preInvestment.overview.taa.action.zh-CN: 在 SAA 允许区间内，研究阶段性权重调整。
preInvestment.overview.taa.action.en-US: Research tactical weight adjustments within the SAA ranges.

preInvestment.overview.product-allocatio.zh-CN: 承接 SAA 或 TAA，配置具体产品并核对费用、风险与现金。
preInvestment.overview.product-allocatio.en-US: Use SAA or TAA to allocate products and check costs, risk and cash.

preInvestment.overview.portfolio-synthes.zh-CN: 汇总候选方案的来源、产品权重与风险证据。
preInvestment.overview.portfolio-synthes.en-US: Bring together the candidate’s sources, product weights and risk evidence.

preInvestment.overview.validation.action.zh-CN: 复核产品风险、费用、资金安排与选定情景。
preInvestment.overview.validation.action.en-US: Check product risk, costs, funding needs and selected scenarios.

preInvestment.overview.approval.action.zh-CN: 核对验证报告，记录采纳理由与复核日期。
preInvestment.overview.approval.action.en-US: Review the validation report and record the rationale and review date.

preInvestment.overview.paths.title.zh-CN: 两种研究路径如何汇合？
preInvestment.overview.paths.title.en-US: How do the two research paths converge?

preInvestment.overview.paths.strategy.de.zh-CN: 定义权益、固收等大类，配置指数或产品作为研究代理；现金类填写预期收益率。真实投资产品可以在后续匹配。
preInvestment.overview.paths.strategy.de.en-US: Define asset classes and select indices or products as research proxies. Enter an expected return for cash. Investable products can be matched later.

preInvestment.overview.paths.product.des.zh-CN: 选择已保存的产品池版本，构建大类及其代理。两条路径都先完成 LTCMA，再进入 SAA。
preInvestment.overview.paths.product.des.en-US: Select saved product-pool versions, then construct asset classes and their proxies. Both paths go through LTCMA before SAA.

preInvestment.overview.navigationHint.zh-CN: 点击步骤名称进入对应工作区；已有研究在各模块列表中打开。现有工具保留在阶段导航中。
preInvestment.overview.navigationHint.en-US: Open a workspace by selecting its step name. Open saved research from each module’s list. Existing tools remain in the stage navigation.

agent.regime.help.zh-CN: 描述你要识别的市场状态，AI 会复用已有模板和节点生成草稿。检查后应用到编辑器，再试算和保存。
agent.regime.help.en-US: Describe the market states you want to identify. AI uses existing templates and nodes to propose a draft. Review it, apply to the editor, then preview and save.

agent.regime.designPrompt.zh-CN: 帮我设计情景识别算法。先读取当前研究模式和可用模板，和我确认识别目标。
agent.regime.designPrompt.en-US: Help me design a scenario algorithm. Check the current mode and templates, then clarify the states to identify.

agent.regime.explainPrompt.zh-CN: 读取当前编辑器，解释每个步骤、参数和时点要求。
agent.regime.explainPrompt.en-US: Read the editor and explain its steps, parameters and timing requirements.

agent.regime.improvePrompt.zh-CN: 我想修改当前情景算法。先读取图谱并简要说明可修改的参数，等我告诉你具体要求。
agent.regime.improvePrompt.en-US: I want to change this algorithm. Read its graph and summarize editable parameters, then wait for my requirements.

agent.regime.summary.zh-CN: {{count}} 个步骤 · 应用后可预览、撤销和保存
agent.regime.summary.en-US: {{count}} steps · Preview, undo and save after applying

agent.regime.applied.zh-CN: 已应用。可以撤销；试算和保存请在编辑器完成。
agent.regime.applied.en-US: Applied. You can undo the change. Preview and save in the editor.

agent.regime.changed.zh-CN: 页面或草稿已变化，请让 AI 按当前内容重新校验。
agent.regime.changed.en-US: The page or draft changed. Ask AI to validate against the current editor.

agent.regime.invalid.zh-CN: 尚未通过当前研究模式的校验，请调整后再应用。
agent.regime.invalid.en-US: Not valid for the current research mode. Revise before applying.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.summary.zh-CN: 已按共同日期对齐：{{dates}} 个价格观察日、{{periods}} 个收益区间；{{excluded}} 个非共同日期不作调仓点，跨过这些日期的 {{spans}} 个区间仍保留全部涨跌。最长区间 {{days}} 个自然日。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.summary.en-US: Aligned to {{dates}} common price dates and {{periods}} return intervals. The {{excluded}} non-common dates are not rebalance points; all price changes across the {{spans}} spanning intervals are retained. Longest interval: {{days}} calendar days.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.convention.zh-CN: 年化风险按区间实际时长估计（ACT/365.25），现金按实际天数复利计息。观察窗口、持有期及每日调仓均按共同观察期计数；代理信号在公布日期之后使用。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.convention.en-US: Annual risk uses actual interval lengths (ACT/365.25); cash compounds over elapsed calendar days. Lookback, holding periods and daily rebalancing count common observation intervals. Proxy signals are used after their publication date.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.unknownCalenda.zh-CN: 日期差异可能来自市场休市或数据缺失；目前未用各市场完整日历核验原因。下表统计共同覆盖区间内、其他代理有记录而该代理没有记录的日期；不补价格、不填零收益。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.unknownCalenda.en-US: Date differences may reflect market closures or missing data; complete market calendars have not verified the cause. Counts below cover dates within the common range when another proxy has a record but this proxy does not. Prices are not filled and missing returns are not replaced with zero.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.cashOnly.zh-CN: 仅含现金假设，无市场代理。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.cashOnly.en-US: Cash assumptions only; no market proxies.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.intervalRebala.zh-CN: 共同观察期目标再平衡；SAA/TAA 使用相同交易成本。训练和验证分别从 SAA 起步。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.intervalRebala.en-US: Rebalance targets at common observations. SAA and TAA use the same transaction costs. Training and validation each start from SAA.

preInvestment.taaCalendar.stressRebalanc.zh-CN: 使用当前建议权重、每个观察期恢复目标、同一成本；资产收益贡献扣除显式费用后与净收益对账；改善表示两者收益百分点之差。
preInvestment.taaCalendar.stressRebalanc.en-US: Use current proposed weights, reset targets at each observation, and apply the same costs. Asset contributions less explicit costs reconcile to net returns; improvement is the percentage-point difference in returns.

mandate.compoundTargetHint.zh-CN: 累计收益按复利折算为年化要求；后续结合组合波动，与 LTCMA 的算术收益比较。
mandate.compoundTargetHint.en-US: Cumulative growth is annualized on a compound basis, then compared with arithmetic CMA returns at the portfolio risk.

mandate.compoundConversion.zh-CN: 投资期累计目标 {{total}}，对应所需年化复利收益 {{annual}}。
mandate.compoundConversion.en-US: A cumulative target of {{total}} implies required compound annual growth of {{annual}}.

mandate.requirementsHelp.zh-CN: 这里是目标要求，不是市场预测。后续方案须同时满足收益、风险及现金等约束。
mandate.requirementsHelp.en-US: These are requirements, not market forecasts. Subsequent portfolios must meet return, risk, cash and other limits together.

mandate.benchmarkReturnPending.zh-CN: 选择数值基准后，按同一模型计算“基准收益＋目标超额”。不同 LTCMA 下的数值可能不同。
mandate.benchmarkReturnPending.en-US: Select a numerical benchmark to calculate benchmark return plus required excess. The result depends on the selected CMA.

mandate.benchmarkReturnEquation.zh-CN: 当前参考：基准 {{benchmark}} ＋ 要求超额 {{excess}} ＝ 所需年化算术收益 {{required}}。SAA 将用所选 LTCMA 重新计算。
mandate.benchmarkReturnEquation.en-US: Current reference: benchmark {{benchmark}} + required excess {{excess}} = required arithmetic return {{required}}. SAA recalculates this using the selected CMA.

mandate.compoundComparisonHelp.zh-CN: 复利要求与算术收益分别保留。系统按组合实际波动换算后比较；资金路径成功率另行验证，费用只计算一次。
mandate.compoundComparisonHelp.en-US: Compound and arithmetic requirements remain distinct. Comparisons account for actual portfolio volatility; funding success is checked separately and fees are counted once.

mandate.referenceReturnPass.zh-CN: 参考组合收益 {{reference}}、波动 {{risk}}，达到同口径收益要求 {{required}}；实际方案仍需用所选 LTCMA 验证。
mandate.referenceReturnPass.en-US: Reference return {{reference}} at risk {{risk}} meets the comparable requirement {{required}}. Validate the actual portfolio using its selected CMA.

mandate.referenceReturnFail.zh-CN: 参考组合收益 {{reference}}、波动 {{risk}}，未达到同口径收益要求 {{required}}。可调整目标或继续检验实际范围。
mandate.referenceReturnFail.en-US: Reference return {{reference}} at risk {{risk}} does not meet the comparable requirement {{required}}. Adjust the goal or test the actual scope.

policyFrontier.returnCurveHelp.zh-CN: 收益要求线已结合组合波动换算为算术收益；线上方且风险上限左侧满足本项初筛。资金成功率和其他约束仍需单独通过。
policyFrontier.returnCurveHelp.en-US: The required-return curve converts compound growth to arithmetic return at each risk level. Points above it and below the risk cap pass this screen; funding success and other constraints remain separate checks.

policyFrontier.benchmarkRequirement.zh-CN: 所需算术收益按本模型的基准收益＋目标超额计算；共同模式下每个模型分别验证。
policyFrontier.benchmarkRequirement.en-US: Required arithmetic return equals each model’s benchmark return plus required excess; common mode checks every model separately.

mandate.returnCheckFailed.zh-CN: 收益要求暂时未能读取。请核对输入后重试诊断；当前不显示达标结论。
mandate.returnCheckFailed.en-US: Unable to load return requirements. Check the inputs and retry diagnosis; no passing conclusion is shown.

ltcma.handoffNotCurrent.zh-CN: 该 LTCMA 或其投资目标、研究范围已有新版本；请基于最新版本修改后再进入 SAA。
ltcma.handoffNotCurrent.en-US: This LTCMA or its objectives or scope has a newer version. Update it to the latest version before using it in SAA.

versioning.reason.selfRetired.zh-CN: 此版本已删除，只能查看。
versioning.reason.selfRetired.en-US: This version was deleted and is view-only.

versioning.reason.selfSuperseded.zh-CN: 此版本已被 v{{latest}} 替代，只能查看。
versioning.reason.selfSuperseded.en-US: This version was replaced by v{{latest}} and is view-only.

versioning.reason.upstreamDeleted.en-US: {{kind}}{{name}} was deleted, so this was automatically retired.

versioning.reason.upstreamSuperseded.zh-CN: {{kind}}{{name}}已有新版本 v{{latest}}；请基于新版本修改后再用于下一步。
versioning.reason.upstreamSuperseded.en-US: {{kind}}{{name}} has a newer v{{latest}}. Update to it before using this in the next step.

versioning.reason.upstreamStale.en-US: The upstream of {{kind}}{{name}} changed. Update the {{kind}} first.

versioning.scopeMandateHasNewer.zh-CN: 绑定的目标 v{{number}} 已有新版本 v{{latest}}。
versioning.scopeMandateHasNewer.en-US: The linked objective v{{number}} has a newer v{{latest}}.

versioning.scopeMandateUpgraded.zh-CN: 已改用同一目标的最新版本；保存后生成新的范围版本，原版本保留可查。
versioning.scopeMandateUpgraded.en-US: Switched to the latest version of the same objective. Saving creates a new scope version; the original stays viewable.

mandate.compoundReachable.zh-CN: 授权波动范围内有参考点达到同口径收益要求；资金成功率由独立模拟判断。
mandate.compoundReachable.en-US: A reference point within the authorized risk cap meets the comparable return requirement. Funding success uses independent simulation.

mandate.compoundNotReached.zh-CN: 授权波动范围内尚未找到达到同口径收益要求的参考点；有限搜索不证明所有组合无解。
mandate.compoundNotReached.en-US: No tested reference point within the risk cap meets the comparable return requirement. A finite search does not prove that every portfolio is infeasible.

versioning.newerEquivalent.zh-CN: 已有新版本 v{{latest}} · 配置相同

mandate.candidateReturnPass.zh-CN: 同口径收益检查通过：预期算术年收益 {{actual}}，本组合风险下所需 {{required}}。
mandate.candidateReturnPass.en-US: Comparable return check passed: expected arithmetic return {{actual}}; required at this portfolio risk {{required}}.

mandate.candidateReturnFail.zh-CN: 收益要求未达标：预期算术年收益 {{actual}}，本组合风险下所需 {{required}}。可查看资金缺口，不能确认此政策。
mandate.candidateReturnFail.en-US: Return requirement not met: expected arithmetic return {{actual}}; required at this portfolio risk {{required}}. Review the funding shortfall; this policy cannot be confirmed.

saaDetail.frozenHint.zh-CN: 展示保存时的研究结果；后续研究会重新核验适用条件。
saaDetail.frozenHint.en-US: Results are frozen at saving. Eligibility is checked again in subsequent research.

saaDetail.minimumReturn.zh-CN: 各模型最低预期年收益
saaDetail.minimumReturn.en-US: Lowest expected annual return across models

saaDetail.maximumRisk.zh-CN: 各模型最高预期年波动
saaDetail.maximumRisk.en-US: Highest expected annual volatility across models

saaDetail.commonMetricsHint.zh-CN: 收益与风险分别取各模型最不利值，可能来自不同模型。逐模型结果可在下方展开查看。
saaDetail.commonMetricsHint.en-US: Return and risk each use the least favorable model and may come from different models. Expand the checks below for individual results.

saaDetail.metricsHint.zh-CN: 按保存时的 LTCMA 假设计算。
saaDetail.metricsHint.en-US: Calculated using the LTCMA assumptions frozen with this plan.

saaDetail.noMetrics.zh-CN: 这份历史记录未保存收益风险摘要；不按最新假设补算。
saaDetail.noMetrics.en-US: This record has no saved return and risk summary. It is not recalculated using newer assumptions.

saaDetail.noWeights.zh-CN: 这份历史记录没有资产权重，请返回列表选择其他方案。
saaDetail.noWeights.en-US: This record has no asset weights. Return to the list and select another plan.

saaDetail.commonHint.zh-CN: 同一组资产权重，须满足每份 LTCMA 的目标与约束。
saaDetail.commonHint.en-US: The same asset weights must satisfy the objectives and constraints under every LTCMA.

saaDetail.averageHint.zh-CN: 按研究权重融合 LTCMA 参数；采纳依据为融合后的结果。
saaDetail.averageHint.en-US: LTCMA parameters are combined using the research weights. Adoption is based on the combined results.

saaDetail.singleHint.zh-CN: 使用以下 LTCMA 的收益与风险假设。
saaDetail.singleHint.en-US: Uses the return and risk assumptions of the LTCMA below.

saaDetail.reason.zh-CN: 采纳理由与复核关注点

saaDetail.modelChecks.zh-CN: 查看各 LTCMA 下的收益、风险与约束结果
saaDetail.modelChecks.en-US: View return, risk and constraint checks by LTCMA

saaDetail.technicalDetails.zh-CN: 查看求解与不确定性详情

saaDetail.chartDescription.zh-CN: 资产权重分布；各项精确比例见旁边的资产清单。
saaDetail.chartDescription.en-US: Asset weight distribution. Exact weights are listed alongside the chart.

agent.scenarioPublicationHelp.zh-CN: 保存与发布仍在原工作区单独确认。
agent.scenarioPublicationHelp.en-US: Confirm saving or publishing separately in the workspace.

agent.platform.description.zh-CN: 描述你的目标，助手会理解需求并带你进入对应页面。也可以直接聊天。
agent.platform.description.en-US: Describe your goal to find the right page and continue your task, or simply chat.

agent.platform.welcome.zh-CN: 目前支持交给指标中心编写、校验和试算指标。其他功能可咨询或打开页面；正式保存仍由你确认。
agent.platform.welcome.en-US: The indicator center can author, validate and preview indicators. Ask about other features or open their pages. Saving requires your confirmation.

agent.platform.createExample.zh-CN: 帮我创建60日滚动夏普指标

agent.platform.invalidDestination.zh-CN: 任务入口不匹配，请重新描述需求。
agent.platform.invalidDestination.en-US: The task destination does not match. Please describe your request again.

agent.platform.conversation.zh-CN: 本轮仅讨论，不执行操作。
agent.platform.conversation.en-US: Discussion only; no action will run.

agent.platform.clarification_required.zh-CN: 需要补充信息后才能继续。
agent.platform.clarification_required.en-US: More information is needed before continuing.

agent.platform.ready.zh-CN: 已理解需求，准备进入对应页面。
agent.platform.ready.en-US: Request understood; ready to open the page.

agent.platform.unsupported.zh-CN: 该功能尚未接入中央助手执行，未进行操作。
agent.platform.unsupported.en-US: This feature is not connected for central execution. No action was taken.

agent.platform.pageReplied.zh-CN: 页面助手已回复；具体成果请在任务页面查看。
agent.platform.pageReplied.en-US: The page assistant has replied. View the task page for its results.

agent.platform.received.zh-CN: 任务已由页面助手接收。
agent.platform.received.en-US: The page assistant has received the task.

agent.platform.waitingPage.zh-CN: 正在准备指标中心，任务尚未开始。
agent.platform.waitingPage.en-US: Preparing the indicator center. The task has not started.

agent.platform.cancelled.zh-CN: 页面任务已停止；可进入任务页面查看或继续对话。
agent.platform.cancelled.en-US: The page task was stopped. Open it to review or continue the conversation.

agent.platform.paused.zh-CN: 页面任务已暂停，请进入页面补充条件。
agent.platform.paused.en-US: The page task is paused. Open it to provide the missing context.

agent.platform.interrupted.zh-CN: 页面任务已中断，可进入页面恢复。
agent.platform.interrupted.en-US: The page task was interrupted. Open it to resume.

agent.platform.failed.zh-CN: 页面任务处理失败，可进入页面查看原因并重试。
agent.platform.failed.en-US: The page task failed. Open it to review the error and retry.
